docstring:
Gauss reducedness for the integral binary quadratic form
`a*x^2 + b*x*y + c*y^2` in the strict source convention:

`IsGaussReduced a b c` holds iff `0 < a`, `discrim a b c < 0`,
`|b| ≤ a`, `a ≤ c`, and `(|b| = a ∨ a = c) → 0 ≤ b`.

This is Mortenson `arXiv:1702.01627v2` Section 2 line 259. In particular
`(1,-1,1)` is positive definite and satisfies the loose inequalities but
is not reduced because the tie-break requires `b ≥ 0`.

docstring:
A cube basis polynomial evaluates to one at its point and zero at every
other Boolean point.
name: BooleanCube.eval_cubeBasis
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x y : BooleanCube.BoolCube n), (MvPolynomial.eval fun i ↦ if y i = Bool.true then 1 else 0) (BooleanCube.cubeBasis x) = if x = y then 1 else 0
statement:
theorem eval_cubeBasis {n : ℕ} (x y : BoolCube n) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => if y i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) (cubeBasis x) =
      if x = y then 1 else 0

docstring:
The deterministic extension agrees with the Boolean function at every
cube point.
name: BooleanCube.eval_multilinearExtension
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanCube.BoolCube n → Bool) (y : BooleanCube.BoolCube n), (MvPolynomial.eval fun i ↦ if y i = Bool.true then 1 else 0) (BooleanCube.multilinearExtension f) = if f y = Bool.true then 1 else 0
statement:
theorem eval_multilinearExtension {n : ℕ}
    (f : BoolCube n → Bool) (y : BoolCube n) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => if y i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      (multilinearExtension f) = if f y then 1 else 0

docstring:
The Fourier degree of the `0/1` indicator of a Boolean function is at most

extension vanish. This connects `booleanDegree` to `MultilinearDegreeLE`.

statement:
theorem multilinearDegreeLE_indicator {n : ℕ} (f : BoolCube n → Bool) :
    MultilinearDegreeLE n (fun x => if f x then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      (booleanDegree f)

    multilinearExtension (fun x => x i) = MvPolynomial.X i

docstring:
If `G` is finite and `Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b` for primes `p, q` and
`a, b : ℕ`, then `G` is solvable. Proved by descent to `Fin (Fintype.card G)`.
name: BurnsidePaqb.burnside_paqb
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] (p q a b : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b → Group.IsSolvable G
statement:
theorem burnside_paqb {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (p q a b : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (hcard : Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b) : Group.IsSolvable G

name: BurnsidePaqb.burnside_paqb_of_simple_prime
signature: ∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G], (∀ {H : Type u} [inst : Group H] [inst_2 : Fintype H], IsSimpleGroup H → (∃ g, g ≠ 1 ∧ IsPrimePow (BurnsidePaqb.conjClass g).card) → ∃ r, Nat.Prime r ∧ Fintype.card H = r) → ∀ (p q a b : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b → Group.IsSolvable G
statement:
theorem burnside_paqb_of_simple_prime
    (C6 : ∀ {H : Type u} [Group H] [Fintype H], IsSimpleGroup H →
      (∃ g : H, g ≠ 1 ∧ IsPrimePow (conjClass g).card) →
      ∃ r : ℕ, r.Prime ∧ Fintype.card H = r)
    (p q : ℕ) (a b : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (hcard : Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b) : Group.IsSolvable G

docstring:
Burnside's `p^a q^b` theorem for small-universe groups: if `G` is finite with
`Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b` for primes `p, q`, then `G` is solvable.
Proved via the simple-prime-power corollary and induction.
name: BurnsidePaqb.burnside_paqb_zero
signature: ∀ {G : Type} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] (p q a b : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → Fintype.card G = p ^ a * q ^ b → Group.IsSolvable G

statement:

    ∑ x ∈ (ConjClasses.carrier l).toFinset, ρ.character x * ρ.character x⁻¹
      = (Module.finrank ℂ V : ℂ)
        * (centralScalar ρ l * ρ.character (classRep l)⁻¹)

docstring: An embedding sends the character value to the sum of conjugate roots.
name: BurnsidePaqb.embedding_char_eq_conj_sum
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : _root_.Module ℂ V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : Representation ℂ G V) (g : G) (hmg : ∀ μ ∈ (ρ g).charpoly.roots, μ ^ m = 1) (hχ : ρ.character g ∈ BurnsidePaqb.cycSubfield m) (σ : ↥(BurnsidePaqb.cycSubfield m) →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ), σ ⟨ρ.character g, hχ⟩ = (Multiset.map (fun x ↦ σ (BurnsidePaqb.conjRootElem m hm ρ g hmg x)) (ρ g).charpoly.roots.attach).sum
statement:
theorem embedding_char_eq_conj_sum (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G V) (g : G)
    (hmg : ∀ μ ∈ (ρ g).charpoly.roots, μ ^ m = 1)
    (hχ : ρ.character g ∈ cycSubfield m)
    (σ : cycSubfield m →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) :
    σ ⟨ρ.character g, hχ⟩
      = (((ρ g).charpoly.roots.attach.map
        (fun x => σ (conjRootElem m hm ρ g hmg x))).sum)

docstring: Chebyshev's estimate `θ(x) ~ x` follows from the prime number theorem.
name: Chebyshev.theta_isEquivalent_of_primeCounting_isEquivalent
signature: (Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop (fun x ↦ ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting) fun x ↦ x / Real.log x) → Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop Chebyshev.theta fun x ↦ x

    (h : (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ))

docstring:
For a reduced residue class `a` modulo `q`, the average of the von Mangoldt function over
`n ≡ a (mod q)` tends to `1 / φ(q)`. Source: the proved theorem
`PrimeNumberTheoremAnd.WeakPNT_AP` in
[PrimeNumberTheoremAnd](https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd), revision
`be5e07e04cde20c5ceabf63759bd097a9c88173f`, and its use in
[arXiv:2608.24035](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24035). Lean preserves the source's natural
representative and half-open `Finset.range` normalization, while omitting the redundant assumption
`1 ≤ q`, which follows from `a < q`.

Proves `Wanted` entry `weakPNT_arithmeticProgression`.
name: Chebyshev.weakPNT_arithmeticProgression
signature: ∀ {q a : ℕ}, a.Coprime q → a < q → Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, if n % q = a then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0) / ↑N) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / ↑q.totient))
statement:
public theorem weakPNT_arithmeticProgression {q a : ℕ}
    (ha : Nat.Coprime a q) (ha_lt : a < q) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
            if n % q = a then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0) / (N : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (Nat.totient q : ℝ)))

docstring: Boundary integral of `1/s` over a rectangle containing `0`: `2πi`.
name: Complex.boundary_rect_one_div
signature: ∀ {a b T : ℝ}, a < 0 → 0 < b → 0 < T → ((∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + -↑T * Complex.I)) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I)) + Complex.I * ((∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, 1 / (↑b + ↑y * Complex.I)) - ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, 1 / (↑a + ↑y * Complex.I)) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I
statement:
theorem boundary_rect_one_div {a b T : ℝ} (ha : a < 0) (hb : 0 < b) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + -T * Complex.I))
      - (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + T * Complex.I))
      + Complex.I * ((∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T, (1 : ℂ) / (b + y * Complex.I))
        - (∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T, (1 : ℂ) / (a + y * Complex.I)))
      = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I

docstring: Rectangle boundary of `1/s` with the pole outside (`0 < a`): vanishes.
name: Complex.boundary_rect_one_div_outside
signature: ∀ {a b T : ℝ}, 0 < a → a ≤ b → 0 < T → ((∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + -↑T * Complex.I)) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I)) + Complex.I * ((∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, 1 / (↑b + ↑y * Complex.I)) - ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, 1 / (↑a + ↑y * Complex.I)) = 0
statement:
theorem boundary_rect_one_div_outside {a b T : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + -T * Complex.I))
      - (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + T * Complex.I))
      + Complex.I * ((∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T, (1 : ℂ) / (b + y * Complex.I))
        - (∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T, (1 : ℂ) / (a + y * Complex.I)))
      = 0

The exponent gap in the corrected Rosenbloom estimate absorbs every fixed

signature: ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 < C → ∃ U, 1 < U ∧ ∀ (μ A : ℝ), U ≤ μ → μ ≤ A → A ≤ C * μ * (1 + Real.log A ^ (81 / 128)) → A ≤ μ * Real.log μ ^ (2 / 3)
statement:
theorem eventually_absorb_corrected_wiman_exponent
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ U : ℝ, 1 < U ∧ ∀ μ A : ℝ,
      U ≤ μ → μ ≤ A →
      A ≤ C * μ * (1 + Real.log A ^ (81 / 128 : ℝ)) →
      A ≤ μ * Real.log μ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)

docstring: Eventually the maximum Taylor term is greater than one.
name: Complex.eventually_one_lt_wimanMaximumTerm
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∀ᶠ (r : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, 1 < Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r
statement:
theorem eventually_one_lt_wimanMaximumTerm
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop, 1 < wimanMaximumTerm f r

docstring: Eventually the logarithm of the maximum Taylor term is positive.
name: Complex.eventually_pos_log_wimanMaximumTerm
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∀ᶠ (r : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < Real.log (Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r)
statement:
theorem eventually_pos_log_wimanMaximumTerm
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop, 0 < Real.log (wimanMaximumTerm f r)

docstring:
The logarithmic Taylor majorant eventually has all regularity and growth properties needed
for the two power-growth arguments.
name: Complex.eventually_wimanGrowth_regular
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∃ x₀, (∀ (x : ℝ), x₀ ≤ x → 0 < Complex.wimanGrowth f x) ∧ MonotoneOn (Complex.wimanGrowth f) (Set.Ici x₀) ∧ MonotoneOn (deriv (Complex.wimanGrowth f)) (Set.Ici x₀) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 2 (Complex.wimanGrowth f) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (deriv (Complex.wimanGrowth f)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
statement:
theorem eventually_wimanGrowth_regular
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) :
    ∃ x₀ : ℝ,
      (∀ x, x₀ ≤ x → 0 < wimanGrowth f x) ∧
      MonotoneOn (wimanGrowth f) (Set.Ici x₀) ∧
      MonotoneOn (deriv (wimanGrowth f)) (Set.Ici x₀) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (wimanGrowth f) ∧
      Tendsto (deriv (wimanGrowth f)) atTop atTop

docstring:
The two power-growth bad sets have finite measure, and off their union the second derivative
is controlled by the composed exponent `(9 / 8) ^ 2 = 81 / 64`.
name: Complex.exists_finite_wimanExceptionalSet
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∃ x₀, MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume (Complex.wimanExceptionalSet f x₀) < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ), x₀ ≤ x → x ∉ Complex.wimanExceptionalSet f x₀ → iteratedDeriv 2 (Complex.wimanGrowth f) x ≤ Complex.wimanGrowth f x ^ (81 / 64)
statement:
theorem exists_finite_wimanExceptionalSet
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) :
    ∃ x₀ : ℝ,
      volume (wimanExceptionalSet f x₀) < ∞ ∧
      ∀ x, x₀ ≤ x → x ∉ wimanExceptionalSet f x₀ →
        iteratedDeriv 2 (wimanGrowth f) x ≤
          wimanGrowth f x ^ (81 / 64 : ℝ)

docstring:
The supremum defining the maximum modulus is attained on every
nonnegatively-sized circle.
name: Complex.exists_mem_sphere_eq_wimanMaximumModulus
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → ∃ z ∈ Metric.sphere 0 r, Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r = ‖f z‖ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 r, ‖f w‖ ≤ ‖f z‖
statement:
theorem exists_mem_sphere_eq_wimanMaximumModulus
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ∃ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      wimanMaximumModulus f r = ‖f z‖ ∧
      ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ‖f w‖ ≤ ‖f z‖

docstring: A summable nonnegative Taylor-term sequence realizes its supremum.
name: Complex.exists_wimanTerm_eq_wimanMaximumTerm
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (r : ℝ), ∃ n, Complex.wimanTerm f r n = Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r

theorem exists_wimanTerm_eq_wimanMaximumTerm

    (r : ℝ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, wimanTerm f r n = wimanMaximumTerm f r

docstring:
For a transcendental entire function, Wiman radii with exponent `2 / 3`
occur arbitrarily far out. This is a strict corollary of, not the full theorem
stated in, Filevych (2003).
name: Complex.exists_wiman_radius_two_thirds
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∀ (R : ℝ), ∃ r, R < r ∧ Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r ≤ Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r * Real.log (Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r) ^ (2 / 3)
statement:
theorem exists_wiman_radius_two_thirds
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) (R : ℝ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, R < r ∧ wimanMaximumModulus f r ≤
        wimanMaximumTerm f r *
          Real.log (wimanMaximumTerm f r) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)

name: Complex.hasDerivAt_ein

docstring:

docstring: Bottom-minus-top of `1/s`: `2i·Δarctan` (log parts cancel).
name: Complex.horiz_diff_one_div
signature: ∀ {a b T : ℝ}, T ≠ 0 → a ≤ b → (∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + -↑T * Complex.I)) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, 1 / (↑x + ↑T * Complex.I) = 2 * Complex.I * (↑(Real.arctan (b / T)) - ↑(Real.arctan (a / T)))
statement:
theorem horiz_diff_one_div {a b T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + -T * Complex.I))
      - (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, (1 : ℂ) / (x + T * Complex.I))
      = 2 * Complex.I * (arctan (b / T) - arctan (a / T))

docstring:
Bound the explicit quadratic integral remainder by the first neglected term
times the outer-sector cosecant factor.
name: Complex.integral_remainder_bound
signature: ∀ (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0), Real.pi / 2 ≤ |z.arg| → |z.arg| < Real.pi → ‖Complex.exp (-z) / z ^ 2 * ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, ↑(Real.exp (-t)) * ↑t ^ 2 / (↑t + z)‖ ≤ (Real.sin |z.arg|)⁻¹ * ‖Complex.e1AsymptoticTerm 2 z hz‖
statement:
theorem integral_remainder_bound
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hargLower : Real.pi / 2 ≤ |z.arg|)

    ‖Complex.exp (-z) / z^2 *

          (Real.exp (-t) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ)^2 / ((t : ℂ) + z)‖
      ≤ (Real.sin |z.arg|)⁻¹ * ‖e1AsymptoticTerm 2 z hz‖

theorem two_term_integral_remainder
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (harg : |z.arg| < Real.pi) :
    e1AsymptoticRemainder 2 z hz =
      Complex.exp (-z) / z^2 *
        ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0,
          (Real.exp (-t) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ)^2 / ((t : ℂ) + z)

docstring:
The finite geometric expansion of the kernel in the DLMF integral
representation, specialized through the quadratic remainder.
name: Complex.two_term_kernel_identity
statement:
lemma two_term_kernel_identity (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (htz : (t : ℂ) + z ≠ 0) :
    1 / ((t : ℂ) + z) =
      1 / z - (t : ℂ) / z ^ 2 + (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / (z ^ 2 * ((t : ℂ) + z))

docstring: Vertical side integral of `1/s`: `2 * arctan (T / c)`.
name: Complex.vertical_side_one_div
signature: ∀ {c T : ℝ}, c ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ T → ∫ (y : ℝ) in -T..T, 1 / (↑c + ↑y * Complex.I) = 2 * ↑(Real.arctan (T / c))
statement:
theorem vertical_side_one_div {c T : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T, (1 : ℂ) / (c + y * Complex.I) = 2 * arctan (T / c)

docstring: The atomic measure whose mass at `n` is the norm of the `n`th Taylor coefficient.
name: Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → MeasureTheory.Measure ℕ
statement: def wimanCoefficientMeasure (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Measure ℕ

docstring: A nonzero Taylor coefficient gives nonzero mass to the coefficient measure.
name: Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure_ne_zero
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), (∃ n, Complex.wimanTaylorCoefficient f n ≠ 0) → Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure f ≠ 0
statement:
theorem wimanCoefficientMeasure_ne_zero
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hne : ∃ n, wimanTaylorCoefficient f n ≠ 0) :
    wimanCoefficientMeasure f ≠ 0

docstring: The mass of a singleton under the coefficient measure is its coefficient norm.
name: Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure_singleton
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ), (Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure f) {n} = ENNReal.ofReal ‖Complex.wimanTaylorCoefficient f n‖
statement:
theorem wimanCoefficientMeasure_singleton (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanCoefficientMeasure f {n} = ENNReal.ofReal ‖wimanTaylorCoefficient f n‖

docstring: The union of the power-growth bad sets for the logarithmic majorant and its derivative.
name: Complex.wimanExceptionalSet
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → Set ℝ
statement: def wimanExceptionalSet (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : ℝ) : Set ℝ

docstring: The logarithm of the radial Taylor majorant at logarithmic radius `x`.
name: Complex.wimanGrowth
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ
statement: def wimanGrowth (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

docstring:
The positive radial majorant formed from the norms of the Taylor coefficients at radius
`|r|`.
name: Complex.wimanMajorant
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ
statement: def wimanMajorant (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ

docstring:
Outside a finite exceptional set, the radial majorant is controlled by the maximum term and
the specialized power of the logarithmic majorant.
name: Complex.wimanMajorant_bound_off_exceptionalSet
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → Complex.IsTranscendental f → ∃ C x₀, 0 < C ∧ MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume (Complex.wimanExceptionalSet f x₀) < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ), x₀ ≤ x → x ∉ Complex.wimanExceptionalSet f x₀ → Complex.wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x) ≤ C * Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f (Real.exp x) * (1 + Complex.wimanGrowth f x ^ (81 / 128))
statement:
theorem wimanMajorant_bound_off_exceptionalSet
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (htrans : IsTranscendental f) :
    ∃ C x₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      volume (wimanExceptionalSet f x₀) < ∞ ∧
      ∀ x, x₀ ≤ x → x ∉ wimanExceptionalSet f x₀ →
        wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x) ≤
          C * wimanMaximumTerm f (Real.exp x) *
            (1 + wimanGrowth f x ^ (81 / 128 : ℝ))

docstring: The corrected Rosenbloom concentration estimate, including the mandatory additive term.
name: Complex.wimanMajorant_le_eight_mul_maximumTerm
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (x : ℝ), Complex.wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x) ≤ 8 * Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f (Real.exp x) * (1 + √(iteratedDeriv 2 (Complex.wimanGrowth f) x))
statement:
theorem wimanMajorant_le_eight_mul_maximumTerm
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (x : ℝ) :
    wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x) ≤
      8 * wimanMaximumTerm f (Real.exp x) *
        (1 + Real.sqrt (iteratedDeriv 2 (wimanGrowth f) x))

docstring: The normalized radial majorant is nonnegative.
name: Complex.wimanMajorant_nonneg
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ Complex.wimanMajorant f r
statement:
theorem wimanMajorant_nonneg (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ wimanMajorant f r

docstring: The maximum modulus on the circle of radius `|r|`.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumModulus
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ
statement: def wimanMaximumModulus (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ

docstring: Re-normalizing the radius does not change the maximum modulus.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumModulus_abs
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ), Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f |r| = Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumModulus_abs (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    wimanMaximumModulus f |r| = wimanMaximumModulus f r

docstring: The maximum modulus on a circle is bounded by the positive radial Taylor majorant.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumModulus_le_wimanMajorant
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r ≤ Complex.wimanMajorant f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumModulus_le_wimanMajorant
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    wimanMaximumModulus f r ≤ wimanMajorant f r

docstring: Negating a radius does not change the maximum modulus.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumModulus_neg
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ), Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f (-r) = Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumModulus_neg (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    wimanMaximumModulus f (-r) = wimanMaximumModulus f r

docstring: The maximum term, initially expressed as a supremum over all indices.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumTerm
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ
statement: def wimanMaximumTerm (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ

docstring: Re-normalizing the radius does not change the maximum Taylor term.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumTerm_abs
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ), Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f |r| = Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumTerm_abs (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    wimanMaximumTerm f |r| = wimanMaximumTerm f r

docstring: The maximum term is below a bound exactly when every Taylor term is.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumTerm_le_iff
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (r a : ℝ), Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r ≤ a ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), Complex.wimanTerm f r n ≤ a
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumTerm_le_iff
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (r a : ℝ) :
    wimanMaximumTerm f r ≤ a ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, wimanTerm f r n ≤ a

docstring:
The maximum Taylor term is bounded by the maximum modulus on every
positive-radius circle.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumTerm_le_wimanMaximumModulus
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r ≤ Complex.wimanMaximumModulus f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumTerm_le_wimanMaximumModulus
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    wimanMaximumTerm f r ≤ wimanMaximumModulus f r

docstring: Negating a radius does not change the maximum Taylor term.
name: Complex.wimanMaximumTerm_neg
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ), Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f (-r) = Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r
statement:
theorem wimanMaximumTerm_neg (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    wimanMaximumTerm f (-r) = wimanMaximumTerm f r

docstring: The Taylor coefficient of an entire function at the origin.
name: Complex.wimanTaylorCoefficient
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℕ → ℂ
statement: def wimanTaylorCoefficient (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

docstring:
The modulus of the `n`th Taylor term at radius `|r|`.

Normalizing at the definition boundary makes negative inputs denote the same radius as their
absolute values, so this quantity is always nonnegative.
name: Complex.wimanTerm
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ
statement: def wimanTerm (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

docstring: Re-normalizing a Wiman term's radius does not change it.
name: Complex.wimanTerm_abs
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Complex.wimanTerm f |r| n = Complex.wimanTerm f r n
statement:
theorem wimanTerm_abs (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanTerm f |r| n = wimanTerm f r n

docstring: Each Taylor term is bounded by the radial majorant.
name: Complex.wimanTerm_le_wimanMajorant
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Complex.wimanTerm f r n ≤ Complex.wimanMajorant f r
statement:
theorem wimanTerm_le_wimanMajorant
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanTerm f r n ≤ wimanMajorant f r

docstring: Every Taylor term is bounded by the supremal maximum term.
name: Complex.wimanTerm_le_wimanMaximumTerm
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Complex.wimanTerm f r n ≤ Complex.wimanMaximumTerm f r
statement:
theorem wimanTerm_le_wimanMaximumTerm
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanTerm f r n ≤ wimanMaximumTerm f r

docstring: Negating a radius does not change its Wiman term.
name: Complex.wimanTerm_neg
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Complex.wimanTerm f (-r) n = Complex.wimanTerm f r n
statement:
theorem wimanTerm_neg (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanTerm f (-r) n = wimanTerm f r n

docstring: Every normalized radial Taylor term is nonnegative.
name: Complex.wimanTerm_nonneg
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ Complex.wimanTerm f r n
statement:
theorem wimanTerm_nonneg (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ wimanTerm f r n

docstring: The coefficient measure tilted at logarithmic radius `x`.
name: Complex.wimanTiltedMeasure
signature: (ℂ → ℂ) → ℝ → MeasureTheory.Measure ℕ
statement: def wimanTiltedMeasure (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : Measure ℕ

docstring: The tilted measure has the atomic mass representation of normalized Taylor terms.
name: Complex.wimanTiltedMeasure_eq_sum
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (x : ℝ), Complex.wimanTiltedMeasure f x = MeasureTheory.Measure.sum fun n ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Complex.wimanTerm f (Real.exp x) n / Complex.wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x)) • MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac n
statement:
theorem wimanTiltedMeasure_eq_sum
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (x : ℝ) :
    wimanTiltedMeasure f x =
      Measure.sum fun n : ℕ =>
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (wimanTerm f (Real.exp x) n / wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x)) •
            Measure.dirac n

docstring: The tilted singleton masses are the Taylor terms normalized by the majorant.
name: Complex.wimanTiltedMeasure_singleton
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), (Complex.wimanTiltedMeasure f x) {n} = ENNReal.ofReal (Complex.wimanTerm f (Real.exp x) n / Complex.wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x))
statement:
theorem wimanTiltedMeasure_singleton
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    wimanTiltedMeasure f x {n} =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (wimanTerm f (Real.exp x) n / wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x))

docstring: The coefficient-measure cumulant-generating function is the logarithmic majorant.
name: Complex.wiman_cgf_eq_growth
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (x : ℝ), ProbabilityTheory.cgf (fun n ↦ ↑n) (Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure f) x = Complex.wimanGrowth f x
statement:
theorem wiman_cgf_eq_growth
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (x : ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.cgf (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ))
        (wimanCoefficientMeasure f) x = wimanGrowth f x

docstring: The MGF of the coefficient measure is the radial Taylor majorant.
name: Complex.wiman_mgf_eq_majorant
signature: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (x : ℝ), ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun n ↦ ↑n) (Complex.wimanCoefficientMeasure f) x = Complex.wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x)
statement:
theorem wiman_mgf_eq_majorant
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (x : ℝ) :
    mgf (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (wimanCoefficientMeasure f) x =
      wimanMajorant f (Real.exp x)

docstring:
A `C¹` map between finite-dimensional real normed spaces has level sets that are locally
graphs at points where its derivative is surjective.
name: ContDiff.exists_localGraph_of_surjective_fderiv
signature: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup G] [inst_4 : NormedSpace ℝ G] [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_7 : NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F], Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ G + Module.finrank ℝ F → ∀ (f : E → F), ContDiff ℝ 1 f → ∀ (x₀ : E), Function.Surjective ⇑(fderiv ℝ f x₀) → ∃ e U, ∃ (_ : U ∈ nhds (e x₀).1), ∃ g, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U ∧ ∃ V ∈ nhds x₀, V ∩ f ⁻¹' {f x₀} = V ∩ ⇑e ⁻¹' {p | p.1 ∈ U ∧ p.2 = g p.1}
statement:
theorem _root_.ContDiff.exists_localGraph_of_surjective_fderiv
    {E G F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [FiniteDimensional ℝ G]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ G + Module.finrank ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (x₀ : E)
    (hreg : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ f x₀)) :
    ∃ (e : E ≃L[ℝ] G × F)
      (U : Set G) (_ : U ∈ 𝓝 (e x₀).1) (g : G → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U ∧ ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x₀, V ∩ f ⁻¹' {f x₀} =
        V ∩ e ⁻¹' {p : G × F | p.1 ∈ U ∧ p.2 = g p.1}

docstring: The graph of a `C^n` map between real normed spaces is a `C^n` immersion.
name: ContDiff.isImmersion_graph
signature: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {h : E → F}, ContDiff ℝ n h → Manifold.IsImmersion (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (E × F)) n fun x ↦ (x, h x)
statement:
theorem _root_.ContDiff.isImmersion_graph
    {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {n : ℕ∞ω} {h : E → F} (hh : ContDiff ℝ n h) :
    IsImmersion 𝓘(ℝ, E) 𝓘(ℝ, E × F) n (fun x => (x, h x))

docstring:
The variation of a `C¹` curve on `[a, b]` is the integral of the norm of its derivative
within `[a, b]`.
name: ContDiffOn.eVariationOn_Icc_eq_ofReal_integral_norm_derivWithin
signature: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {γ : ℝ → E} {a b : ℝ}, a ≤ b → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Set.Icc a b) → eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, ‖derivWithin γ (Set.Icc a b) t‖)
statement:
theorem _root_.ContDiffOn.eVariationOn_Icc_eq_ofReal_integral_norm_derivWithin
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {γ : ℝ → E} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Icc a b)) :
    eVariationOn γ (Icc a b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in a..b, ‖derivWithin γ (Icc a b) t‖)

docstring:
Local normal convergence of the function series `f` on `S`: every `x ∈ S`
has a neighbourhood whose intersection with `S` carries normal convergence.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn
signature: {X : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] → [TopologicalSpace X] → (ℕ → X → E) → Set X → Prop
statement: def ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn (f : ℕ → X → E) (S : Set X) : Prop

docstring: The derivative series of a locally normally convergent holomorphic series is locally normal.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.deriv
signature: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℕ → ℂ → E} {S : Set ℂ}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → IsOpen S → (∀ (n : ℕ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (f n) S) → ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn (fun n z ↦ deriv (f n) z) S
statement:
theorem ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.deriv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f : ℕ → ℂ → E} {S : Set ℂ}
    (hf : ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S)
    (hS : IsOpen S) (holo : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f n) S) :
    ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn (fun n z => _root_.deriv (f n) z) S

docstring:
Projection from local normal convergence at a point: at any `x ∈ S`,
some neighbourhood intersected with `S` carries normal convergence.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.exists_nhds_inter
signature: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ℕ → X → E} {S : Set X} {x : X}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → x ∈ S → ∃ U ∈ nhds x, ConvergesNormallyOn f (U ∩ S)

docstring: A locally normally convergent holomorphic series may be differentiated termwise.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.hasDerivAt_tsum
signature: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℕ → ℂ → E} {S : Set ℂ} {z : ℂ}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → IsOpen S → (∀ (n : ℕ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (f n) S) → z ∈ S → HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ ∑' (n : ℕ), f n w) (∑' (n : ℕ), deriv (f n) z) z
statement:
theorem ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.hasDerivAt_tsum
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : Nat → Complex → E} {S : Set Complex} {z : Complex}
    (hf : ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S)
    (hS : IsOpen S) (holo : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn Complex (f n) S)
    (hz : z ∈ S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => ∑' n, f n w) (∑' n, _root_.deriv (f n) z) z

docstring: Local normal convergence persists when the domain shrinks.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.mono
signature: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ℕ → X → E} {S T : Set X}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → T ⊆ S → ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f T

docstring: Local normal convergence implies pointwise absolute convergence on the domain.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.summable_norm
signature: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ℕ → X → E} {S : Set X}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → ∀ {x : X}, x ∈ S → Summable fun n ↦ ‖f n x‖
statement:
theorem ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.summable_norm
    {X E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    {f : Nat → X → E} {S : Set X} (hf : ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ S) : Summable (fun n => norm (f n x))

docstring: A locally normally convergent series converges locally uniformly to its pointwise sum.
name: ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_tsum_nat
signature: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℕ → X → E} {S : Set X}, ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun N x ↦ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n x) (fun x ↦ ∑' (n : ℕ), f n x) Filter.atTop S
statement:
theorem ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_tsum_nat
    {X E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : Nat → X → E} {S : Set X} (hf : ConvergesLocallyNormallyOn f S) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun N x => Finset.sum (Finset.range N) fun n => f n x)
      (fun x => ∑' n, f n x) atTop S

docstring:
Normal convergence of the function series `f` on `S`: the sup-norm series
is finite in `ℝ≥0∞`.
name: ConvergesNormallyOn
signature: {X : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] → (ℕ → X → E) → Set X → Prop
statement: def ConvergesNormallyOn (f : ℕ → X → E) (S : Set X) : Prop

docstring: Normal convergence persists when the domain shrinks.
name: ConvergesNormallyOn.mono
signature: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ℕ → X → E} {S T : Set X}, ConvergesNormallyOn f S → T ⊆ S → ConvergesNormallyOn f T
statement:

theorem_wanted directionalExternalIlluminationNumbersEqual (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (hK : IsConvexBody K) :

noncomputable def directionalIlluminationNumber {n : ℕ}

docstring:
Finite illumination and actual interior-translate covering counts agree.

name: ConvexCovering.directionalInteriorFormulationsEquivalent
signature: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), ConvexCovering.IsConvexBody K → ∀ (q : ℕ), ConvexCovering.IlluminatedByDirections K q ↔ ConvexCovering.CoveredByInteriorTranslates K q

    (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (p x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :

docstring:
The at-most homothet formulation and fixed-count interior formulation agree.
Source: Bezdek and Khan, arXiv:1602.06040v2, introduction; Arman, Kaire and Prymak,
arXiv:2510.25968v3, introduction. The left side is the explicit closed formulation,
not an assumed OpenConjectures declaration.
name: ConvexCovering.homothetInteriorTranslateFormulationsEquivalent
signature: (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), ConvexCovering.IsConvexBody K → ∃ q ≤ 2 ^ n, ConvexCovering.CoveredBySmallerPositiveHomothets K q) ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ConvexCovering.UniformInteriorTranslateBound n (2 ^ n)

theorem_wanted homothetInteriorTranslateFormulationsEquivalent :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), IsConvexBody K →
      ∃ q : ℕ, q ≤ 2 ^ n ∧ CoveredBySmallerPositiveHomothets K q) ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → UniformInteriorTranslateBound n (2 ^ n)

statement: def ArtinGroup

docstring:
The defining braid relation holds among the generators: for distinct `i j` with `M i j ≠ ∞`,
the two length-`M i j` alternating words in `of M i` and `of M j` agree.
name: CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.braid_relation
signature: ∀ {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) {i j : B}, i ≠ j → M.M i j ≠ 0 → CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord (CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of M i) (CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of M j) (M.M i j) = CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord (CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of M j) (CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of M i) (M.M i j)
statement:
theorem braid_relation {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : M i j ≠ 0) :
    alternatingWord (of M i) (of M j) (M i j) = alternatingWord (of M j) (of M i) (M i j)

docstring: The generators generate the whole Artin group.
name: CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.closure_range_of
signature: ∀ {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B), Subgroup.closure (Set.range (CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of M)) = ⊤
statement: theorem closure_range_of : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (of M)) = ⊤

docstring: The generator `s i` of the Artin group of `M`.
name: CoxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup.of
signature: {B : Type u_1} → (M : CoxeterMatrix B) → B → M.ArtinGroup
statement: def of (i : B) : M.ArtinGroup

docstring: The alternating product `a * b * a * b * ⋯` of length `n` in a monoid, starting with `a`.
name: CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord
signature: {G : Type u_2} → [Monoid G] → G → G → ℕ → G
statement: def alternatingWord {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (a b : G) : ℕ → G

name: CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord_succ
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_2} [inst : Monoid G] (a b : G) (n : ℕ), CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord a b (n + 1) = a * CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord b a n
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_succ {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (a b : G) (n : ℕ) :
    alternatingWord a b (n + 1) = a * alternatingWord b a n

name: CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord_zero
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_2} [inst : Monoid G] (a b : G), CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord a b 0 = 1
statement: theorem alternatingWord_zero {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (a b : G) : alternatingWord a b 0 = 1

docstring:
The Artin (braid) relation for the ordered pair `(i, j)`: the two alternating words of length
`M i j` in the generators `i` and `j` agree. It is encoded in the free group as
`⟨s i · s j · ⋯⟩ · ⟨s j · s i · ⋯⟩⁻¹`, which lies in the relation set exactly when both words are
declared equal.
name: CoxeterMatrix.artinRelation
signature: {B : Type u_1} → CoxeterMatrix B → B → B → FreeGroup B
statement: def artinRelation (i j : B) : FreeGroup B

docstring:
The set of Artin relations of `M`: one braid relation for each ordered pair of distinct
generators whose off-diagonal entry is finite (`M i j ≠ 0`, i.e. `m i j ≠ ∞`). Pairs with
`M i j = ∞` contribute no relation.
name: CoxeterMatrix.artinRelationsSet
signature: {B : Type u_1} → CoxeterMatrix B → Set (FreeGroup B)
statement: def artinRelationsSet : Set (FreeGroup B)

name: CoxeterMatrix.instGroupArtinGroup
signature: {B : Type u_1} → (M : CoxeterMatrix B) → Group M.ArtinGroup
statement: instance : Group M.ArtinGroup

docstring: A monoid homomorphism carries an alternating word to the alternating word of the images.
name: CoxeterMatrix.map_alternatingWord
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_2} {H : Type u_3} [inst : Monoid G] [inst_1 : Monoid H] (f : G →* H) (a b : G) (n : ℕ), f (CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord a b n) = CoxeterMatrix.alternatingWord (f a) (f b) n
statement:
theorem map_alternatingWord {G H : Type*} [Monoid G] [Monoid H] (f : G →* H) (a b : G) (n : ℕ) :
    f (alternatingWord a b n) = alternatingWord (f a) (f b) n

docstring: A finite directed graph on `Fin n` given by its Boolean adjacency predicate.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix
signature: ℕ → Type
statement: structure AdjacencyMatrix (n : Nat)

docstring: Add the single directed edge from `i` to `j`; all other entries are kept.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.addEdge
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n → Fin n → Fin n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n
statement: def addEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) : AdjacencyMatrix n

docstring: The graph with no edges.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.empty
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n
statement: def empty {n : Nat} : AdjacencyMatrix n

docstring: Remove the single directed edge from `i` to `j`; all other entries are kept.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.eraseEdge
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n → Fin n → Fin n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n
statement: def eraseEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) : AdjacencyMatrix n

docstring: Two adjacency matrices with the same edges everywhere are equal.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.ext
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} {m m' : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n}, (∀ (i j : Fin n), m.hasEdge i j = m'.hasEdge i j) → m = m'
statement:
theorem ext {n : Nat} {m m' : AdjacencyMatrix n}
    (h : ∀ i j, m.hasEdge i j = m'.hasEdge i j) : m = m'

docstring: Whether there is a directed edge from `i` to `j`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n → Fin n → Fin n → Bool
statement: def hasEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) : Bool

docstring: The added edge is present after insertion.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_addEdge
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n), (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge i j = Bool.true
statement:
theorem hasEdge_addEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge i j = true

docstring: Insertion adds the new edge to the old edge set and nothing else.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_addEdge_iff
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n), (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge a b = Bool.true ↔ a = i ∧ b = j ∨ m.hasEdge a b = Bool.true
statement:
theorem hasEdge_addEdge_iff {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n) :
    (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge a b = true ↔
      (a = i ∧ b = j) ∨ m.hasEdge a b = true

docstring: Insertion does not change any other ordered pair.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_addEdge_of_ne
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n), a ≠ i ∨ b ≠ j → (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge a b = m.hasEdge a b
statement:
theorem hasEdge_addEdge_of_ne {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n)
    (h : a ≠ i ∨ b ≠ j) :
    (m.addEdge i j).hasEdge a b = m.hasEdge a b

docstring: The empty graph has no edges.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_empty
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.empty.hasEdge i j = Bool.false
statement:
theorem hasEdge_empty {n : Nat} (i j : Fin n) :
    (empty : AdjacencyMatrix n).hasEdge i j = false

docstring: The erased edge is absent after deletion.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_eraseEdge
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n), (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge i j = Bool.false
statement:
theorem hasEdge_eraseEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge i j = false

docstring: Deletion removes the edge from the old edge set and nothing else.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_eraseEdge_iff
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n), (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge a b = Bool.true ↔ ¬(a = i ∧ b = j) ∧ m.hasEdge a b = Bool.true
statement:
theorem hasEdge_eraseEdge_iff {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n) :
    (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge a b = true ↔
      ¬(a = i ∧ b = j) ∧ m.hasEdge a b = true

docstring: Deletion does not change any other ordered pair.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.hasEdge_eraseEdge_of_ne
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n), a ≠ i ∨ b ≠ j → (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge a b = m.hasEdge a b
statement:
theorem hasEdge_eraseEdge_of_ne {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j a b : Fin n)
    (h : a ≠ i ∨ b ≠ j) :
    (m.eraseEdge i j).hasEdge a b = m.hasEdge a b

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.instInhabited
signature: {n : ℕ} → Inhabited (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n)
statement: instance {n : Nat} : Inhabited (AdjacencyMatrix n)

docstring: Membership in the neighbor list is the edge query.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.mem_neighbors
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n), j ∈ m.neighbors i ↔ m.hasEdge i j = Bool.true
statement:
theorem mem_neighbors {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) :
    j ∈ m.neighbors i ↔ m.hasEdge i j = true

docstring: After insertion, the target vertex is a neighbor of the source.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.mem_neighbors_addEdge
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n), j ∈ (m.addEdge i j).neighbors i
statement:
theorem mem_neighbors_addEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) :
    j ∈ (m.addEdge i j).neighbors i

docstring: The neighbor list after insertion, characterized by membership.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.mem_neighbors_addEdge_iff
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j b : Fin n), b ∈ (m.addEdge i j).neighbors i ↔ b = j ∨ b ∈ m.neighbors i
statement:
theorem mem_neighbors_addEdge_iff {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n)
    (i j b : Fin n) :
    b ∈ (m.addEdge i j).neighbors i ↔ b = j ∨ b ∈ m.neighbors i

docstring: The out-neighbors of `i`, as a list of vertices in increasing order.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.neighbors
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n → Fin n → List (Fin n)
statement: def neighbors {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n) : List (Fin n)

docstring: Every vertex of the empty graph has an empty neighbor list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.neighbors_empty
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.empty.neighbors i = []
statement:
theorem neighbors_empty {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    (empty : AdjacencyMatrix n).neighbors i = []

docstring: The neighbor list has no duplicate vertices.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.neighbors_nodup
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n), (m.neighbors i).Nodup
statement:
theorem neighbors_nodup {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n) :
    (m.neighbors i).Nodup

docstring:
The neighbor list is in strictly increasing order, as documented for
`neighbors`: earlier neighbors are smaller than later ones.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.neighbors_pairwise_lt
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n), List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 < x2) (m.neighbors i)
statement:
theorem neighbors_pairwise_lt {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n) :
    List.Pairwise (· < ·) (m.neighbors i)

docstring: After deletion, the target vertex is no longer a neighbor of the source.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.not_mem_neighbors_eraseEdge
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (m : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n), j ∉ (m.eraseEdge i j).neighbors i
statement:
theorem not_mem_neighbors_eraseEdge {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i j : Fin n) :
    j ∉ (m.eraseEdge i j).neighbors i

docstring: The out-degree of a vertex: the number of its out-neighbors.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.outDegree
signature: {n : ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix n → Fin n → ℕ
statement: def outDegree {n : Nat} (m : AdjacencyMatrix n) (i : Fin n) : Nat

docstring: Every vertex of the empty graph has out-degree zero.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.outDegree_empty
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AdjacencyMatrix.empty.outDegree i = 0
statement:
theorem outDegree_empty {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    (empty : AdjacencyMatrix n).outDegree i = 0

docstring:
`All p tree` states that every key in `tree` satisfies `p`; it is
`BinarySearchTree.All` of the cache-erased tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.All
signature: {α : Type u} → (α → Prop) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def All (p : α → Prop) (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring:
The AVL balance invariant: at every node, the heights of the two subtrees
differ by at most one, so the balance factor lies in `{-1, 0, 1}`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Balanced : Tree α → Prop

docstring: Cached heights agree with the defining recursion at every node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def CacheCorrect : Tree α → Prop

docstring:
Structural membership, inherited from `BinarySearchTree` through
`toBinaryTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Mem
signature: {α : Type u} → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Mem (x : α) (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring:
Every left key is smaller and every right key is larger, recursively; it is
`BinarySearchTree.Ordered` of the cache-erased tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Ordered
signature: {α : Type u} → [LT α] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Ordered [LT α] (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring: A binary tree with a cached height stored at each node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: public inductive Tree (α : Type u)

docstring:
`All` is equivalent to universal quantification over structural
membership; inherited from `BinarySearchTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.all_iff_forall_mem
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.All p tree ↔ ∀ x ∈ tree, p x
statement:
public theorem all_iff_forall_mem {p : α → Prop} {tree : Tree α} :
    All p tree ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ tree → p x

docstring: Every remaining key of an ordered tree is larger than the removed minimum.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.all_minD_lt_eraseMin_of_ordered
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {default : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.All (fun x ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.minD default tree < x) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.eraseMin tree)
statement:
public theorem all_minD_lt_eraseMin_of_ordered [LinearOrder α] {default : α} {tree : Tree α}
    (hTree : Ordered tree) : All (minD default tree < ·) (eraseMin tree)

docstring:
`All` on an AVL tree is `BinarySearchTree.All` of its cache-erased tree,
by definition.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.all_toBinaryTree
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.All p tree ↔ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.All p (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.toBinaryTree tree)
statement:
public theorem all_toBinaryTree {p : α → Prop} {tree : Tree α} :
    All p tree ↔ BinarySearchTree.All p (toBinaryTree tree)

docstring:
Rebuild a node from children whose heights differ by at most two, restoring the
balance invariant. When the left child is too tall, a single right rotation is
performed if the left-left grandchild is at least as tall as the left-right one,
and a double left-right rotation otherwise; the right-heavy case is symmetric.
Children that already differ by at most one are rebuilt with `mkNode`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α
statement: public def balance (left : Tree α) (key : α) (right : Tree α) : Tree α

docstring:
If the two sides are already height-balanced against each other,
`balance` is just `mkNode` (no rotation).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance_eq_mkNode_of_le
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key : α} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right + 1 → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left + 1 → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance left key right = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode left key right

docstring:
Left-heavy with a right-heavy left child: `balance` performs the
left-right double rotation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance_left_double
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key leftKey leftRightKey : α} {cached cachedRight : ℕ} {leftLeft leftRightLeft leftRightRight right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right + 1 < cached → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height leftLeft < cachedRight → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cached leftLeft leftKey (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cachedRight leftRightLeft leftRightKey leftRightRight)) key right = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode leftLeft leftKey leftRightLeft) leftRightKey (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode leftRightRight key right)

docstring:
Left-heavy with a left-heavy (or even) left child: `balance` performs
the single right rotation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance_left_single
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key leftKey : α} {cached : ℕ} {leftLeft leftRight right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right + 1 < cached → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height leftRight ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height leftLeft → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cached leftLeft leftKey leftRight) key right = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode leftLeft leftKey (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode leftRight key right)

docstring:
Right-heavy with a left-heavy right child: `balance` performs the
right-left double rotation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance_right_double
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key rightKey rightLeftKey : α} {cached cachedLeft : ℕ} {left rightLeftLeft rightLeftRight rightRight : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left + 1 < cached → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height rightRight < cachedLeft → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance left key (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cached (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cachedLeft rightLeftLeft rightLeftKey rightLeftRight) rightKey rightRight) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode left key rightLeftLeft) rightLeftKey (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode rightLeftRight rightKey rightRight)

docstring:
Right-heavy with a right-heavy (or even) right child: `balance`
performs the single left rotation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance_right_single
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key rightKey : α} {cached : ℕ} {left rightLeft rightRight : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left + 1 < cached → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height rightLeft ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height rightRight → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance left key (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree.node cached rightLeft rightKey rightRight) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.mkNode left key rightLeft) rightKey rightRight

docstring:
Rebalancing children whose heights differ by at most two produces a
balanced tree. This is the precondition that one insertion step maintains.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balanced_balance
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {key : α} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect left → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect right → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced left → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced right → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right + 2 → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height right ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.height left + 2 → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balance left key right)
statement:
public theorem balanced_balance {key : α} {left right : Tree α}
    (hCacheLeft : CacheCorrect left) (hCacheRight : CacheCorrect right)
    (hBalLeft : Balanced left) (hBalRight : Balanced right)
    (hDiffLeft : height left ≤ height right + 2)
    (hDiffRight : height right ≤ height left + 2) :
    Balanced (balance left key right)

docstring: Deletion, under the name `delete`, preserves the balance invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balanced_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.delete x tree)

docstring: `deleteMin` preserves the AVL balance invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balanced_deleteMin
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.deleteMin tree)

docstring: Deletion preserves the AVL balance invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.balanced_erase
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.CacheCorrect tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.AvlTree.erase x tree)

    (flatten tree).Nodup

docstring:
The separator bounds of an ordered node, in index-free form. If the key list is
`keys₁ ++ key :: keys₂` and the child list splits as `children₁ ++ children₂` with
`children₁` holding one more child than `keys₁` has keys (so the last child of `children₁`
is the subtree immediately left of `key` and the first child of `children₂` the one
immediately right of it), then every key stored on the left is below `key` and every key
stored on the right is above `key`. In particular, every key in the `i`-th child lies
strictly between the `(i-1)`-st and `i`-th separators.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.Ordered.separator_bounds
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LT α] {keys₁ keys₂ : List α} {children₁ children₂ : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree α)} {key : α}, children₁.length = keys₁.length + 1 → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.node (keys₁ ++ key :: keys₂) (children₁ ++ children₂)).Ordered → (∀ x ∈ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.node keys₁ children₁).flatten, x < key) ∧ ∀ x ∈ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.node keys₂ children₂).flatten, key < x

docstring:
The structural invariant of a B-tree of minimum degree `t`, indexed by the minimum key
count `mink` required at the top node and by the height `height`. A leaf has height `0`;
an internal node has height one more than its children, and since every child is required
to have the same height, all leaves of a valid tree sit at the same depth. Every node has
at most `2 * t - 1` keys, the top node has at least `mink` keys, every other node has at
least `t - 1` keys, and an internal node with `k` keys has exactly `k + 1` children.
Non-root trees are used with `mink = t - 1`; the root invariant is `ValidRoot`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.Valid
signature: {α : Type u} → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree α → Prop
statement: public inductive Valid (t : Nat) : Nat → Nat → BTree α → Prop

docstring:
The structural invariant at the root of a B-tree of minimum degree `t` and height
`height`: a root leaf holds at most `2 * t - 1` keys (possibly none, for the empty tree),
and a root internal node holds between `1` and `2 * t - 1` keys, with every child a
non-root valid tree of the same height.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.ValidRoot
signature: {α : Type u} → ℕ → ℕ → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree α → Prop
statement: public inductive ValidRoot (t : Nat) : Nat → BTree α → Prop

sibling's last key moves up as the new separator. Returns the new sibling,

Search a tree by comparing the query key against the separators from the root down:
at each internal node descend into the first child whose following separator exceeds the
query, report success on equality with a separator, and at a leaf report membership in
the key list.

tree minus the deleted key.

docstring:
Delete a key from a tree of the given height, by a top-down pass
(with the two spine traversals in the separator case described in the
module documentation): at a leaf erase the key, and at an internal node
run `delList` with
deletion at the children's height. Heights that do not match the shape of
the tree fall back to leaf erasure or the identity; the specification
`delH_spec` only covers matching heights.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.delH
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → ℕ → ℕ → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree α
statement: def delH [LinearOrder α] : Nat → Nat → α → BTree α → BTree α

docstring:
Delete a key from the node with the given separator and child lists,
where `delChild` deletes from a child (in `delH`, deletion at the next
height down). Before descending into a child with fewer than `t` keys, the
child is given a key by borrowing from an adjacent sibling or is merged
with the separator and a sibling, so `delChild` is only ever applied to a
tree holding at least `t` keys at its root (or to a merged tree). The walk
goes from the left: a child that is not last borrows or merges on its
right, and the last child borrows or merges on its left, where its left
sibling and separator are in hand.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BTree.delList

    (x : α) : List α → List (BTree α) → List α × List (BTree α)

single child. See the module documentation for the algorithm and its

erase the key from the inorder flattening and rebuild with `fromList`.
The primary deletion operation is `delete` in

the CLRS 18.3 algorithm.
