docstring: The saved matrix after all phases is `L0 * W^(n-1)`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP_ret
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (W L0 : Vector (Vector (MinTropical (WithTop ℤ)) n) n), (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ ((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP W L0).ret.get i).get j) = (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (L0.get i).get j) * (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (W.get i).get j) ^ (n - 1)
statement:
public theorem slowAPSP_ret {n : Nat}
    (W L0 : _root_.Vector
      (_root_.Vector (MinTropical (WithTop Int)) n) n) :
    Matrix.of (fun i j => ((slowAPSP W L0).ret.get i).get j) =
      Matrix.of (fun i j => (L0.get i).get j) *
        Matrix.of (fun i j => (W.get i).get j) ^ (n - 1)

docstring:
Exact copy/fill assignment, scalar-addition, and scalar-minimum counts.
The first coordinate excludes the accumulator vector updates in `matrixAccumulate`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP_time
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (W L0 : Vector (Vector (MinTropical (WithTop ℤ)) n) n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP W L0).time = (n ^ 2 + 2 * (n - 1) * n ^ 2, (n - 1) * n ^ 3, (n - 1) * n ^ 3)
statement:
public theorem slowAPSP_time {n : Nat}
    (W L0 : _root_.Vector
      (_root_.Vector (MinTropical (WithTop Int)) n) n) :
    (slowAPSP W L0).time =
      (n ^ 2 + 2 * (n - 1) * n ^ 2,
        ((n - 1) * n ^ 3, (n - 1) * n ^ 3))

docstring: The sum of the three actual executed cost coordinates is `Θ(n^4)`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP_time_isTheta
signature: ∀ (W L0 : (n : ℕ) → Vector (Vector (MinTropical (WithTop ℤ)) n) n), (fun n ↦ ↑(Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.1 + ↑(Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.2.1 + ↑(Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.2.2) =Θ[Filter.atTop] fun n ↦ ↑n ^ 4
statement:
public theorem slowAPSP_time_isTheta
    (W L0 : (n : Nat) →
      _root_.Vector
        (_root_.Vector (MinTropical (WithTop Int)) n) n) :
    Asymptotics.IsTheta Filter.atTop
      (fun n => ((slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.1 +
        (slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.2.1 +
        (slowAPSP (W n) (L0 n)).time.2.2 : ℝ))
      (fun n => (n : ℝ) ^ 4)

docstring:
Execute the seven-call Strassen procedure, adding `A * B` to saved `C`.
The returned pair counts actual scalar multiplications and additions/subtractions.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate
signature: {R : Type u} → [Zero R] → [Add R] → [Sub R] → [Mul R] → (k : ℕ) → Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k) → Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k) → Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM (ℕ × ℕ) (Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k))

docstring:
Every Strassen output entry is its saved `C` entry plus the finite row-column
product sum, with the left factor drawn from `A` and the right factor from `B`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate_apply
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (k : ℕ) (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)) (i j : Fin (2 ^ k)), ((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).ret.get i).get j = (C.get i).get j + ∑ t, (A.get i).get t * (B.get t).get j
statement:
public theorem strassenMatrixAccumulate_apply {R : Type u} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R]
    (k : Nat) (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)) (i j : Fin (2 ^ k)) :
    ((strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).ret.get i).get j =
      (C.get i).get j + ∑ t : Fin (2 ^ k), (A.get i).get t * (B.get t).get j

docstring:
Strassen accumulation returns the saved matrix `C` plus the canonical
Matrix product `A * B`, preserving multiplication operand order.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate_ret
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (k : ℕ) (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)), (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ ((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).ret.get i).get j) = (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (C.get i).get j) + (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A.get i).get j) * Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (B.get i).get j
statement:
public theorem strassenMatrixAccumulate_ret {R : Type u} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R]
    (k : Nat) (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => ((strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).ret.get i).get j) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j => (C.get i).get j) +
        (Matrix.of fun i j => (A.get i).get j) * (Matrix.of fun i j => (B.get i).get j)

docstring:
The actual Strassen accumulator counts its scalar multiplications and
additions/subtractions exactly. This does not charge allocation or bit operations.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate_time
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Zero R] [inst_1 : Add R] [inst_2 : Sub R] [inst_3 : Mul R] (k : ℕ) (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Matrix.strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).time = (7 ^ k, (25 * 7 ^ k - 22 * 4 ^ k) / 3)
statement:

    [Zero R] [Add R] [Sub R] [Mul R] (k : Nat)
    (A B C : Vector (Vector R (2 ^ k)) (2 ^ k)) :
    (strassenMatrixAccumulate k A B C).time =
      (7 ^ k, (25 * 7 ^ k - 22 * 4 ^ k) / 3)

docstring: For a positive exponent, the raw result is the least residue of `a ^ b`.

statement:
theorem modularExponentiation_correct (a b n : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) (hn : 0 < n) :

docstring: The positive even branch squares the result of the source `b / 2` recursion.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularExponentiation.modularExponentiation_even
statement:
theorem modularExponentiation_even (a b n : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) (heven : b % 2 = 0) :
    modularExponentiation a b n =
      let d := modularExponentiation a (b / 2) n
      ⟨(d.ret * d.ret) % n, d.time + 1⟩

docstring: Positive-exponent results lie strictly below a positive modulus.

statement:
theorem modularExponentiation_lt (a b n : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) (hn : 0 < n) :

statement:
theorem modularExponentiation_odd (a b n : Nat) (hodd : b % 2 ≠ 0) :
    modularExponentiation a b n =
      let d := modularExponentiation a (b - 1) n
      ⟨(a * d.ret) % n, d.time + 1⟩

docstring: Raw-result projection of the source positive even branch.

signature:
∀ (a b n : ℕ),

    b % 2 = 0 →

statement:

docstring: The solver returns `gcd a n` residues exactly when the congruence is solvable.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver_length
signature: ∀ (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).ret.size = if ↑(a.gcd n) ∣ b then a.gcd n else 0

      if (Nat.gcd a n : Int) ∣ b then Nat.gcd a n else 0

docstring: Membership characterizes exactly the least nonnegative solutions of the congruence.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver_mem_iff
signature: ∀ (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n) (x : ℕ), x ∈ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).ret.toList ↔ x < n ∧ ↑a * ↑x ≡ b [ZMOD ↑n]
statement:
theorem modularLinearEquationSolver_mem_iff

    x ∈ (modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).ret.toList ↔
      x < n ∧ Int.ModEq (n : Int) ((a : Int) * (x : Int)) b

docstring: The returned list is the CLRS progression built from the canonical extended-GCD coefficient.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver_ret
signature: ∀ (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).ret.toList = if ↑(a.gcd n) ∣ b then List.map (fun i ↦ ((n.gcdB a * (b / ↑(a.gcd n)) % ↑n + ↑i * ↑(n / a.gcd n)) % ↑n).toNat) (List.range (a.gcd n)) else []
statement:
theorem modularLinearEquationSolver_ret
    (a : Nat) (b : Int) (n : Nat) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).ret.toList =
      if (Nat.gcd a n : Int) ∣ b then
        (List.range (Nat.gcd a n)).map (fun (i : Nat) =>
          (((Nat.gcdB n a * (b / (Nat.gcd a n : Int))) % (n : Int) +
            (i : Int) * ((n / Nat.gcd a n : Nat) : Int)) % (n : Int)).toNat)
      else []

docstring: The selected arithmetic-event cost is bounded by the source logarithmic-plus-output bound.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver_time_bounds
signature: ∀ (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n), (1 + if ↑(a.gcd n) ∣ b then 4 + 3 * a.gcd n else 0) ≤ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).time ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.ModularLinearEquation.modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).time ≤ 6 * (2 * n.log2 + 2) + 1 + if ↑(a.gcd n) ∣ b then 4 + 3 * a.gcd n else 0
statement:
theorem modularLinearEquationSolver_time_bounds
    (a : Nat) (b : Int) (n : Nat) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n) :
    1 + (if (Nat.gcd a n : Int) ∣ b then 4 + 3 * Nat.gcd a n else 0)
      ≤ (modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).time ∧
    (modularLinearEquationSolver a b n ha hn).time
      ≤ 6 * (2 * Nat.log2 n + 2) + 1 +
        (if (Nat.gcd a n : Int) ∣ b then 4 + 3 * Nat.gcd a n else 0)

signature: Type u → Type u
statement: public inductive CacheEvent (α : Type u)

docstring: Source-legal transitions, independent of the order representing cache contents.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.cacheLTS

docstring: Scan the real requests and evict the first resident used furthest in the strict future.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture
signature: {α : Type u} → [DecidableEq α] → ℕ → List α → List α → List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent α) × List α
statement:
public def furthestInFuture {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (capacity : Nat) (requests initialCache : List α) : List (CacheEvent α) × List α

docstring: The four source branches, on the actual saved suffix result and valid initial cache.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture_cons
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (capacity : ℕ) (request : α) (future cache : List α), cache.Nodup → cache.length ≤ capacity → (request ∈ cache → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.hit request :: (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future cache).1, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future cache).2)) ∧ (capacity = 0 → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request Option.none :: (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future []).1, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future []).2)) ∧ (request ∉ cache → cache.length < capacity → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request Option.none :: (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache)).1, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache)).2)) ∧ (request ∉ cache → 0 < capacity → cache.length = capacity → ∀ (victim : α), List.argmax (fun block ↦ List.idxOf? block future) cache = Option.some victim → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request (Option.some victim) :: (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache.erase victim)).1, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache.erase victim)).2))
statement:
theorem furthestInFuture_cons {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (capacity : Nat) (request : α) (future cache : List α)
    (hnodup : cache.Nodup) (hcapacity : cache.length ≤ capacity) :
    (request ∈ cache →
      furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache =
        (.hit request :: (furthestInFuture capacity future cache).1,
          (furthestInFuture capacity future cache).2)) ∧
    (capacity = 0 →
      furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache =
        (.miss request none :: (furthestInFuture capacity future []).1,
          (furthestInFuture capacity future []).2)) ∧
    (request ∉ cache → cache.length < capacity →
      furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache =
        (.miss request none :: (furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache)).1,
          (furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache)).2)) ∧
    (request ∉ cache → 0 < capacity → cache.length = capacity →
      ∀ victim, List.argmax (β := WithTop Nat) (fun block => future.idxOf? block) cache =
          some victim →
        furthestInFuture capacity (request :: future) cache =
          (.miss request (some victim) ::
            (furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache.erase victim)).1,
            (furthestInFuture capacity future (request :: cache.erase victim)).2))

docstring:
The emitted events form a source-legal trace for exactly the input requests;
the saved final cache is duplicate-free and within capacity.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture_legal
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (capacity : ℕ) (requests initialCache : List α),
  initialCache.Nodup →
    initialCache.length ≤ capacity →
      have output := Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity requests initialCache;
      (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.cacheLTS capacity).MTr initialCache output.1 output.2 ∧
        List.map
              (fun event ↦
                match event with
                | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.hit request => request
                | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request evicted => request)
              output.1 =
            requests ∧
          output.2.Nodup ∧ output.2.length ≤ capacity
statement:
theorem furthestInFuture_legal {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (capacity : Nat) (requests initialCache : List α)
    (hnodup : initialCache.Nodup) (hcapacity : initialCache.length ≤ capacity) :
    let output := furthestInFuture capacity requests initialCache
    (cacheLTS capacity).MTr initialCache output.1 output.2 ∧
      output.1.map (fun event => match event with
        | .hit request => request | .miss request _ => request) = requests ∧
      output.2.Nodup ∧ output.2.length ≤ capacity

docstring:
The actual manager emits no more misses than any source-legal trace on the same requests
from the same valid initial cache. Competitors may permute representations.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture_min_misses
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (capacity : ℕ) (requests initialCache : List α),
  initialCache.Nodup →
    initialCache.length ≤ capacity →
      ∀ (events : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent α)) (finalCache : List α),
        (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.cacheLTS capacity).MTr initialCache events finalCache →
          List.map
                (fun event ↦
                  match event with
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.hit request => request
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request evicted => request)
                events =
              requests →
            List.countP
                (fun event ↦
                  match event with
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.hit request => Bool.false
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request evicted => Bool.true)
                (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity requests initialCache).1 ≤
              List.countP
                (fun event ↦
                  match event with
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.hit request => Bool.false
                  | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request evicted => Bool.true)
                events
statement:
theorem furthestInFuture_min_misses {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (capacity : Nat) (requests initialCache : List α)
    (hnodup : initialCache.Nodup) (hcapacity : initialCache.length ≤ capacity)
    (events : List (CacheEvent α)) (finalCache : List α)
    (hlegal : (cacheLTS capacity).MTr initialCache events finalCache)
    (hrequests : events.map (fun event => match event with
      | .hit request => request | .miss request _ => request) = requests) :
    (furthestInFuture capacity requests initialCache).1.countP
      (fun event => match event with | .hit _ => false | .miss _ _ => true) ≤
      events.countP (fun event => match event with | .hit _ => false | .miss _ _ => true)

docstring: An empty request list preserves the exact initial cache representation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture_nil
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (capacity : ℕ) (initialCache : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture capacity [] initialCache = ([], initialCache)
statement:
theorem furthestInFuture_nil {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (capacity : Nat) (initialCache : List α) :
    furthestInFuture capacity [] initialCache = ([], initialCache)

docstring: With no storage, each real request produces exactly one miss and the cache stays empty.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture_zero_capacity
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (requests : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.furthestInFuture 0 requests [] = (List.map (fun request ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OfflineCaching.CacheEvent.miss request Option.none) requests, [])
statement:
theorem furthestInFuture_zero_capacity {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (requests : List α) :
    furthestInFuture 0 requests [] =
      (requests.map (fun request => CacheEvent.miss request none), [])

docstring:
An open-addressing hash table with `m` slots and probe sequence `probe`. No expected
constant-time bound is claimed because the model supplies neither a probability
distribution nor a uniform-hashing assumption about `probe`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing
signature: (K : Type u) → Type v → (m : ℕ) → (K → ℕ → Fin m) → Type (max u v)
statement:
public structure OpenAddressing (K : Type u) (V : Type v) (m : Nat)
    (probe : K → Nat → Fin m)

docstring: The binding `key ↦ value` is held in some slot of the table.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.Stored
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → K → V → Prop
statement:
public def Stored (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) :
    Prop

docstring:
The validity invariant, in two parts. Probe-closedness: every stored binding is
reached by its key's probe sequence within `m` probes, and every earlier probed
slot is occupied; this is the property that lets `lookup` stop at the first empty
slot. Key uniqueness: no key is stored in two different slots, so each key has at
most one binding and `insert` genuinely replaces it (see `stored_unique` and
`lookup_eq_some_iff`).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.Valid
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → Prop
statement: public def Valid (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) : Prop

docstring: Double hashing: the `i`-th probe of `k` is `(hash1 k + i * hash2 k) % m`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.doubleHashProbe
signature: {K : Type u} → (K → ℕ) → (K → ℕ) → (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → K → ℕ → Fin m
statement:
public def doubleHashProbe {K : Type u} (hash1 hash2 : K → Nat) (m : Nat)
    (hm : 0 < m) : K → Nat → Fin m

docstring: The empty table, with every slot vacant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.empty
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe
statement: public def empty : OpenAddressing K V m probe

docstring:
Inserts a new binding or replaces the existing binding for the key, at the first
probed slot that is empty or already holds the key. Returns `none` when the first
`m` probed slots are all occupied by other keys.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.insert
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → [DecidableEq K] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → K → V → Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe)
statement:
public def insert (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) :

docstring:
Bounded probe scan used by `insert`, starting at probe `start` with a

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.insertAux
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → [DecidableEq K] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → K → V → ℕ → ℕ → Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe)
statement:

statement:

docstring:
Looks up a key along its probe sequence, using at most `m` probes. Returns the value
at the first probed slot holding the key, and `none` if an empty slot or the probe
budget is reached first.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → [DecidableEq K] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → K → Option V
statement: public def lookup (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) : Option V

docstring:
Bounded probe scan used by `lookup`, starting at probe `start` with a
remaining budget of attempts.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookupAux
signature: {K : Type u} → {V : Type v} → {m : ℕ} → {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} → [DecidableEq K] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe → K → ℕ → ℕ → Option V
statement:
def lookupAux (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (start : Nat) :
    Nat → Option V

docstring: Looking up any key in the empty table returns `none`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_empty
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (key : K), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.empty.lookup key = Option.none
statement:
public theorem lookup_empty (key : K) :
    lookup (empty : OpenAddressing K V m probe) key = none

docstring: A key stored in no slot looks up to `none`, with no validity assumption.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_eq_none_of_not_stored
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K), (∀ (value : V), ¬table.Stored key value) → table.lookup key = Option.none

docstring:
Under `Valid`, lookup returns exactly the unique stored binding: `lookup`
returns `some value` if and only if `key ↦ value` is stored. Together with
`lookup_insert` this says a successful insert really replaces the old
binding: no other value for the key remains stored afterwards.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_eq_some_iff
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V), table.Valid → (table.lookup key = Option.some value ↔ table.Stored key value)

docstring: Looking up a successfully inserted key returns the newly supplied value.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_insert
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) (updated : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe), table.insert key value = Option.some updated → updated.lookup key = Option.some value
statement:
public theorem lookup_insert (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K)
    (value : V) (updated : OpenAddressing K V m probe)
    (inserted : insert table key value = some updated) :
    lookup updated key = some value

docstring:
Frame theorem for insertion: in a valid table, looking up a key different
from the inserted one gives the same result before and after a successful
insert. Together with `lookup_insert` this is the map-update specification
of `insert`, in the form of `HashTable.lookup_insert_of_ne`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_insert_of_ne
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) (updated : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe), table.Valid → table.insert key value = Option.some updated → ∀ {other : K}, other ≠ key → updated.lookup other = table.lookup other

docstring:
Under `Valid`, a lookup succeeds if and only if the key is stored in some slot.
This is the membership characterization used in place of a `Finmap` abstraction;
the value found is pinned down by `stored_of_lookup_eq_some` and, after an
insert, by `lookup_insert`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_isSome_iff
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K), table.Valid → ((table.lookup key).isSome = Bool.true ↔ ∃ value, table.Stored key value)

docstring: Under `Valid`, a stored key is found by `lookup`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.lookup_isSome_of_stored
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V), table.Valid → table.Stored key value → (table.lookup key).isSome = Bool.true
statement:
public theorem lookup_isSome_of_stored (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe)
    (key : K) (value : V) (valid : Valid table)
    (stored : Stored table key value) :
    (lookup table key).isSome

docstring:
When `insert` fails, every one of the first `m` probed slots is occupied by a key
different from the inserted one. For probe sequences that are permutations of the
slots, this says exactly that the table is full with other keys.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.occupied_of_insert_eq_none
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V), table.insert key value = Option.none → ∀ attempts < m, ∃ otherKey otherValue, table.slots.get (probe key attempts) = Option.some (otherKey, otherValue) ∧ otherKey ≠ key
statement:
public theorem occupied_of_insert_eq_none (table : OpenAddressing K V m probe)
    (key : K) (value : V) (failed : insert table key value = none) :
    ∀ attempts < m, ∃ (otherKey : K) (otherValue : V),
      table.slots.get (probe key attempts) = some (otherKey, otherValue) ∧
        otherKey ≠ key

docstring:
A successful insert changes no other key's stored binding: for `other ≠ key`,
`other ↦ otherValue` is stored after the insert exactly when it was stored
before. No validity assumption is needed; the insert writes a single slot,
previously empty or previously holding `key`, and leaves every other slot
unchanged.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.stored_insert_of_ne
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) (updated : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe), table.insert key value = Option.some updated → ∀ {other : K}, other ≠ key → ∀ {otherValue : V}, updated.Stored other otherValue ↔ table.Stored other otherValue

docstring: A value returned by `lookup` is stored in the table.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.stored_of_lookup_eq_some
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V), table.lookup key = Option.some value → table.Stored key value

docstring: In a valid table, a key has at most one stored binding.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.stored_unique
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe), table.Valid → ∀ {key : K} {value₁ value₂ : V}, table.Stored key value₁ → table.Stored key value₂ → value₁ = value₂

docstring: The empty table satisfies the probe-closed invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.valid_empty
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.empty.Valid
statement:
public theorem valid_empty :
    Valid (empty : OpenAddressing K V m probe)

docstring: Insertion or replacement preserves the probe-closed invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing.valid_insert
signature: ∀ {K : Type u} {V : Type v} {m : ℕ} {probe : K → ℕ → Fin m} [inst : DecidableEq K] (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe) (key : K) (value : V) (updated : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OpenAddressing K V m probe), table.Valid → table.insert key value = Option.some updated → updated.Valid

    (value : V) (updated : OpenAddressing K V m probe) (valid : Valid table)
    (inserted : insert table key value = some updated) :
    Valid updated

statement:
public def expectedSearchCost [AddCommMonoid R] (n : Nat)
    (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1))
    (tree : BinaryTree (Fin n))
    (complete : inorder tree = List.finRange n) : R

docstring: CLRS OPTIMAL-BST with saved `e`, saved `w`, saved earliest roots, and candidate-event time.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST
signature: {R : Type u} → [inst : AddCommMonoid R] → [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] → [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] → {n : ℕ} → Vector R n → Vector R (n + 1) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Vector (Vector R (n + 1)) (n + 1) × Vector (Vector (Option (Fin n)) n) n)
statement:
public def optimalBST [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] {n : Nat} (p : Vector R n)
    (q : Vector R (n + 1)) : TimeM Nat
    (Vector (Vector R (n + 1)) (n + 1) ×
      Vector (Vector (Option (Fin n)) n) n)

docstring: The empty instance performs initialization but no candidate evaluation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST_empty
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (p : Vector R 0) (q : Vector R 1), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q = { ret := (Vector.ofFn fun x ↦ Vector.ofFn fun x ↦ q[0], Vector.replicate 0 (Vector.replicate 0 Option.none)), time := 0 }
statement:
public theorem optimalBST_empty [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (p : Vector R 0) (q : Vector R 1) :
    optimalBST p q =
      ⟨(Vector.ofFn (fun _ : Fin 1 => Vector.ofFn (fun _ : Fin 1 => q[0])),
        Vector.replicate 0 (Vector.replicate 0 (none : Option (Fin 0)))), 0⟩

docstring: The full saved cost is attained and bounds every canonical ordered competitor.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST_minimal
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (n : ℕ) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)), IsLeast {z | ∃ tree, ∃ (h : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.inorder tree = List.finRange n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.expectedSearchCost n p q tree h = z} (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[0][n]
statement:
public theorem optimalBST_minimal [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)),
      IsLeast {z : R | ∃ (tree : BinaryTree (Fin n))
        (h : inorder tree = List.finRange n), expectedSearchCost n p q tree h = z}
        (optimalBST p q).ret.1[0][n]

docstring: Every meaningful table cell has the CLRS recurrence and the earliest attaining root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST_table_spec
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (n : ℕ) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)), (∀ (a : Fin (n + 1)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑a] = q[↑a]) ∧ ∀ (a : Fin n) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (h : ↑a < ↑b), ∃ r, ↑a ≤ ↑r ∧ ↑r < ↑b ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.2[↑a][↑b - 1] = Option.some r ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑b] = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑r] + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑r + 1][↑b] + ((∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i < ↑b then p[↑i] else 0) + ∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i ≤ ↑b then q[↑i] else 0) ∧ ∀ (t : Fin n), ↑a ≤ ↑t → ↑t < ↑b → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑b] ≤ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑t] + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑t + 1][↑b] + ((∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i < ↑b then p[↑i] else 0) + ∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i ≤ ↑b then q[↑i] else 0) ∧ (↑t < ↑r → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑b] < (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑a][↑t] + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).ret.1[↑t + 1][↑b] + ((∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i < ↑b then p[↑i] else 0) + ∑ i, if ↑a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i ≤ ↑b then q[↑i] else 0))
statement:
public theorem optimalBST_table_spec [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)),
      (∀ a : Fin (n + 1), (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][a.val] = q[a.val]) ∧
      (∀ (a : Fin n) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (h : a.val < b.val),
        ∃ r : Fin n, a.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < b.val ∧
          (optimalBST p q).ret.2[a.val][b.val - 1]'(by omega) = some r ∧
          (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][b.val] =
            (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][r.val] +
            (optimalBST p q).ret.1[r.val + 1][b.val] +
            ((∑ i : Fin n, if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b.val then p[i.val] else 0) +
              ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ b.val then q[i.val] else 0) ∧
          ∀ t : Fin n, a.val ≤ t.val → t.val < b.val →
            ((optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][b.val] ≤
              (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][t.val] +
              (optimalBST p q).ret.1[t.val + 1][b.val] +
              ((∑ i : Fin n, if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b.val then p[i.val] else 0) +
                ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ b.val then q[i.val] else 0)) ∧
            (t.val < r.val → (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][b.val] <
              (optimalBST p q).ret.1[a.val][t.val] +
              (optimalBST p q).ret.1[t.val + 1][b.val] +
              ((∑ i : Fin n, if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b.val then p[i.val] else 0) +
                ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), if a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ b.val then q[i.val] else 0)))

docstring: The coupled execution charges exactly one tick for each candidate.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST_time
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (n : ℕ) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).time = (n + 2).choose 3
statement:
public theorem optimalBST_time [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)),
      (optimalBST p q).time = Nat.choose (n + 2) 3

docstring: Cubic lower and upper bounds for the selected candidate-event metric.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST_time_bounds
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid R] (n : ℕ) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)), n ^ 3 ≤ 6 * (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).time ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OptimalBST.optimalBST p q).time ≤ n ^ 3
statement:
public theorem optimalBST_time_bounds [AddCommMonoid R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Vector R n) (q : Vector R (n + 1)),
      n ^ 3 ≤ 6 * (optimalBST p q).time ∧ (optimalBST p q).time ≤ n ^ 3

docstring: Cached select after deletion refines the traversal select of the erased result.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select_delete_eq_bstSelect
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {key : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.CacheCorrect tree → ∀ (index : ℕ), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.delete key tree) index = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.select (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.erase (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.delete key tree)) index
statement:
public theorem select_delete_eq_bstSelect {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {key : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hCache : CacheCorrect tree) (index : Nat) :
    select (delete key tree) index =
      BinarySearchTree.select (erase (delete key tree)) index

docstring: Cached navigation select refines the prerequisite traversal-based select.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select_eq_bstSelect
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.CacheCorrect tree → ∀ (index : ℕ), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select tree index = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.select (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.erase tree) index

docstring: Selecting the rank of a present key returns that key.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select_rank
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {key : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.CacheCorrect tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Ordered tree → key ∈ tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select tree (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.rank key tree) = Option.some key

docstring: Selecting the rank of a key that survives deletion returns that key.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select_rank_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {key y : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.CacheCorrect tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.Ordered tree → y ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.delete key tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.select (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.delete key tree) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.rank y (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.OrderStatisticTree.delete key tree)) = Option.some y
statement:
public theorem select_rank_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {key y : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hCache : CacheCorrect tree) (hTree : Ordered tree)
    (hy : y ∈ delete key tree) :
    select (delete key tree) (rank y (delete key tree)) = some y

docstring:
A static two-level (FKS) hash table. The primary hash selects a bucket
`primaryHash k % bucketCount`; inside bucket `i`, the secondary hash selects the slot
`secondaryHash i k % secondarySize i` of a table with one binding per slot. No
existence or expected-time claim about the hash functions is made; correctness is
conditioned on `PerfectHashing.Valid`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing
signature: (α : Type u) → Type v → (α → ℕ) → Type (max u v)
statement: public structure PerfectHashing (α : Type u) (β : Type v) (primaryHash : α → Nat)

docstring:
The FKS sizing rule: every bucket's secondary table has size the square of the
number of keys in the bucket, `mᵢ = nᵢ²`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.SquareSized
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → Prop
statement: public def SquareSized (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) : Prop

docstring: Whether some secondary slot, in any bucket, holds the binding `(key, value)`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.Stored
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → α → β → Prop
statement:
public def Stored (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) (key : α) (value : β) :
    Prop

docstring:
The correctness invariant of a two-level table. `placed` says every stored binding
lies in the bucket selected by the primary hash for its key, at the slot selected by
that bucket's secondary hash. `injective` says each secondary hash is injective, as
a slot selector, on the keys stored in its bucket: no two stored keys of one bucket
collide. The second clause follows from the first (`Valid.injective_of_placed`); it
is recorded separately because choosing such injective secondary hashes is the task
of the FKS construction.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.Valid
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → Prop
statement: public structure Valid (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) : Prop

docstring:
Placement implies secondary injectivity on stored keys: if two stored keys of one
bucket selected the same slot, both bindings would have to occupy that slot, so the
bindings, and in particular the keys, are equal.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.Valid.injective_of_placed
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, (∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i)) (key : α) (value : β), (table.secondaryTable i).get j = Option.some (key, value) → ⟨primaryHash key % table.bucketCount, ⋯⟩ = i ∧ ↑j = table.secondaryHash i key % table.secondarySize i) → ∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (key₁ key₂ : α), (∃ j value, (table.secondaryTable i).get j = Option.some (key₁, value)) → (∃ j value, (table.secondaryTable i).get j = Option.some (key₂, value)) → table.secondaryHash i key₁ % table.secondarySize i = table.secondaryHash i key₂ % table.secondarySize i → key₁ = key₂
statement:
public theorem injective_of_placed {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}
    (placed : ∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i))
      (key : α) (value : β),
      (table.secondaryTable i).get j = some (key, value) →
        (⟨primaryHash key % table.bucketCount, Nat.mod_lt _ table.bucketCount_pos⟩ :
          Fin table.bucketCount) = i ∧
          j.val = table.secondaryHash i key % table.secondarySize i) :
    ∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (key₁ key₂ : α),
      (∃ (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i)) (value : β),
        (table.secondaryTable i).get j = some (key₁, value)) →
      (∃ (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i)) (value : β),
        (table.secondaryTable i).get j = some (key₂, value)) →
      table.secondaryHash i key₁ % table.secondarySize i =
        table.secondaryHash i key₂ % table.secondarySize i →
      key₁ = key₂

docstring: A table satisfying the placement clause is valid.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.Valid.mk_of_placed
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, (∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i)) (key : α) (value : β), (table.secondaryTable i).get j = Option.some (key, value) → ⟨primaryHash key % table.bucketCount, ⋯⟩ = i ∧ ↑j = table.secondaryHash i key % table.secondarySize i) → table.Valid
statement:
public theorem mk_of_placed {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}
    (placed : ∀ (i : Fin table.bucketCount) (j : Fin (table.secondarySize i))
      (key : α) (value : β),
      (table.secondaryTable i).get j = some (key, value) →
        (⟨primaryHash key % table.bucketCount, Nat.mod_lt _ table.bucketCount_pos⟩ :
          Fin table.bucketCount) = i ∧
          j.val = table.secondaryHash i key % table.secondarySize i) :
    Valid table

docstring: The number of occupied slots of bucket `i`, the `nᵢ` of the FKS analysis.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.bucketSize
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) → Fin table.bucketCount → ℕ
statement:
public def bucketSize (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash)
    (i : Fin table.bucketCount) : Nat

docstring: A bucket cannot hold more bindings than it has slots.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.bucketSize_le_secondarySize
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) (i : Fin table.bucketCount), table.bucketSize i ≤ table.secondarySize i

docstring: The empty table for the given bucket sizes and secondary hash functions.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.empty
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → (primaryHash : α → ℕ) → (bucketCount : ℕ) → 0 < bucketCount → (Fin bucketCount → ℕ) → (Fin bucketCount → α → ℕ) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash
statement:
public def empty (primaryHash : α → Nat) (bucketCount : Nat)
    (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → Nat)
    (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → Nat) :
    PerfectHashing α β primaryHash

docstring:
The bucket-independent contents of the table as a list: every occupied secondary
slot, bucket by bucket. Stored bindings are exactly the members of this list
(`mem_entries_iff`).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.entries
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → List (α × β)
statement: public def entries (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) : List (α × β)

docstring: The empty table has no entries.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.entries_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (bucketCount : ℕ) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → ℕ) (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash).entries = []
statement:
public theorem entries_empty (bucketCount : Nat) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount)
    (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → Nat)
    (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → Nat) :
    entries (empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash :
      PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) = []

docstring:
Looks up a key by evaluating the primary and secondary hashes and inspecting the
single selected slot. Returns the stored value when that slot holds the key, and
`none` otherwise (in particular when the bucket's secondary table is empty).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → [DecidableEq α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → Option β
statement:
public def lookup [DecidableEq α] (key : α) (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) :
    Option β

docstring: Looking up any key in the empty table returns `none`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] (bucketCount : ℕ) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → ℕ) (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → ℕ) (key : α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash) = Option.none
statement:
public theorem lookup_empty [DecidableEq α] (bucketCount : Nat)
    (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → Nat)
    (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → Nat) (key : α) :
    lookup key (empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize
      secondaryHash : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) = none

docstring: Under `Valid`, lookup fails exactly on keys that are not stored.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup_eq_none_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.Valid → ∀ (key : α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key table = Option.none ↔ ∀ (value : β), ¬table.Stored key value
statement:
public theorem lookup_eq_none_iff [DecidableEq α]
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (valid : Valid table) (key : α) :
    lookup key table = none ↔ ∀ value : β, ¬ Stored table key value

docstring: Lookup completeness phrased against the list abstraction `entries`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup_eq_some_of_mem_entries
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.Valid → ∀ {key : α} {value : β}, (key, value) ∈ table.entries → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key table = Option.some value
statement:
public theorem lookup_eq_some_of_mem_entries [DecidableEq α]
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (valid : Valid table) {key : α}
    {value : β} (h : (key, value) ∈ table.entries) :
    lookup key table = some value

docstring:
Completeness of lookup under `Valid`: a stored binding is found, because placement
puts it in exactly the bucket and slot that lookup probes.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup_eq_some_of_stored
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.Valid → ∀ {key : α} {value : β}, table.Stored key value → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key table = Option.some value
statement:
public theorem lookup_eq_some_of_stored [DecidableEq α]
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (valid : Valid table) {key : α}
    {value : β} (h : Stored table key value) :
    lookup key table = some value

docstring: The list abstraction `entries` contains exactly the stored bindings.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.mem_entries_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) (key : α) (value : β), (key, value) ∈ table.entries ↔ table.Stored key value

docstring: Lookup soundness phrased against the list abstraction `entries`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.mem_entries_of_lookup_eq_some
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} {key : α} {value : β}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key table = Option.some value → (key, value) ∈ table.entries

docstring: Nothing is stored in the empty table.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.not_stored_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (bucketCount : ℕ) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → ℕ) (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → ℕ) (key : α) (value : β), ¬(Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash).Stored key value
statement:
public theorem not_stored_empty (bucketCount : Nat) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount)
    (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → Nat)
    (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → Nat) (key : α) (value : β) :
    ¬ Stored (empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash :
      PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) key value

docstring: Each bucket's secondary size is dominated by the total secondary space.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.secondarySize_le_totalSecondarySpace
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) (i : Fin table.bucketCount), table.secondarySize i ≤ table.totalSecondarySpace
statement:
public theorem secondarySize_le_totalSecondarySpace
    (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) (i : Fin table.bucketCount) :
    table.secondarySize i ≤ totalSecondarySpace table

docstring:
Soundness of lookup, with no validity hypothesis: a successful lookup only returns a
value that is actually stored alongside the key in some secondary slot.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.stored_of_lookup_eq_some
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} {key : α} {value : β}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.lookup key table = Option.some value → table.Stored key value

docstring:
Under `Valid`, the stored value for a key is unique when it exists. This is
a direct consequence of placement (both bindings would occupy the one slot their
shared key hashes to), so it needs no decidable equality on keys.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.stored_unique
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.Valid → ∀ {key : α} {value₁ value₂ : β}, table.Stored key value₁ → table.Stored key value₂ → value₁ = value₂
statement:
public theorem stored_unique
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (valid : Valid table) {key : α}
    {value₁ value₂ : β} (h₁ : Stored table key value₁)
    (h₂ : Stored table key value₂) : value₁ = value₂

docstring: The total number of stored keys, `∑ i, nᵢ`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.totalKeys
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → ℕ
statement: public def totalKeys (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) : Nat

docstring: The total secondary space: the total number of secondary slots, `∑ i, mᵢ`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.totalSecondarySpace
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {primaryHash : α → ℕ} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash → ℕ
statement: public def totalSecondarySpace (table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash) : Nat

docstring: Under the FKS sizing rule, the total secondary space is the sum of squares `∑ i, nᵢ²`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.totalSecondarySpace_eq_sum_sq
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.SquareSized → table.totalSecondarySpace = ∑ i, table.bucketSize i ^ 2
statement:
public theorem totalSecondarySpace_eq_sum_sq
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (hsq : SquareSized table) :
    totalSecondarySpace table =
      ∑ i : Fin table.bucketCount, (bucketSize table i) ^ 2

docstring:
Elementary space bound under the FKS sizing rule: the total secondary space
`∑ i, nᵢ²` is at most `(∑ i, nᵢ)²`, the square of the total number of keys. The
linear bound `∑ i, nᵢ² = O(n)` of FKS additionally requires a good primary hash
function, whose existence is a probabilistic statement not proved here.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.totalSecondarySpace_le_totalKeys_sq
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} {table : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing α β primaryHash}, table.SquareSized → table.totalSecondarySpace ≤ table.totalKeys ^ 2
statement:
public theorem totalSecondarySpace_le_totalKeys_sq
    {table : PerfectHashing α β primaryHash} (hsq : SquareSized table) :
    totalSecondarySpace table ≤ (totalKeys table) ^ 2

docstring: The empty table is valid: no slot is occupied, so both clauses are vacuous.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.valid_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {primaryHash : α → ℕ} (bucketCount : ℕ) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount) (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → ℕ) (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.PerfectHashing.empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash).Valid
statement:
public theorem valid_empty (bucketCount : Nat) (bucketCount_pos : 0 < bucketCount)
    (secondarySize : Fin bucketCount → Nat)
    (secondaryHash : Fin bucketCount → α → Nat) :
    Valid (empty primaryHash bucketCount bucketCount_pos secondarySize secondaryHash :
      PerfectHashing α β primaryHash)

docstring: An enqueue or dequeue request, used to state aggregate cost bounds.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: inductive Operation (α : Type u)

docstring: The potential-method charge assigned to one queue operation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation.charge
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation α → ℕ
statement: def Operation.charge : Operation α → Nat

docstring: Dequeues one value, retaining the input queue when it is empty.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue
signature: {α : Type u} → Std.Queue α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Option α × Std.Queue α)
statement: def dequeue (q : Std.Queue α) : TimeM Nat (Option α × Std.Queue α)

docstring: The modeled cost of dequeueing: one unit plus the number of elements reversed.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeueCost
signature: {α : Type u} → Std.Queue α → ℕ
statement: def dequeueCost (q : Std.Queue α) : Nat

docstring: Dequeueing has amortized charge one, including on an empty queue.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue_amortized
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue q).time + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue q).ret.2 = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential q + 1
statement:
theorem dequeue_amortized (q : Std.Queue α) :
    (dequeue q).time + potential (dequeue q).ret.2 = potential q + 1

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue_ret
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α),
  (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue q).ret =
    match q.dequeue? with
    | Option.none => (Option.none, q)
    | Option.some (value, rest) => (Option.some value, rest)
statement:
theorem dequeue_ret (q : Std.Queue α) :
    (dequeue q).ret =
      match q.dequeue? with

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeue q).time = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.dequeueCost q
statement:
theorem dequeue_time (q : Std.Queue α) :
    (dequeue q).time = dequeueCost q

docstring: Enqueues one value and charges one unit.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue
signature: {α : Type u} → Std.Queue α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Std.Queue α)
statement: def enqueue (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α) : TimeM Nat (Std.Queue α)

docstring: Enqueueing has amortized charge two.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue_amortized
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue q value).time + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue q value).ret = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential q + 2
statement:
theorem enqueue_amortized (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α) :
    (enqueue q value).time + potential (enqueue q value).ret = potential q + 2

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue_ret
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue q value).ret = Std.Queue.enqueue value q
statement:
theorem enqueue_ret (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α) :
    (enqueue q value).ret = q.enqueue value

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.enqueue q value).time = 1
statement:
theorem enqueue_time (q : Std.Queue α) (value : α) :
    (enqueue q value).time = 1

docstring: The number of queued elements waiting in the list that the next transfer reverses.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential
signature: {α : Type u} → Std.Queue α → ℕ
statement: def potential (q : Std.Queue α) : Nat

docstring: Executes queue operations from left to right, accumulating modeled cost.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.run
signature: {α : Type u} → List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation α) → Std.Queue α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Std.Queue α)
statement: def run : List (Operation α) → Std.Queue α → TimeM Nat (Std.Queue α)

docstring: Potential changes telescope over a sequence of queue operations.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.run_amortized
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (ops : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation α)) (q : Std.Queue α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.run ops q).time + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.run ops q).ret = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential q + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.totalCharge ops

signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (q : Std.Queue α) (op : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.Operation α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.step q op).time + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.step q op).ret = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Queue.Amortized.potential q + op.charge

docstring: A radix trie from list keys over `α` to values in `β`, with list-labelled edges.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie
signature: Type u → Type v → Type (max u v)
statement: inductive RadixTrie (α : Type u) (β : Type v)

docstring:
Path compression at a single node: a node reached by an edge either ends a key (it
stores a value) or genuinely branches (it has at least two children). A value-free node
with at most one child could be merged into its parent edge, which is exactly what a
radix trie rules out. The root is exempt, since it has no incoming edge.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.RootCompact
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β → Prop
statement: def RootCompact {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : RadixTrie α β → Prop

docstring:
The radix-trie invariant: at every node, edge labels are nonempty, their first symbols
are distinct, every subtree is valid, and every subtree is path-compressed at its root
(`RootCompact`): a value-free non-root node has at least two children, so no unary
value-free node remains to be merged into its parent edge.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.Valid
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β → Prop
statement: inductive Valid {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : RadixTrie α β → Prop

statement:
theorem Valid.buildFrom {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq γ]
    (L : List (List γ × β)) : Valid (buildFrom L)

statement: theorem Valid.empty {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : Valid (empty : RadixTrie α β)

docstring: A list is its longest common prefix with another list, followed by the drop remainder.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.append_drop_commonPrefix_left
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α), xs = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys ++ List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length xs

theorem append_drop_commonPrefix_left {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]

docstring:
The trie built from a list of key-value pairs by inserting the head pair last. Later
pairs in the list are inserted first, so on duplicate keys the head-most value wins.

signature: {γ : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [DecidableEq γ] → List (List γ × β) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β

docstring: The longest common prefix of two lists.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix
signature: {α : Type u} → [DecidableEq α] → List α → List α → List α
statement: def commonPrefix {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] : List α → List α → List α

docstring: A shared prefix factors out of the longest common prefix.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_append_append
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (P xs ys : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix (P ++ xs) (P ++ ys) = P ++ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_append_append {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
    (P xs ys : List α) :
    commonPrefix (P ++ xs) (P ++ ys) = P ++ commonPrefix xs ys

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_cons_cons
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a : α) (xs : List α) (b : α) (ys : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix (a :: xs) (b :: ys) = if a = b then a :: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys else []
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_cons_cons {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (xs : List α)
    (b : α) (ys : List α) :
    commonPrefix (a :: xs) (b :: ys) =
      if a = b then a :: commonPrefix xs ys else []

docstring: The longest-common-prefix decomposition, stated with the drop remainders.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_drop_spec
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α), xs = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys ++ List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length xs ∧ ys = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys ++ List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length ys ∧ (List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length xs = [] ∨ List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length ys = [] ∨ ∃ x xs'' y ys'', List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length xs = x :: xs'' ∧ List.drop (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys).length ys = y :: ys'' ∧ x ≠ y)
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_drop_spec {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    xs = commonPrefix xs ys ++ xs.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length ∧
      ys = commonPrefix xs ys ++ ys.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length ∧
      (xs.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length = [] ∨
        ys.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length = [] ∨
        ∃ x xs'' y ys'', xs.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length = x :: xs'' ∧
          ys.drop (commonPrefix xs ys).length = y :: ys'' ∧ x ≠ y)

docstring: If the first list extends the second, the longest common prefix is the second.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_eq_of_append
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] {xs ys t : List α}, xs = ys ++ t → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys = ys
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_eq_of_append {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {xs ys t : List α}
    (h : xs = ys ++ t) : commonPrefix xs ys = ys

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_nil_left
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (ys : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix [] ys = []
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_nil_left {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (ys : List α) :
    commonPrefix [] ys = []

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_nil_right
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs [] = []
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_nil_right {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) :
    commonPrefix xs [] = []

docstring: The longest common prefix of a list with itself is the list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_self
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs xs = xs
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_self {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) :
    commonPrefix xs xs = xs

docstring:
Both lists extend their longest common prefix, and the remainders are the reason the
prefix is longest: one is empty, or their heads differ.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix_spec
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α), ∃ xs' ys', xs = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys ++ xs' ∧ ys = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix xs ys ++ ys' ∧ (xs' = [] ∨ ys' = [] ∨ ∃ x xs'' y ys'', xs' = x :: xs'' ∧ ys' = y :: ys'' ∧ x ≠ y)
statement:
theorem commonPrefix_spec {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    ∃ xs' ys', xs = commonPrefix xs ys ++ xs' ∧ ys = commonPrefix xs ys ++ ys' ∧
      (xs' = [] ∨ ys' = [] ∨
        ∃ x xs'' y ys'', xs' = x :: xs'' ∧ ys' = y :: ys'' ∧ x ≠ y)

docstring: The trie containing no key-value entries.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.empty
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β
statement: def empty {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : RadixTrie α β

docstring: Enumerates the key-value entries of a radix trie in stored sibling order.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.entries
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β → List (List α × β)
statement: def entries {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : RadixTrie α β → List (List α × β)

docstring: Returns the first child edge whose label starts with `c`, if any.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge
signature: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [DecidableEq α] → α → List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β) → Option (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)
statement:
def findEdge {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α] (c : α) :
    List (List α × RadixTrie α β) → Option (List α × RadixTrie α β)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_cons
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] (c : α) (label : List α) (child : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β) (rest : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c ((label, child) :: rest) = if label.head? = Option.some c then Option.some (label, child) else Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c rest
statement:
theorem findEdge_cons {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α] (c : α)
    (label : List α) (child : RadixTrie α β)
    (rest : List (List α × RadixTrie α β)) :
    findEdge c ((label, child) :: rest) =
      if label.head? = some c then some (label, child) else findEdge c rest

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_eq_none_imp
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] {c : α} {children : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c children = Option.none → ∀ e ∈ children, e.1.head? ≠ Option.some c

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_nil
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] (c : α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c [] = Option.none
statement:
theorem findEdge_nil {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α] (c : α) :
    findEdge c ([] : List (List α × RadixTrie α β)) = none

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_replaceEdge_ne
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] {c c' : α}, c' ≠ c → ∀ {newEdge : List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β}, newEdge.1.head? = Option.some c → ∀ (children : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c' (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.replaceEdge c newEdge children) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c' children
statement:
theorem findEdge_replaceEdge_ne {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α]
    {c c' : α} (h : c' ≠ c) {newEdge : List α × RadixTrie α β}
    (hhead : newEdge.1.head? = some c)
    (children : List (List α × RadixTrie α β)) :
    findEdge c' (replaceEdge c newEdge children) = findEdge c' children

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_replaceEdge_same
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] {c : α} {newEdge : List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β}, newEdge.1.head? = Option.some c → ∀ (children : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.replaceEdge c newEdge children) = Option.some newEdge
statement:
theorem findEdge_replaceEdge_same {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α]
    {c : α} {newEdge : List α × RadixTrie α β}
    (hhead : newEdge.1.head? = some c)
    (children : List (List α × RadixTrie α β)) :
    findEdge c (replaceEdge c newEdge children) = some newEdge

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_some_head
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] {c : α} {children : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)} {label : List α} {child : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c children = Option.some (label, child) → label.head? = Option.some c

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge_some_mem
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] {c : α} {children : List (List α × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β)} {label : List α} {child : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie α β}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c children = Option.some (label, child) → (label, child) ∈ children

docstring:
Whether some key stored in the trie extends `p`. The walk follows the edge whose label
starts with the pattern's head symbol; it succeeds when the pattern ends inside that
edge (with a stored key below) or at a node reached by consuming whole edges.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.hasPrefix
signature: {γ : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [DecidableEq γ] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β → List γ → Bool
statement:
def hasPrefix {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq γ] (t : RadixTrie γ β)
    (p : List γ) : Bool

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.hasPrefix_cons_none
signature: ∀ {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq γ] (value : Option β) (children : List (List γ × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β)) (c : γ) (cs : List γ), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c children = Option.none → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.node value children).hasPrefix (c :: cs) = Bool.false
statement:
theorem hasPrefix_cons_none {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq γ]
    (value : Option β) (children : List (List γ × RadixTrie γ β)) (c : γ) (cs : List γ)
    (hfind : findEdge c children = none) :
    (RadixTrie.node value children).hasPrefix (c :: cs) = false

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.hasPrefix_cons_some
signature: ∀ {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq γ] (value : Option β) (children : List (List γ × Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β)) (c : γ) (cs label : List γ) (child : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.findEdge c children = Option.some (label, child) → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.node value children).hasPrefix (c :: cs) = if Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix (c :: cs) label = c :: cs then !child.keys.isEmpty else if Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.commonPrefix (c :: cs) label = label then child.hasPrefix (List.drop label.length (c :: cs)) else Bool.false
statement:
theorem hasPrefix_cons_some {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq γ]
    (value : Option β) (children : List (List γ × RadixTrie γ β)) (c : γ) (cs : List γ)
    (label : List γ) (child : RadixTrie γ β)
    (hfind : findEdge c children = some (label, child)) :
    (RadixTrie.node value children).hasPrefix (c :: cs) =
      if commonPrefix (c :: cs) label = (c :: cs) then !child.keys.isEmpty
      else if commonPrefix (c :: cs) label = label then
        child.hasPrefix ((c :: cs).drop label.length)
      else false

docstring: Prefix search succeeds exactly when some stored key extends the pattern.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie.hasPrefix_eq_true_iff
signature: ∀ {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RadixTrie γ β}, t.Valid → ∀ (p : List γ), t.hasPrefix p = Bool.true ↔ ∃ k ∈ t.keys, p <+: k
statement:
theorem hasPrefix_eq_true_iff {γ : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq γ]
    {t : RadixTrie γ β} (h : Valid t) (p : List γ) :
    t.hasPrefix p = true ↔ ∃ k ∈ t.keys, p <+: k

docstring:
A 1D range tree over `Int`: empty, a single leaf, or a binary node
caching the leaf interval `[lo, hi]` of its subtree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree

docstring:
The cached node intervals are the true leaf intervals:
at every node, `lo = min left.tmin right.tmin` and
`hi = max left.tmax right.tmax`, recursively. Node children must be
nonempty: `tmin`/`tmax` give the empty tree the sentinel `0`, so with an
empty child the node cache would only conservatively enclose the leaves
(for example `.node 0 5 .empty (.leaf 5)` would cache `[0, 5]` for the
single leaf `5`), not equal the true leaf interval. Together
`bounds_of_mem` and `bounds_mem_toList_of_ne_nil` show the cache is
exactly attained by leaves.
