signature: ∀ (xs : List ℤ) (lo hi : ℤ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).count lo hi = (List.filter (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)) xs).length
statement:
theorem count_build (xs : List Int) (lo hi : Int) :
    (build xs).count lo hi =
      (xs.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)).length

docstring: The count is the length of the leaf list filtered to `[lo, hi]`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.count_eq
signature: ∀ {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree}, t.BoundsOk → ∀ (lo hi : ℤ), t.count lo hi = (List.filter (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)) t.toList).length
statement:
theorem count_eq {t : RangeTree} (hb : BoundsOk t) (lo hi : Int) :
    t.count lo hi = (t.toList.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)).length

docstring: The length of the leaf list is the size of the tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.length_toList
signature: ∀ (t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree), t.toList.length = t.size
statement: theorem length_toList (t : RangeTree) : t.toList.length = t.size

docstring: Membership in the report on a built tree, stated on the input list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.mem_report_build_iff
signature: ∀ {xs : List ℤ} {lo hi x : ℤ}, x ∈ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).report lo hi ↔ x ∈ xs ∧ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi
statement:
theorem mem_report_build_iff {xs : List Int} {lo hi x : Int} :
    x ∈ (build xs).report lo hi ↔ x ∈ xs ∧ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi

docstring: Membership in the report is membership in the tree inside `[lo, hi]`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.mem_report_iff
signature: ∀ {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree}, t.BoundsOk → ∀ {lo hi x : ℤ}, x ∈ t.report lo hi ↔ x ∈ t.toList ∧ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi
statement:
theorem mem_report_iff {t : RangeTree} (hb : BoundsOk t) {lo hi x : Int} :
    x ∈ t.report lo hi ↔ x ∈ t.toList ∧ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi

docstring: The range report for `[lo, hi]`; see `reportAux`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.report
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → ℤ → ℤ → List ℤ
statement: def report (t : RangeTree) (lo hi : Int) : List Int

docstring:
Accumulator range report for `[lo, hi]`: a node whose cached interval is
disjoint from the query contributes nothing, a node contained in it
contributes its whole leaf list onto the accumulator (the canonical-node
case, via the linear `toListAux`), and otherwise both children are
searched. The cached bounds make each pruning test constant-time.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.reportAux
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → ℤ → ℤ → List ℤ → List ℤ
statement: def reportAux : RangeTree → Int → Int → List Int → List Int

docstring:
The accumulator report of a bounds-valid tree is its filtered leaf
list on the accumulator.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.reportAux_eq_filter_append
signature: ∀ {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree}, t.BoundsOk → ∀ (lo hi : ℤ) (acc : List ℤ), t.reportAux lo hi acc = List.filter (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)) t.toList ++ acc
statement:
theorem reportAux_eq_filter_append {t : RangeTree} (hb : BoundsOk t)
    (lo hi : Int) (acc : List Int) :
    t.reportAux lo hi acc =
      t.toList.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi) ++ acc

docstring: The report on a tree built from a list is that list filtered to `[lo, hi]`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.report_build
signature: ∀ (xs : List ℤ) (lo hi : ℤ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).report lo hi = List.filter (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)) xs
statement:
theorem report_build (xs : List Int) (lo hi : Int) :
    (build xs).report lo hi = xs.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)

docstring: The report of a bounds-valid tree is the leaf list filtered to `[lo, hi]`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.report_eq_filter
signature: ∀ {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree}, t.BoundsOk → ∀ (lo hi : ℤ), t.report lo hi = List.filter (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)) t.toList
statement:
theorem report_eq_filter {t : RangeTree} (hb : BoundsOk t) (lo hi : Int) :
    t.report lo hi = t.toList.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi)

docstring: The number of leaves of a tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.size
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → ℕ
statement: def size : RangeTree → Nat

docstring: The size of a tree built from a list is the length of that list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.size_build
signature: ∀ (xs : List ℤ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).size = xs.length
statement: theorem size_build (xs : List Int) : (build xs).size = xs.length

docstring: The cached upper leaf bound; `0` for the empty tree (vacuous).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.tmax
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → ℤ
statement: def tmax : RangeTree → Int

docstring:
The cached lower leaf bound; `0` for the empty tree (vacuous).
Constant-time: a projection of the node cache, not a traversal.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.tmin
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → ℤ
statement: def tmin : RangeTree → Int

docstring: The leaf values of a tree from left to right.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toList
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → List ℤ
statement: def toList (t : RangeTree) : List Int

docstring:
Accumulator leaf traversal: `toListAux t acc = toList t ++ acc`, so
`toList` is linear rather than repeatedly appending left leaf lists.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toListAux
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree → List ℤ → List ℤ
statement: def toListAux : RangeTree → List Int → List Int

docstring: The accumulator traversal appends the leaf list onto its accumulator.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toListAux_eq
signature: ∀ (t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree) (acc : List ℤ), t.toListAux acc = t.toList ++ acc
statement:
theorem toListAux_eq (t : RangeTree) (acc : List Int) :
    toListAux t acc = t.toList ++ acc

docstring: The leaf list of a tree built from a list is that list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toList_build
signature: ∀ (xs : List ℤ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).toList = xs
statement: theorem toList_build : ∀ xs : List Int, (build xs).toList = xs

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toList_empty
signature: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.empty.toList = []
statement: theorem toList_empty : (RangeTree.empty).toList = []

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toList_leaf
signature: ∀ (x : ℤ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.leaf x).toList = [x]
statement: theorem toList_leaf (x : Int) : (RangeTree.leaf x).toList = [x]

docstring: Characteristic node equation for `toList` (the former definition).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.toList_node
signature: ∀ (lo hi : ℤ) (left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.node lo hi left right).toList = left.toList ++ right.toList
statement:
theorem toList_node (lo hi : Int) (left right : RangeTree) :
    (RangeTree.node lo hi left right).toList = left.toList ++ right.toList

docstring:
Building from a sorted list yields a valid (classical) range tree:
correct cached bounds and sorted leaf order. Without the sortedness
hypothesis only `boundsOk_build` holds.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.valid_build_of_sorted
signature: ∀ {xs : List ℤ}, List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 ≤ x2) xs → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RangeTree.build xs).Valid
statement:
theorem valid_build_of_sorted {xs : List Int} (h : xs.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) :
    Valid (build xs)

docstring:
`All p tree` states that every key in `tree` satisfies `p`; it is
`BinarySearchTree.All` of the color-erased tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.All
signature: {α : Type u} → (α → Prop) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def All {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring:
`RedOk` everywhere except possibly a red-red redex at the root.

This is the intermediate invariant of Okasaki's unchecked insertion.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.AlmostRedOk
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def AlmostRedOk {α : Type u} : Tree α → Prop

docstring: All root-to-leaf paths contain the same number of black nodes.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Balanced {α : Type u} : Tree α → Prop

docstring: The color of a red-black tree node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color
signature: Type
statement: public inductive Color

docstring:
A red-black tree whose root may be double black. The `.nodeBB` case is a
double-black node; its children are genuine trees of the parent module, so a
double black occurs only at the root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: public inductive BBTree (α : Type u)

docstring:
Root colors of a `BBTree`: the colors of the parent module plus a
double-black color counting as two black nodes.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor
signature: Type
statement: public inductive BColor

docstring:
Black-height balance for a `BBTree`: the parent module's `Balanced` for
a genuine tree, and balance of the two children for a double-black node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → Prop
statement: public def BalancedBB {α : Type u} : BBTree α → Prop

docstring:
The red invariant for a `BBTree`: the parent module's `RedOk` for a
genuine tree, and `RedOk` of both children for a double-black node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → Prop
statement: public def RedOkBB {α : Type u} : BBTree α → Prop

docstring:
Reassemble a node whose left subtree was deleted from: if the result is
genuine, rebuild the node; if it is double black, repair the deficit against
the right sibling with `fixLeft`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balLeft
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement:
def balLeft {α : Type u} (color : Color) (left : BBTree α) (key : α)
    (right : Tree α) : BBTree α

docstring:
Reassemble a node whose right subtree was deleted from; the mirror image
of `balLeft`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balRight
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement:
def balRight {α : Type u} (color : Color) (left : Tree α) (key : α)
    (right : BBTree α) : BBTree α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balancedBB_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = True
statement:
public theorem balancedBB_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    BalancedBB (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = True

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balancedBB_incrBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack tree)
statement:
public theorem balancedBB_incrBlack {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Balanced tree) : BalancedBB (incrBlack tree)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balancedBB_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced left ∧ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced right ∧ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight left = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight right)
statement:
public theorem balancedBB_nodeBB {α : Type u} {left right : Tree α}
    {key : α} :
    BalancedBB (.nodeBB left key right) =
      (Balanced left ∧ Balanced right ∧ blackHeight left = blackHeight right)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balancedBB_regular
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree
statement:
public theorem balancedBB_regular {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    BalancedBB (.regular tree) = Balanced tree

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balanced_blacken
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BalancedBB tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken tree)
statement:
public theorem balanced_blacken {α : Type u} {tree : BBTree α}
    (h : BalancedBB tree) : Balanced (blacken tree)

docstring: Deletion preserves black-height balance.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balanced_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree)
statement:
public theorem balanced_deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Valid tree) : Balanced (deleteBal x tree)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.balanced_rootBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack tree)
statement:
public theorem balanced_rootBlack {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Balanced tree) : Balanced (rootBlack tree)

docstring:
The black height of a `BBTree`: a double-black root counts as two black
nodes, so `bhBB` of a deletion result equals `blackHeight` of the original
tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → ℕ
statement: public def bhBB {α : Type u} : BBTree α → Nat

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = 2
statement:
public theorem bhBB_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    bhBB (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = 2

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB_incrBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree + 1
statement:
public theorem bhBB_incrBlack {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    bhBB (incrBlack tree) = blackHeight tree + 1

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight left + 2

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB_regular
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.bhBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree
statement:
public theorem bhBB_regular {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    bhBB (.regular tree) = blackHeight tree

docstring:
Deletion from a valid tree keeps the black height or lowers it by one,
when a double-black bubble is absorbed at the root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blackHeight_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree ∨ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree) + 1 = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree
statement:
public theorem blackHeight_deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Valid tree) :
    blackHeight (deleteBal x tree) = blackHeight tree ∨
      blackHeight (deleteBal x tree) + 1 = blackHeight tree

docstring:
Absorb a double black at the root and recolor the root black, producing
a genuine tree. This touches only the root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: public def blacken {α : Type u} : BBTree α → Tree α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty
statement:
public theorem blacken_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    blacken (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = .empty

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black left key right

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken_regular
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack tree
statement:
public theorem blacken_regular {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    blacken (.regular tree) = rootBlack tree

docstring: The extended color of the root of a `BBTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor
statement: public def colorBB {α : Type u} : BBTree α → BColor

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.doubleBlack
statement:
public theorem colorBB_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    colorBB (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = .doubleBlack

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_incrBlack_ne_red
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack tree) ≠ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.red
statement:
public theorem colorBB_incrBlack_ne_red {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    colorBB (incrBlack tree) ≠ .red

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.doubleBlack

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_regular_black
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black left key right)) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.black

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_regular_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.black
statement:
public theorem colorBB_regular_empty {α : Type u} :
    colorBB (.regular (.empty : Tree α)) = .black

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_regular_eq_red
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.red ↔ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf tree = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.red
statement:
public theorem colorBB_regular_eq_red {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    colorBB (.regular tree) = .red ↔ colorOf tree = .red

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_regular_ne_red
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) ≠ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.red ↔ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf tree = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black
statement:
public theorem colorBB_regular_ne_red {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    colorBB (.regular tree) ≠ .red ↔ colorOf tree = .black

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB_regular_red
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.red left key right)) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BColor.red

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorOf_blacken
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black
statement:

docstring: The tree produced by deletion has a black root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.colorOf_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black

docstring:
Delete a key from a genuine tree, returning a tree whose root may be
double black. A node with two children is deleted by promoting its
successor, the minimum key of its right subtree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.del
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement: def del {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) : Tree α → BBTree α

docstring:
Delete a key by the double-black method. The result is again valid
when the input satisfies the three structural invariants `Ordered`,
`RedOk`, and `Balanced` (`valid_deleteBal_of_invariants`); in
particular `valid_deleteBal` covers `Valid tree`. The traversal
specifications `inorder_deleteBal` and `mem_deleteBal` require only
`Ordered tree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement:
public def deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) (tree : Tree α) :
    Tree α

docstring:
Repair a black-height deficit in the left child. Here `left` is the
deficient subtree with its double black already absorbed, so
`blackHeight left + 1 = blackHeight right`; `color` and `key` are the parent
color and key. The cases, in order: a black sibling with a red far (right)
nephew (single rotation), a black sibling with a red near (left) nephew
(double rotation), a black sibling with two black nephews (redden the
sibling and bubble the double black into the parent), and a red sibling
(rotate it up and solve the black-sibling problem under the resulting red
parent; the three subcases mirror the black-sibling cases).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.fixLeft
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement: def fixLeft {α : Type u} : Color → Tree α → α → Tree α → BBTree α

docstring:
Repair a black-height deficit in the right child; the mirror image of
`fixLeft`. Here `right` is the deficient subtree with its double black
absorbed, so `blackHeight right + 1 = blackHeight left`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.fixRight
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement: def fixRight {α : Type u} : Color → Tree α → α → Tree α → BBTree α

docstring:
Add one black node to the root of a genuine tree: the empty tree becomes
double-black empty, a red root becomes black, and a black root becomes
double black.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α
statement: public def incrBlack {α : Type u} : Tree α → BBTree α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB
statement:
public theorem incrBlack_empty {α : Type u} :
    incrBlack (.empty : Tree α) = .emptyBB

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack_node_black
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack_node_red
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.red left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black left key right)
statement:
public theorem incrBlack_node_red {α : Type u}
    {left right : Tree α} {key : α} :
    incrBlack (.node .red left key right) =
      .regular (.node .black left key right)

docstring: The inorder traversal of a `BBTree`, ignoring the double-black mark.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α → List α
statement: public def inorderBB {α : Type u} : BBTree α → List α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = []
statement:
public theorem inorderBB_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    inorderBB (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = []

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB_incrBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree
statement:

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder left ++ key :: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder right

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB_regular
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree
statement:
public theorem inorderBB_regular {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    inorderBB (.regular tree) = inorder tree

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorder_blacken
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorderBB tree
statement:

docstring: Deleting a key erases it from the inorder traversal of an ordered tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorder_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree) = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree).erase x

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.inorder_rootBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree

docstring: Deletion from an ordered tree removes exactly the deleted key.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.mem_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x y : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → (y ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree ↔ y ∈ tree ∧ y ≠ x)

docstring:
The leftmost key of a tree, if any: its minimum under the search-tree

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.minKey
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Option α
statement: def minKey {α : Type u} : Tree α → Option α

docstring: The deleted key is absent after deletion from an ordered tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.not_mem_deleteBal_self
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → x ∉ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree
statement:
public theorem not_mem_deleteBal_self {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Ordered tree) : x ∉ deleteBal x tree

docstring: Deletion preserves the strict search-tree invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.ordered_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree)
statement:
public theorem ordered_deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Ordered tree) : Ordered (deleteBal x tree)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOkBB_emptyBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.emptyBB = True
statement:
public theorem redOkBB_emptyBB {α : Type u} :
    RedOkBB (.emptyBB : BBTree α) = True

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOkBB_incrBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.incrBlack tree)
statement:

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOkBB_nodeBB
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.nodeBB left key right) = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk left ∧ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk right)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOkBB_regular
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree.regular tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree
statement:
public theorem redOkBB_regular {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    RedOkBB (.regular tree) = RedOk tree

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOk_blacken
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.BBTree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.RedOkBB tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.blacken tree)
statement:
public theorem redOk_blacken {α : Type u} {tree : BBTree α}
    (h : RedOkBB tree) : RedOk (blacken tree)

docstring: Deletion preserves the red invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOk_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree)
statement:
public theorem redOk_deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.redOk_rootBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack tree)
statement:
public theorem redOk_rootBlack {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} (h : RedOk tree) :
    RedOk (rootBlack tree)

docstring: Recolor the root of a genuine tree black.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: public def rootBlack {α : Type u} : Tree α → Tree α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty
statement:
public theorem rootBlack_empty {α : Type u} :
    rootBlack (.empty : Tree α) = .empty

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack_node
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {color : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.rootBlack (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node color left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black left key right

docstring:
Deletion from a valid red-black tree leaves a valid tree. Only the
three structural invariants of `Valid` are used; see
`valid_deleteBal_of_invariants`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.valid_deleteBal
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree)
statement:
public theorem valid_deleteBal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Valid tree) : Valid (deleteBal x tree)

docstring:
Deletion yields a valid tree from the three structural invariants
`Ordered`, `RedOk`, and `Balanced`; the input root need not be black,
since `deleteBal` blackens the root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.valid_deleteBal_of_invariants
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.DeleteBalanced.deleteBal x tree)
statement:
public theorem valid_deleteBal_of_invariants {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    {x : α} {tree : Tree α} (hOrdered : Ordered tree) (hRedOk : RedOk tree)
    (hBalanced : Balanced tree) : Valid (deleteBal x tree)

docstring: Structural membership, inherited from `BinarySearchTree` through `erase`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Mem
signature: {α : Type u} → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Mem {α : Type u} (x : α) (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring:
Every left key is smaller and every right key is larger, recursively; it is
`BinarySearchTree.Ordered` of the color-erased tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered
signature: {α : Type u} → [LT α] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Ordered {α : Type u} [LT α] (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring: The red invariant: no red node has a red child.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def RedOk {α : Type u} : Tree α → Prop

docstring: A red-black tree: each node carries a color, a key, and two subtrees.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: public inductive Tree (α : Type u)

docstring: A valid red-black tree: ordered, red-invariant, balanced, black root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid
signature: {α : Type u} → [LT α] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Prop
statement: public def Valid {α : Type u} [LT α] (tree : Tree α) : Prop

docstring:
`All` on a red-black tree is `BinarySearchTree.All` of its color-erased
tree, by definition.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.all_erase
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.All p tree ↔ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.All p (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase tree)
statement:
public theorem all_erase {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Tree α} :
    All p tree ↔ BinarySearchTree.All p (erase tree)

docstring:
`All` is equivalent to universal quantification over structural
membership; inherited from `BinarySearchTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.all_iff_forall_mem
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.All p tree ↔ ∀ x ∈ tree, p x
statement:
public theorem all_iff_forall_mem {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {tree : Tree α} :
    All p tree ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ tree → p x

docstring: Okasaki's rebalancing: repair a red-red redex below a black node.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.balance
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: def balance {α : Type u} : Color → Tree α → α → Tree α → Tree α

docstring:
Deletion always produces a black-height-balanced tree (unconditional;
see `valid_delete`).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.balanced_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree)
statement:
public theorem balanced_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} : Balanced (delete x tree)

docstring: Insertion preserves black-height balance.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.balanced_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree)
statement:
public theorem balanced_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Balanced tree) : Balanced (insert x tree)

docstring: The number of black nodes on a root-to-leaf path, counting the leaf.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → ℕ
statement: public def blackHeight {α : Type u} : Tree α → Nat

docstring: Insertion preserves `blackHeight` up to the final root recoloring.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree ∨ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.blackHeight tree + 1
statement:
public theorem blackHeight_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} :
    blackHeight (insert x tree) = blackHeight tree ∨
      blackHeight (insert x tree) = blackHeight tree + 1

docstring: The color of the root of a tree; the empty tree counts as black.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color
statement: public def colorOf {α : Type u} : Tree α → Color

docstring: The tree produced by deletion has a black root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.colorOf (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color.black
statement:
public theorem colorOf_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} : colorOf (delete x tree) = .black

docstring: Search a tree by following comparisons from its root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.contains
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Bool
statement: public def contains {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) : Tree α → Bool

docstring:
Search is equivalent to structural membership for an ordered tree;
inherited from `BinarySearchTree` through `erase`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.contains_eq_true_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.contains x tree = Bool.true ↔ x ∈ tree)

docstring:
Unbalanced deletion: delete a key by comparisons, splicing the subtrees of a
deleted node together with `join`. Colors are kept, but `RedOk` and
`Balanced` need not hold of the result; `delete` repairs them.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.del
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: def del {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) : Tree α → Tree α

docstring: Delete a key, leaving a valid red-black tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement:
public def delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) (tree : Tree α) :

docstring: Remove colors, yielding the underlying binary search tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → BinaryTree α
statement: public def erase {α : Type u} : Tree α → BinaryTree α

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty = BinaryTree.nil
statement:
public theorem erase_empty {α : Type u} :
    erase (.empty : Tree α) = .nil

docstring: Recoloring the root black is invisible after erasing colors.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase_makeBlack
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.makeBlack tree) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase tree
statement:
public theorem erase_makeBlack {α : Type u} {tree : Tree α} :
    erase (makeBlack tree) = erase tree

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase_node
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {color : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α} {key : α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node color left key right) = BinaryTree.node key (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase left) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase right)

docstring: Build a tree by inserting the list from right to left.

signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → List α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: public def fromList {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] : List α → Tree α

docstring:
The linear-time inorder traversal of a tree, inherited from
`BinarySearchTree` through `erase`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → List α
statement: public def inorder {α : Type u} (tree : Tree α) : List α

docstring:
Append the inorder traversal of a tree to an existing suffix in linear
time; inherited from `BinarySearchTree` through `erase`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorderAux
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → List α → List α
statement: public def inorderAux {α : Type u} (tree : Tree α) (suffix : List α) : List α

docstring: Deleting a key erases it from the inorder traversal of an ordered tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree) = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree).erase x

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty = []
statement:
public theorem inorder_empty {α : Type u} :
    inorder (.empty : Tree α) = []

docstring:
The inorder traversal of a red-black tree is the `BinarySearchTree`
inorder traversal of its color-erased tree, by definition.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_erase
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase tree)
statement:
public theorem inorder_erase {α : Type u} (tree : Tree α) :
    inorder tree = BinarySearchTree.inorder (erase tree)

docstring: The inorder traversal of a splice appends the two traversals.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_join
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.join left right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder left ++ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder right
statement:
public theorem inorder_join {α : Type u} {left right : Tree α} :
    inorder (join left right) = inorder left ++ inorder right

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_node
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {color : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Color} (key : α) (left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.node color left key right) = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder left ++ key :: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder right
statement:
public theorem inorder_node {α : Type u} {color : Color} (key : α)
    (left right : Tree α) :
    inorder (.node color left key right) =
      inorder left ++ key :: inorder right

docstring: The inorder traversal of an ordered tree has no duplicate keys.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder_nodup
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree).Nodup
statement:
public theorem inorder_nodup {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Ordered tree) : (inorder tree).Nodup

docstring: Unchecked insertion; the result may violate `RedOk` at the root.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ins
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: def ins {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) : Tree α → Tree α

docstring: Insert a key, leaving an existing equal key unchanged.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement:
public def insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) (tree : Tree α) :

docstring:
Splice two trees end to end, keeping every key of the first tree before every

trees stays ordered.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.join
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
