docstring: Recolor the root of a tree black.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.makeBlack
signature: {α : Type u} → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: def makeBlack {α : Type u} : Tree α → Tree α

docstring: Deletion from an ordered tree removes exactly the deleted key.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x y : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → (y ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree ↔ y ∈ tree ∧ y ≠ x)

docstring:
Membership in a red-black tree is `BinarySearchTree` membership in its
color-erased tree, by definition.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_erase
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, x ∈ tree ↔ x ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase tree
statement:
public theorem mem_erase {α : Type u} {x : α} {tree : Tree α} :
    x ∈ tree ↔ x ∈ erase tree

docstring: A key is in a tree built from a list exactly when it is in the list.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_fromList
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {xs : List α}, x ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.fromList xs ↔ x ∈ xs
statement:
public theorem mem_fromList {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α} {xs : List α} :
    x ∈ fromList xs ↔ x ∈ xs

docstring:
Inorder traversal contains exactly the structurally present keys;
inherited from `BinarySearchTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_inorder
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, x ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree ↔ x ∈ tree
statement:
public theorem mem_inorder {α : Type u} {x : α} {tree : Tree α} :
    x ∈ inorder tree ↔ x ∈ tree

docstring: Inserting a key adds exactly that key to structural membership.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x y : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, y ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree ↔ y = x ∨ y ∈ tree
statement:
public theorem mem_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x y : α} {tree : Tree α} :
    y ∈ insert x tree ↔ y = x ∨ y ∈ tree

docstring: A key is in a splice exactly when it is in one of the two parts.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.mem_join
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {x : α} {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, x ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.join left right ↔ x ∈ left ∨ x ∈ right
statement:
public theorem mem_join {α : Type u} {x : α} {left right : Tree α} :
    x ∈ join left right ↔ x ∈ left ∨ x ∈ right

docstring: The deleted key is absent after deletion from an ordered tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.not_mem_delete_self
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → x ∉ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree
statement:
public theorem not_mem_delete_self {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} (hTree : Ordered tree) : x ∉ delete x tree

docstring:
Deletion always produces an ordered tree (unconditional; see
`valid_delete`).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ordered_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree)
statement:
public theorem ordered_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} : Ordered (delete x tree)

docstring:
Ordering of a red-black tree is `BinarySearchTree.Ordered` of its
color-erased tree, by definition.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ordered_erase
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LT α] {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree ↔ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.BinarySearchTree.Ordered (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.erase tree)
statement:
public theorem ordered_erase {α : Type u} [LT α] {tree : Tree α} :
    Ordered tree ↔ BinarySearchTree.Ordered (erase tree)

docstring:
The inorder traversal of an ordered tree is strictly increasing;
inherited from `BinarySearchTree`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ordered_inorder
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 < x2) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.inorder tree)
statement:
public theorem ordered_inorder {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Ordered tree) : List.Pairwise (· < ·) (inorder tree)

docstring: Insertion preserves the strict search-tree invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ordered_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree)
statement:
public theorem ordered_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Ordered tree) : Ordered (insert x tree)

docstring:
Splicing two ordered trees stays ordered when every key of the left tree is
smaller than every key of the right tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.ordered_join
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LT α] {left right : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered left → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered right → (∀ a ∈ left, ∀ b ∈ right, a < b) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.join left right)
statement:
public theorem ordered_join {α : Type u} [LT α] {left right : Tree α}
    (hLeft : Ordered left) (hRight : Ordered right)
    (hSeparated : ∀ a ∈ left, ∀ b ∈ right, a < b) :
    Ordered (join left right)

docstring: Rebuild a valid red-black tree holding exactly the keys of a tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.rebalance
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α
statement: def rebalance {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (tree : Tree α) : Tree α

docstring:
Deletion always produces a tree satisfying the red invariant
(unconditional; see `valid_delete`).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.redOk_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree)
statement:
public theorem redOk_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} : RedOk (delete x tree)

docstring: Insertion preserves the red invariant.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.redOk_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree)
statement:
public theorem redOk_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : RedOk tree) : RedOk (insert x tree)

docstring:
Deletion always produces a valid red-black tree, with no hypothesis on
the input: the result is rebuilt by `fromList`, which is unconditionally
valid.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.valid_delete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.delete x tree)
statement:
public theorem valid_delete {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α}
    {tree : Tree α} : Valid (delete x tree)

docstring: The empty tree is a valid red-black tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.valid_empty
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LT α], Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree.empty
statement: public theorem valid_empty {α : Type u} [LT α] : Valid (.empty : Tree α)

docstring: Building a tree by insertion always produces a valid tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.valid_fromList
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {xs : List α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.fromList xs)
statement:
public theorem valid_fromList {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {xs : List α} :
    Valid (fromList xs)

docstring: Insertion preserves validity of a red-black tree.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.valid_insert
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree)
statement:
public theorem valid_insert {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Tree α}
    (h : Valid tree) : Valid (insert x tree)

docstring:
Insertion yields a valid tree from the three structural invariants
`Ordered`, `RedOk`, and `Balanced`; the input root need not be black,
since `insert` recolors the root black.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.valid_insert_of_invariants
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x : α} {tree : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Tree α}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Ordered tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.RedOk tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Balanced tree → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.Valid (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RedBlackTree.insert x tree)

docstring:
Compute the maximum revenue by saving solutions for lengths `0, ..., n` in increasing order.
One cost tick is charged for each evaluated positive first-piece length.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → [LinearOrder α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ α
statement:
public def bottomUpCutRod {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat α

docstring:
The computed revenue is attained by a whole-rod composition and dominates every such revenue.
This covers signed prices without offering an option to discard any material.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).ret
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition n => compositionRevenue prices parts le_rfl)
      (bottomUpCutRod prices).ret

docstring: The actual candidate count is the triangular number, independent of all prices.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_time {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (bottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2

docstring: Matching quadratic bounds in the stated candidate-evaluation cost model.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_time_bounds
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).time ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).time ≤ n ^ 2
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_time_bounds {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (bottomUpCutRod prices).time ∧ (bottomUpCutRod prices).time ≤ n ^ 2

docstring: The executable evaluates exactly `j` candidates in row `j`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_time_sum
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).time = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), j
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_time_sum {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (bottomUpCutRod prices).time = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), j

docstring: Twice the actual candidate count is `n * (n + 1)`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_time_twice
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), 2 * (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1)
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_time_twice {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    2 * (bottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1)

docstring: Empty input needs no candidate evaluation and earns zero.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] (prices : Vector α 0), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices = Pure.pure 0
statement:
theorem bottomUpCutRod_zero {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    (prices : Vector α 0) : bottomUpCutRod prices = pure 0

docstring:
Revenue obtained by selling every positive block of a rod composition.
The price vector's entry `i - 1` is the price of a piece of length `i`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → {n k : ℕ} → Vector α n → Composition k → k ≤ n → α
statement:
public def compositionRevenue {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] {n k : Nat}
    (prices : Vector α n) (parts : Composition k) (hk : k ≤ n) : α

docstring: Revenue is additive when two whole-rod compositions are concatenated.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue_append
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] {n k l : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (left : Composition k) (right : Composition l) (hkl : k + l ≤ n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices (left.append right) hkl = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices left ⋯ + Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices right ⋯
statement:
public theorem compositionRevenue_append {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    {n k l : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (left : Composition k) (right : Composition l)
    (hkl : k + l ≤ n) :
    compositionRevenue prices (left.append right) hkl =
      compositionRevenue prices left (by omega) +
      compositionRevenue prices right (by omega)

docstring: Selling the rod without a cut earns its supplied price.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue_single
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] {n k : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (hk : k ≤ n) (hpos : 0 < k), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices (Composition.single k hpos) hk = prices[k - 1]
statement:
public theorem compositionRevenue_single {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    {n k : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (hk : k ≤ n) (hpos : 0 < k) :
    compositionRevenue prices (Composition.single k hpos) hk =
      prices[k - 1]'(by omega)

docstring: The empty rod earns zero revenue.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (parts : Composition 0), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯ = 0

docstring:
Compute the saved tables once, then emit each successive saved first cut in source order.
The returned composition sells the whole rod. In addition to candidate events,
one event is charged per emitted positive piece; allocation and arithmetic remain free.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → [LinearOrder α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Composition n)
statement:
public def cutRodSolution {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat (Composition n)

docstring:
Each emitted block is the actual saved first cut for the remainder after earlier blocks.
The successful optional lookup also witnesses that this saved entry is in bounds.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution_blocks
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret.length), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.2[n - (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret.sizeUpTo i - 1]? = Option.some (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret.blocks[i]
statement:
public theorem cutRodSolution_blocks {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < (cutRodSolution prices).ret.length) :
    (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.2[n - (cutRodSolution prices).ret.sizeUpTo i - 1]? =
      some ((cutRodSolution prices).ret.blocks[i]'hi)

docstring: The reconstructed whole-rod composition earns a greatest possible canonical revenue.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret ⋯)
statement:
public theorem cutRodSolution_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition n => compositionRevenue prices parts le_rfl)
      (compositionRevenue prices (cutRodSolution prices).ret le_rfl)

docstring: Following tight saved cuts earns exactly the final saved revenue.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution_revenue
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret ⋯ = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[n]
statement:
public theorem cutRodSolution_revenue {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    compositionRevenue prices (cutRodSolution prices).ret le_rfl =
      (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[n]

docstring: The actual cost is candidate events plus one event for every emitted piece.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2 + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution prices).ret.length
statement:
public theorem cutRodSolution_time {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (cutRodSolution prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2 + (cutRodSolution prices).ret.length

docstring: The empty rod returns the empty canonical composition and charges no events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α], Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.cutRodSolution #v[] = Pure.pure (Composition.ones 0)
statement:
public theorem cutRodSolution_zero {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α] :
    cutRodSolution (#v[] : Vector α 0) = pure (Composition.ones 0)

docstring:
Save all optimal revenues and the first maximizing cut at each positive length.
The source's `r[j]` is the revenue vector's entry `j`; `s[j]` is the cut vector's
entry `j - 1`. Ascending candidates update only on strict improvement.
One event is charged per candidate, including the first candidate of each row.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → [LinearOrder α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Vector α (n + 1) × Vector ℕ n)
statement:
public def extendedBottomUpCutRod {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat (Vector α (n + 1) × Vector Nat n)

docstring: Every saved revenue is attained by a whole-rod composition and dominates all its competitors.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n), IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts hjn) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j]
statement:
public theorem extendedBottomUpCutRod_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n)
    (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition j => compositionRevenue prices parts hjn)
      (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j]

docstring:
The actual saved positive cut attains the row revenue, and every smaller first cut loses.
The witness `i : Fin j` represents the positive piece length `i.val + 1`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod_firstCut
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < j) (hjn : j ≤ n), ∃ i, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.2[j - 1] = ↑i + 1 ∧ prices[↑i] + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j - (↑i + 1)] = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j] ∧ ∀ (h : Fin j), ↑h < ↑i → prices[↑h] + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j - (↑h + 1)] < (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j]
statement:
public theorem extendedBottomUpCutRod_firstCut {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hpos : 0 < j)
    (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    ∃ i : Fin j, (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.2[j - 1]'(by omega) = i.val + 1 ∧
      prices[i.val]'(by omega) +
        (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j - (i.val + 1)]'(by omega) =
        (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j] ∧
      ∀ h : Fin j, h.val < i.val →
        prices[h.val]'(by omega) +
          (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j - (h.val + 1)]'(by omega) <
          (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[j]

docstring: The final saved revenue is exactly the existing bottom-up solver's result.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod_revenue_eq
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[n] = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.bottomUpCutRod prices).ret
statement:
public theorem extendedBottomUpCutRod_revenue_eq {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).ret.1[n] = (bottomUpCutRod prices).ret

docstring: The saved tables execute exactly the triangular number of candidate events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2
statement:
public theorem extendedBottomUpCutRod_time {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (extendedBottomUpCutRod prices).time = n * (n + 1) / 2

docstring: Empty input returns its zero revenue row, no cut entries and no candidate events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] (prices : Vector α 0), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.extendedBottomUpCutRod prices = Pure.pure (Vector.replicate 1 0, Vector.replicate 0 0)
statement:
public theorem extendedBottomUpCutRod_zero {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] (prices : Vector α 0) :
    extendedBottomUpCutRod prices = pure (Vector.replicate 1 0, Vector.replicate 0 0)

docstring: Initialize an unknown cache and invoke the memoized auxiliary on the whole rod.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → [LinearOrder α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ α
statement:
public def memoizedCutRod {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat α

docstring:
Solve the requested length top-down, carrying every recursive cache update.
Known entries are returned immediately, including signed values and length zero.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux
signature: {α : Type u} → [AddCommMonoid α] → [LinearOrder α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → (j : ℕ) → j ≤ n → Vector (Option α) (n + 1) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (α × Vector (Option α) (n + 1))
statement:
public def memoizedCutRodAux {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)) :
    TimeM Nat (α × Vector (Option α) (n + 1))

docstring: An initially unknown cache is filled through the requested length with exact optima.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux_complete
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j), ∃ value, (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn (Vector.replicate (n + 1) Option.none)).ret.2[k] = Option.some value ∧ IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯) value
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRodAux_complete {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ j), ∃ value : α,
      (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn (Vector.replicate (n + 1) none)).ret.2[k]'(by omega) =
        some value ∧
      IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition k =>
        compositionRevenue prices parts (by omega)) value

docstring: A valid supplied cache yields an attained optimum and remains valid after the call.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (value : α), cache[k] = Option.some value → IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts hk) value) → IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts hjn) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.1 ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (value : α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k] = Option.some value → IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts hk) value) ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[j] = Option.some (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.1
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRodAux_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1))
    (hvalid : ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ n) (value : α), cache[k]'(by omega) = some value →
      IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition k => compositionRevenue prices parts hk)
        value) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition j => compositionRevenue prices parts hjn)
      (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.1 ∧
    (∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ n) (value : α),
      (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k]'(by omega) = some value →
        IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition k => compositionRevenue prices parts hk)
          value) ∧
    (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[j]'(by omega) =
      some (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.1

docstring: A known cache entry returns immediately without touching any saved cell.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux_hit
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)) (value : α), cache[j] = Option.some value → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache = { ret := (value, cache), time := 1 }
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRodAux_hit {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)) (value : α)
    (hcache : cache[j]'(by omega) = some value) :
    memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache = ⟨(value, cache), 1⟩

docstring: Known entries and every cell above the requested length are preserved.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux_preserves
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (value : α), cache[k] = Option.some value → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k] = Option.some value) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n), j < k → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k] = cache[k]
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRodAux_preserves {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) (j : Nat) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (cache : Vector (Option α) (n + 1)) :
    (∀ (k : Nat) (hkn : k ≤ n) (value : α), cache[k]'(by omega) = some value →
      (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k]'(by omega) = some value) ∧
    ∀ (k : Nat) (hkn : k ≤ n), j < k →
      (memoizedCutRodAux prices j hjn cache).ret.2[k]'(by omega) = cache[k]

docstring: The top-down memoized result attains and dominates every whole-rod composition revenue.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod prices).ret
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRod_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition n => compositionRevenue prices parts le_rfl)
      (memoizedCutRod prices).ret

docstring: Exact same-execution event count: one per cache probe, candidate, and actual write.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod prices).time = n ^ 2 + 2 * n + 2
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRod_time {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (memoizedCutRod prices).time = n ^ 2 + 2 * n + 2

docstring: The empty uncached rod earns zero with one probe and one actual cache write.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] (prices : Vector α 0), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.memoizedCutRod prices = { ret := 0, time := 2 }
statement:
public theorem memoizedCutRod_zero {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]

docstring:
Evaluate every first cut in increasing order, freshly recomputing every suffix.
One cost tick is charged at every invocation, including the root and empty suffixes.

statement:
public def recursiveCutRod {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α]
    {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat α

docstring:
Recursive CUT-ROD returns an attaining maximum over canonical whole-length
compositions. Negative prices do not create a discard option.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.recursiveCutRod_correct
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts ↦ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.compositionRevenue prices parts ⋯) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.recursiveCutRod prices).ret
statement:
public theorem recursiveCutRod_correct {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun parts : Composition n =>
      compositionRevenue prices parts le_rfl) (recursiveCutRod prices).ret

docstring:
The actual nonmemoized execution enters exactly `2 ^ n` invocations,
including the root and every empty suffix.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.recursiveCutRod_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] {n : ℕ} (prices : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.RodCutting.recursiveCutRod prices).time = 2 ^ n
statement:
public theorem recursiveCutRod_time {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
    [LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (prices : Vector α n) :
    (recursiveCutRod prices).time = 2 ^ n

and otherwise the query recurses into both children.

docstring: Pointwise effect of deleting a successor: only the cell at `y` changes.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.deleteAfter_get
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (y : Fin capacity) (hy : (store.get y).isSome = Bool.true) (z : Fin capacity),
  (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.deleteAfter store y hy).get z =
    if y = z then
      Option.some
        (have __src := (store.get y).get hy;
        { payload := __src.payload, next := ((store.get y).get hy).next.bind fun n ↦ (store.get n).bind fun node ↦ node.next })
    else store.get z
statement:
theorem deleteAfter_get {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat}

      if y = z then
        some { (store.get y).get hy with
          next := ((store.get y).get hy).next.bind
            fun n => (store.get n).bind fun node => node.next }
      else store.get z

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.insertAfter_get
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (y x : Fin capacity) (hy : (store.get y).isSome = Bool.true) (hx : (store.get x).isSome = Bool.true) (z : Fin capacity),

            (have __src := (store.get x).get hx;
            { payload := __src.payload, next := ((store.get y).get hy).next })

      else store.get z

    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity)
    (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (x : Fin capacity)
    (hx : (store.get x).isSome) (z : Fin capacity) (hz : x ≠ z) :
    (prepend store head x hx).1.get z = store.get z

docstring: Pointwise effect of prepending: only the cell at `x` changes.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.prepend_get
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (x : Fin capacity) (hx : (store.get x).isSome = Bool.true) (z : Fin capacity),
  (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.prepend store head x hx).1.get z =
    if x = z then
      Option.some
        (have __src := (store.get x).get hx;
        { payload := __src.payload, next := head })
    else store.get z
statement:
theorem prepend_get {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat}
    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity)
    (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (x : Fin capacity)
    (hx : (store.get x).isSome) (z : Fin capacity) :
    (prepend store head x hx).1.get z =
      if x = z then some { (store.get x).get hx with next := head } else store.get z

docstring:
With at least as much fuel as the represented length, fuel-bounded search
is `List.find?` over the represented identities.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.searchAux_eq_find?
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (target : α) (fuel : ℕ) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (ids : List (Fin capacity)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Represents store head ids → ids.length ≤ fuel → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.searchAux store target fuel head = List.find? (fun i ↦ Decidable.decide (Option.map Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node.payload (store.get i) = Option.some target)) ids
statement:
theorem searchAux_eq_find? {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat} [DecidableEq α]
    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (target : α)
    (fuel : Nat) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (ids : List (Fin capacity))
    (rep : Represents store head ids) (hlen : ids.length ≤ fuel) :
    searchAux store target fuel head =
      ids.find? (fun i => decide ((store.get i).map Node.payload = some target))

docstring: Search agrees with `List.find?` over the represented identities.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search_eq_find?
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Represents store head ids → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search store head target = List.find? (fun i ↦ Decidable.decide (Option.map Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node.payload (store.get i) = Option.some target)) ids
statement:
theorem search_eq_find? {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat} [DecidableEq α]
    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity)
    (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity))
    (rep : Represents store head ids) :
    search store head target =
      ids.find? (fun i => decide ((store.get i).map Node.payload = some target))

docstring: Search fails exactly when no represented payload equals the target.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search_eq_none_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Represents store head ids → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search store head target = Option.none ↔ ∀ i ∈ ids, Option.map Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node.payload (store.get i) ≠ Option.some target)
statement:
theorem search_eq_none_iff {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat} [DecidableEq α]
    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity)
    (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity))
    (rep : Represents store head ids) :
    search store head target = none ↔
      ∀ i ∈ ids, (store.get i).map Node.payload ≠ some target

docstring: A successful search returns a represented identity carrying the target payload.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search_eq_some
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} {capacity : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq α] (store : Vector (Option (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity) (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity)), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Represents store head ids → ∀ {x : Fin capacity}, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.search store head target = Option.some x → x ∈ ids ∧ Option.map Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SinglyLinkedList.Node.payload (store.get x) = Option.some target
statement:
theorem search_eq_some {α : Type u} {capacity : Nat} [DecidableEq α]
    (store : Vector (Option (Node α (Fin capacity))) capacity)
    (head : Option (Fin capacity)) (target : α) (ids : List (Fin capacity))
    (rep : Represents store head ids)
    {x : Fin capacity} (h : search store head target = some x) :
    x ∈ ids ∧ (store.get x).map Node.payload = some target

docstring:
A sparse table over `α`: the underlying data together with its levels of interval
minima, stored as arrays so that entry lookup is random access. The list-level function
`level`, together with `List.min?` of slices of `data.toList`, is the specification.
Arbitrary values of this type need not relate `data` and `levels` at all; the
representation invariant `Valid` ties every stored level to `level data.toList`,
`build` produces valid tables, and query correctness is stated for valid tables.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: structure SparseTable (α : Type u)

docstring:
The representation invariant: every stored level is exactly `level data.toList`,
so a valid table's entries are the interval minima of its own data. Tables built by
`build` are valid (`build_valid`); an arbitrary value such as `⟨#[1], #[#[99]]⟩` is
not, and query correctness below is stated only for valid tables.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.Valid
signature: {α : Type u} → [Min α] → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable α → Prop
statement: def Valid {α : Type u} [Min α] (t : SparseTable α) : Prop

docstring:
Builds the sparse table over `a` with `Nat.log2 a.length + 1` levels. Levels are
built iteratively: a fold threads one retained row through `buildStep`, computing each
level once from its predecessor, and stores the levels in an array. The input array is
bound once (`data`) and shared between level zero and the `data` field.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build
signature: {α : Type u} → [Min α] → List α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable α
statement: def build {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) : SparseTable α

docstring:
One step of the iterative construction: record the current row as the next level and
compute the following row from it. The state is the current row together with the levels
built so far.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.buildStep
signature: {α : Type u} → [Min α] → Array α × Array (Array α) → ℕ → Array α × Array (Array α)
statement:
def buildStep {α : Type u} [Min α] (state : Array α × Array (Array α)) (k : Nat) :
    Array α × Array (Array α)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build_data_toList
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Min α] (a : List α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build a).data.toList = a
statement:
theorem build_data_toList {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) :
    (build a).data.toList = a

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build_levels_toList_map
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Min α] (a : List α), List.map Array.toList (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build a).levels.toList = List.map (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a) (List.range (a.length.log2 + 1))
statement:
theorem build_levels_toList_map {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) :

Entry `i` of level `k`, as an `Option`; `none` when out of range. Both indexes are

statement: def entry {α : Type u} (t : SparseTable α) (k i : Nat) : Option α

signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Min α] (a : List α) {k : ℕ}, k ≤ a.length.log2 → ∀ (i : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build a).entry k i = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a k)[i]?

docstring:
A built table's in-range entry is `List.min?` of its interval slice. The
interval-fit premise alone suffices: it implies `2 ^ k ≤ a.length`, hence the
level bound `k ≤ Nat.log2 a.length`, which is derived internally.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.entry_build_eq_min?
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (a : List α) (k i : ℕ), i + 2 ^ k ≤ a.length → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.build a).entry k i = (List.take (2 ^ k) (List.drop i a)).min?
statement:
theorem entry_build_eq_min? {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (a : List α) (k i : Nat)
    (h : i + 2 ^ k ≤ a.length) :
    (build a).entry k i = ((a.drop i).take (2 ^ k)).min?

signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable α}, t.Valid → ∀ (k i : ℕ), i + 2 ^ k ≤ t.data.toList.length → t.entry k i = (List.take (2 ^ k) (List.drop i t.data.toList)).min?

docstring:
In a valid table, entry `i` of level `k` is the corresponding entry of
`level t.data.toList`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.entry_eq_of_valid
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Min α] {t : Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable α}, t.Valid → ∀ {k : ℕ}, k ≤ t.data.toList.length.log2 → ∀ (i : ℕ), t.entry k i = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level t.data.toList k)[i]?

    (hValid : t.Valid) {k : Nat} (hk : k ≤ Nat.log2 t.data.toList.length)

    t.entry k i = (level t.data.toList k)[i]?

docstring: An in-range level entry is `List.min?` of its interval slice.

signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (a : List α) (k i : ℕ), i + 2 ^ k ≤ a.length → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a k)[i]? = (List.take (2 ^ k) (List.drop i a)).min?

    (h : i + 2 ^ k ≤ a.length) :
    (level a k)[i]? = ((a.drop i).take (2 ^ k)).min?

docstring:
Level `k` of the sparse table over `a`: entry `i` is the minimum of the length-`2 ^ k`
slice of `a` starting at `i`. Only starts whose interval fits in `a` get an entry.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level
signature: {α : Type u} → [Min α] → List α → ℕ → List α
statement: def level {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) : Nat → List α

docstring: Level `k` has one entry per start index whose length-`2 ^ k` interval fits.

statement:
theorem level_length {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) (k : Nat) :

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level_succ
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Min α] (a : List α) (k : ℕ), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a (k + 1) = List.zipWith Min.min (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a k) (List.drop (2 ^ k) (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SparseTable.level a k))

theorem level_succ {α : Type u} [Min α] (a : List α) (k : Nat) :
    level a (k + 1) = List.zipWith min (level a k) ((level a k).drop (2 ^ k))

docstring:
Splay `x` to the root. The search descends as in a binary search tree;
the restructuring pattern-matches the child on the search path, so each
recursive step performs a zig (single rotation), a zig-zig (both
rotations in the same direction, grandparent edge first), or a zig-zag
(rotations in opposite directions, parent edge first). When `x` is
absent, the node where the search stops is what the rotations carry
upward; branches where the splayed grandchild is empty fall back to a
single zig that carries that last visited node one level up.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SplayTree.splay

statement:

    BinaryTree α → BinaryTree α

statement:
public theorem splay_nil {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) :
    splay x (.nil : BinaryTree α) = .nil

docstring: Stack operations used in CLRS's aggregate-analysis sequence.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation
signature: Type u → Type u
statement: public inductive Operation (α : Type u)

docstring: Execute the actual sequence, stopping with an error on an empty POP.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation α) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Option (List α))
statement: public def execute {α : Type u} : List α → List (Operation α) → TimeM Nat (Option (List α))

docstring: Actual successful cost and remaining size account for every pushed element.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute_balance
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (ops : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation α)) (final : List α),
  (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack ops).ret = Option.some final →
    (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack ops).time + final.length =
      stack.length +
        2 *
          List.countP
            (fun op ↦
              match op with
              | Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation.push value => Bool.true
              | x => Bool.false)
            ops
statement:
public theorem execute_balance {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (ops : List (Operation α))
    (final : List α) (h : (execute stack ops).ret = some final) :
    (execute stack ops).time + final.length = stack.length +
      2 * ops.countP (fun op => match op with | .push _ => true | _ => false)

docstring: Sequence POP agrees with the standalone operation, including underflow.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute_pop_eq_bind_pop
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (ops : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation α)),
  Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation.pop :: ops) = do
    let removed ← Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.pop stack
    match removed with
      | Option.none => Pure.pure Option.none
      | Option.some (fst, next) => Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute next ops
statement:
public theorem execute_pop_eq_bind_pop {α : Type u} (stack : List α)
    (ops : List (Operation α)) :
    execute stack (.pop :: ops) = (do
      let removed ← pop stack
      match removed with
      | none => pure none
      | some (_, next) => execute next ops)

docstring: Sequence PUSH agrees with the standalone operation's result and event cost.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute_push_eq_bind_push
signature:
∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (value : α) (ops : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation α)),
  Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation.push value :: ops) = do
    let next ← Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.push stack value
    Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute next ops
statement:
public theorem execute_push_eq_bind_push {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (value : α)
    (ops : List (Operation α)) :
    execute stack (.push value :: ops) = (do
      let next ← push stack value
      execute next ops)

docstring: Every successful sequence costs at most two events per operation plus initial size.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute_time_le
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (ops : List (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.Operation α)) (final : List α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack ops).ret = Option.some final → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.execute stack ops).time ≤ stack.length + 2 * ops.length

docstring: CLRS MULTIPOP; charge one unit for each top element actually removed.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipop
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → ℕ → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (List α)
statement: public def multipop {α : Type u} : List α → Nat → TimeM Nat (List α)

docstring: Integer request interface; nonpositive counts perform no POP.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipopSigned
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → ℤ → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (List α)
statement: public def multipopSigned {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : Int) : TimeM Nat (List α)

docstring: The source's positive-count guard makes nonpositive requests a complete no-op.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipopSigned_of_nonpos
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α), ∀ k ≤ 0, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipopSigned stack k = Pure.pure stack
statement:
public theorem multipopSigned_of_nonpos {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : Int) (hk : k ≤ 0) :
    multipopSigned stack k = pure stack

docstring: The timed loop removes exactly the requested prefix, stopping at empty.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipop_ret
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipop stack k).ret = List.drop k stack
statement:
public theorem multipop_ret {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : Nat) :
    (multipop stack k).ret = stack.drop k

docstring: The actual loop costs one unit per available element in the requested prefix.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipop_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.multipop stack k).time = Min.min stack.length k
statement:
public theorem multipop_time {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (k : Nat) :
    (multipop stack k).time = min stack.length k

docstring: Exact list refinement and selected-event costs, including underflow.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.operations_spec
statement:
theorem operations_spec {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (value : α) :
    push stack value = ⟨value :: stack, 1⟩ ∧
    pop stack = (match stack with
      | [] => ⟨none, 0⟩
      | head :: tail => ⟨some (head, tail), 1⟩) ∧
    top stack = (match stack with
      | [] => ⟨none, 0⟩
      | head :: _ => ⟨some head, 1⟩)

docstring: Return the removed element and remaining stack, or explicit underflow.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.pop
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Option (α × List α))
statement: def pop {α : Type u} : List α → TimeM Nat (Option (α × List α))

docstring: POP refinement and cost do not require an inhabitant of the element type.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.pop_eq
statement:
theorem pop_eq {α : Type u} (stack : List α) :
    pop stack = (match stack with
      | [] => ⟨none, 0⟩
      | head :: tail => ⟨some (head, tail), 1⟩)

docstring: Add a new top element, charging one successful PUSH event.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.push
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (List α)
statement: def push {α : Type u} (stack : List α) (value : α) : TimeM Nat (List α)

docstring: Observe the top without changing the input stack, or explicit underflow.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.top
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Option α)
statement: def top {α : Type u} : List α → TimeM Nat (Option α)

docstring: TOP refinement and cost do not require an inhabitant of the element type.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.Stack.top_eq
statement:
theorem top_eq {α : Type u} (stack : List α) :
    top stack = (match stack with
      | [] => ⟨none, 0⟩
      | head :: _ => ⟨some head, 1⟩)

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess
signature: {σ m : ℕ} → Vector (Fin σ) m → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Vector ℕ σ × Vector ℕ m)
statement:
public def preprocess {σ m : Nat} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) :
    TimeM Nat (Vector Nat σ × Vector Nat m)

docstring:
A bad-character slot is the distance from the last pattern position to the
rightmost occurrence before that position, or the pattern length if absent.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess_badCharacter
signature: ∀ {σ m : ℕ} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) (c : Fin σ), ((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess p).ret.1[↑c] = m ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < m), p[k] ≠ c) ∨ ∃ j, ∃ (hj : j + 1 < m), p[j] = c ∧ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess p).ret.1[↑c] = m - 1 - j ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < m), p[k] = c → k ≤ j
statement:
public theorem preprocess_badCharacter {σ m : Nat} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) (c : Fin σ) :
    ((preprocess p).ret.1[c.val] = m ∧
      ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k + 1 < m), p[k] ≠ c) ∨
    ∃ (j : Nat) (hj : j + 1 < m), p[j] = c ∧
      (preprocess p).ret.1[c.val] = m - 1 - j ∧
      ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k + 1 < m), p[k] = c → k ≤ j

docstring:
The full-match shift is the least positive period of the pattern, so later
matcher stages may continue without discarding overlapping occurrences.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess_fullMatch
statement:
public theorem preprocess_fullMatch {σ m : Nat} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let d := (preprocess p).ret.2[0]
    0 < d ∧ d ≤ m ∧
      (∀ t : Fin m, d ≤ t.val → p[t.val - d] = p[t.val]) ∧
      ∀ e, 0 < e → (∀ t : Fin m, e ≤ t.val → p[t.val - e] = p[t.val]) → d ≤ e

docstring:
A good-suffix slot is the least positive shift preserving the matched suffix
and, when its predecessor overlaps, a different predecessor symbol.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess_goodSuffix
statement:
public theorem preprocess_goodSuffix {σ m : Nat} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) (i : Fin m) :
    let d := (preprocess p).ret.2[i.val]
    0 < d ∧ d ≤ m ∧
      (∀ t : Fin m, i.val < t.val → d ≤ t.val → p[t.val - d] = p[t.val]) ∧
      (d ≤ i.val → p[i.val - d] ≠ p[i.val]) ∧
      ∀ e, 0 < e →
        (∀ t : Fin m, i.val < t.val → e ≤ t.val → p[t.val - e] = p[t.val]) →
        (e ≤ i.val → p[i.val - e] ≠ p[i.val]) → d ≤ e

docstring:
The executed preprocessor's selected-event cost, including alphabet-table
initialization. This is not a word-RAM or bit-cost bound.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess_time_le
signature: ∀ {σ m : ℕ} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess p).time ≤ if m = 0 then σ else σ + 10 * m - 6
statement:
public theorem preprocess_time_le {σ m : Nat} (p : Vector (Fin σ) m) :
    (preprocess p).time ≤ if m = 0 then σ else σ + 10 * m - 6

docstring:
`MatchAt pattern text offset` means that `pattern` is a prefix of `text` starting at the
zero-based `offset`. The explicit bound excludes offsets beyond the end for an empty pattern.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.MatchAt
signature: {α : Type u} → List α → List α → ℕ → Prop
statement: def MatchAt (pattern text : List α) (offset : Nat) : Prop

docstring:
CLRS fourth edition section 32.3, decreasing-candidate row-major construction.
Each actual candidate comparison is charged by its executed equality tests.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition
signature: {A : ℕ} → (pattern : List (Fin A)) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Vector (Fin (pattern.length + 1)) ((pattern.length + 1) * A))
statement:
def computeTransition {A : Nat} (pattern : List (Fin A)) :
    TimeM Nat (Vector (Fin (pattern.length + 1)) ((pattern.length + 1) * A))

docstring: Every actual table entry is the greatest feasible suffix-prefix length.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition_spec
signature: ∀ {A : ℕ} (pattern : List (Fin A)) (q : Fin (pattern.length + 1)) (a : Fin A), IsGreatest {k | k ≤ pattern.length ∧ List.take k pattern <:+ List.take (↑q) pattern ++ [a]} ↑((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition pattern).ret.get ⟨↑q * A + ↑a, ⋯⟩)
statement:
theorem computeTransition_spec {A : Nat} (pattern : List (Fin A))
    (q : Fin (pattern.length + 1)) (a : Fin A) :
    IsGreatest {k : Nat | k ≤ pattern.length ∧ pattern.take k <:+ pattern.take q.val ++ [a]}
      ((computeTransition pattern).ret.get ⟨q.val * A + a.val, by
        calc
          q.val * A + a.val < q.val * A + A := Nat.add_lt_add_left a.isLt _
          _ = (q.val + 1) * A := (Nat.succ_mul q.val A).symm
          _ ≤ (pattern.length + 1) * A :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right A (Nat.succ_le_of_lt q.isLt)⟩).val

docstring: Bound on the actual candidate/comparison/decrement/write event count.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition_time_le
signature: ∀ {A : ℕ} (pattern : List (Fin A)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition pattern).time ≤ 2 * A * (pattern.length + 1) ^ 3
statement:
theorem computeTransition_time_le {A : Nat} (pattern : List (Fin A)) :
    (computeTransition pattern).time ≤ 2 * A * (pattern.length + 1) ^ 3

docstring:
Compute all maximal-prefix lengths using Gusfield's Z-box algorithm.
The first entry is the input length. Cost counts outer visits and actual comparisons.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ
signature: {α : Type u} → [BEq α] → {n : ℕ} → Vector α n → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Vector ℕ n)
statement:
public def computeZ {α : Type u} [BEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) : TimeM Nat (Vector Nat n)

docstring: Every suffix value is bounded even when the executable comparator is not lawful.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_getElem_le
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] {n : ℕ} (input : Vector α n) (i : Fin n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ input).ret[↑i] ≤ n - ↑i
statement:
public theorem computeZ_getElem_le {α : Type u} [BEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) (i : Fin n) : (computeZ input).ret[i.val] ≤ n - i.val

docstring:
Every returned entry is the maximal common-prefix length of its suffix.
The explicit suffix-length bound rules out equality caused by `List.take` truncation.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_prefix_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {n : ℕ} (input : Vector α n) (i : Fin n) (q : ℕ), q ≤ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ input).ret[↑i] ↔ q ≤ n - ↑i ∧ List.take q input.toList = List.take q (List.drop (↑i) input.toList)
statement:
public theorem computeZ_prefix_iff {α : Type u} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) (i : Fin n) (q : Nat) :
    q ≤ (computeZ input).ret[i.val] ↔ q ≤ n - i.val ∧
      input.toList.take q = (input.toList.drop i.val).take q

docstring: Repeated-symbol input returns the whole remaining suffix at every position.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_replicate
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a : α) (n : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ (Vector.replicate n a)).ret = Vector.ofFn fun i ↦ n - ↑i
statement:
public theorem computeZ_replicate {α : Type u} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
    (a : α) (n : Nat) :
    (computeZ (Vector.replicate n a)).ret = Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => n - i.val)

docstring:
A repeated prefix followed by a distinct final symbol preserves every explicit failure.
For total input length `N = n + 1`, this is `3 * N - 4` events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_replicate_push_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a b : α), a ≠ b → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ ((Vector.replicate n a).push b)).time = 3 * n - 1
statement:
public theorem computeZ_replicate_push_time {α : Type u} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
    (a b : α) (hab : a ≠ b) (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (computeZ ((Vector.replicate n a).push b)).time = 3 * n - 1

docstring: Repeated-symbol input executes exactly `n - 1` comparisons as well as its outer visits.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_replicate_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (a : α) (n : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ (Vector.replicate n a)).time = 2 * (n - 1)
statement:
public theorem computeZ_replicate_time {α : Type u} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
    (a : α) (n : Nat) : (computeZ (Vector.replicate n a)).time = 2 * (n - 1)

docstring: Every positive-index visit contributes one event, even a zero-comparison copy.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_time_ge
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] {n : ℕ} (input : Vector α n), n - 1 ≤ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ input).time
statement:
public theorem computeZ_time_ge {α : Type u} [BEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) : n - 1 ≤ (computeZ input).time

docstring: In the declared event model, the algorithm uses at most three events per positive index.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_time_le
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] {n : ℕ} (input : Vector α n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ input).time ≤ 3 * (n - 1)
statement:
public theorem computeZ_time_le {α : Type u} [BEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) : (computeZ input).time ≤ 3 * (n - 1)

docstring: The source's undefined first entry is completed with the full input length.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ_zero
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] {n : ℕ} (input : Vector α n) (h : 0 < n), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeZ input).ret[0] = n
statement:
public theorem computeZ_zero {α : Type u} [BEq α] {n : Nat}
    (input : Vector α n) (h : 0 < n) : (computeZ input).ret[0] = n

docstring: A pattern occurs as an infix exactly when it matches at some bounded offset.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.exists_matchAt_iff_isInfix
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (pattern text : List α), (∃ offset, Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.MatchAt pattern text offset) ↔ pattern <:+: text
statement:
theorem exists_matchAt_iff_isInfix (pattern text : List α) :
    (∃ offset, MatchAt pattern text offset) ↔ pattern <:+: text

docstring:
All overlapping zero-based shifts, including every empty-pattern boundary.
The constructed table is bound once before the one-pass scan.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches
signature: {A : ℕ} → List (Fin A) → List (Fin A) → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (List ℕ)
statement: def finiteAutomatonMatches {A : Nat} (pattern text : List (Fin A)) : TimeM Nat (List Nat)

docstring: The complete increasing list of zero-based shifts, including overlaps and empty boundaries.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches_ret
signature: ∀ {A : ℕ} (pattern text : List (Fin A)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).ret = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.naiveMatches pattern text).ret
statement:
theorem finiteAutomatonMatches_ret {A : Nat} (pattern text : List (Fin A)) :
    (finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).ret = (TimeM.naiveMatches pattern text).ret

docstring: Exact candidate-table work, two events per symbol, and one event per output.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches_time
signature: ∀ {A : ℕ} (pattern text : List (Fin A)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).time = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.computeTransition pattern).time + 2 * text.length + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).ret.length
statement:
theorem finiteAutomatonMatches_time {A : Nat} (pattern text : List (Fin A)) :
    (finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).time =
      (computeTransition pattern).time + 2 * text.length +
        (finiteAutomatonMatches pattern text).ret.length

docstring: The definition of a match at a zero-based offset.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.matchAt_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (pattern text : List α) (offset : ℕ), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.MatchAt pattern text offset ↔ offset ≤ text.length ∧ pattern <+: List.drop offset text
statement:
theorem matchAt_iff (pattern text : List α) (offset : Nat) :
    MatchAt pattern text offset ↔ offset ≤ text.length ∧ pattern <+: text.drop offset

docstring: Canonical deterministic automaton whose transition is the constructed table.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.patternAutomaton
signature: {A : ℕ} → (pattern : List (Fin A)) → Cslib.Automata.DA.FinAcc (Fin (pattern.length + 1)) (Fin A)
statement:
def patternAutomaton {A : Nat} (pattern : List (Fin A)) :
    Cslib.Automata.DA.FinAcc (Fin (pattern.length + 1)) (Fin A)

docstring: The actual canonical automaton state is the greatest suffix-prefix length.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.patternAutomaton_state
signature: ∀ {A : ℕ} (pattern word : List (Fin A)), IsGreatest {k | k ≤ pattern.length ∧ List.take k pattern <:+ word} ↑((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.patternAutomaton pattern).mtr (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.patternAutomaton pattern).start word)

docstring:
The LCP lengths of consecutive entries of an index list, in order. The result
has one entry per adjacent pair.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.adjLcp
signature: {α : Type u} → [DecidableEq α] → List α → List ℕ → List ℕ
statement: def adjLcp (s : List α) : List Nat → List Nat

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.adjLcp_length
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (s : List α) (l : List ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.adjLcp s l).length = l.length - 1
statement:
theorem adjLcp_length (s : List α) (l : List Nat) :
    (adjLcp s l).length = l.length - 1

docstring:
The length of the longest common prefix of two lists. Only equality on
the alphabet is tested, so no order instance is required.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp
signature: {α : Type u} → [DecidableEq α] → List α → List α → ℕ
statement: def lcp : List α → List α → Nat

docstring:
The LCP array of `s`: the LCP length of each pair of adjacent suffixes in
suffix-array order. This is the naïve value by definition; the linear-time Kasai
construction is out of scope.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcpArray
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → List α → List ℕ
statement: def lcpArray (s : List α) : List Nat

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcpArray_length
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (s : List α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcpArray s).length = s.length - 1
statement: theorem lcpArray_length (s : List α) : (lcpArray s).length = s.length - 1

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_comm
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (x y : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x y = Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp y x
statement: theorem lcp_comm (x y : List α) : lcp x y = lcp y x

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_le_left
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (x y : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x y ≤ x.length
statement: theorem lcp_le_left (x y : List α) : lcp x y ≤ x.length

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_le_min
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (x y : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x y ≤ Min.min x.length y.length
statement: theorem lcp_le_min (x y : List α) : lcp x y ≤ min x.length y.length

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_le_right
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (x y : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x y ≤ y.length
statement: theorem lcp_le_right (x y : List α) : lcp x y ≤ y.length

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_nil_left
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (y : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp [] y = 0
statement: theorem lcp_nil_left (y : List α) : lcp ([] : List α) y = 0

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_nil_right

statement: theorem lcp_nil_right (x : List α) : lcp x ([] : List α) = 0

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp_self
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (x : List α), Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x x = x.length
statement: theorem lcp_self (x : List α) : lcp x x = x.length

docstring:
Maximality of `lcp`: `q` is below the longest-common-prefix length
exactly when it fits in both lists and their first `q` elements agree.
In particular clients can derive `q ≤ lcp x y` from prefix agreement
without unfolding the recursion (a constant-zero function would not
satisfy this).
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.le_lcp_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] {x y : List α} {q : ℕ}, q ≤ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcp x y ↔ q ≤ Min.min x.length y.length ∧ List.take q x = List.take q y
statement:
theorem le_lcp_iff {x y : List α} {q : Nat} :
    q ≤ lcp x y ↔ q ≤ min x.length y.length ∧ x.take q = y.take q

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.le_of_mem_adjLcp
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : List α} {l : List ℕ} {k : ℕ}, k ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.adjLcp s l → k ≤ s.length
statement:
theorem le_of_mem_adjLcp {s : List α} {l : List Nat} {k : Nat}
    (h : k ∈ adjLcp s l) : k ≤ s.length

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.le_of_mem_lcpArray
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : List α} {k : ℕ}, k ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.lcpArray s → k ≤ s.length
statement:
theorem le_of_mem_lcpArray {s : List α} {k : Nat} (h : k ∈ lcpArray s) :
    k ≤ s.length

name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.mem_suffixArray_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : List α} {i : ℕ}, i ∈ Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.SuffixArray.suffixArray s ↔ i < s.length

signature: (items : List Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.Knapsack.Item) → ℕ → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.Knapsack.Result items)

docstring:
The returned set is feasible, its reported value is its value sum, and it is globally
optimal among all feasible subsets of the input indices.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.Knapsack.solve_correct
statement:
theorem solve_correct (items : List Item) (capacity : Nat) :
    let result := (solve items capacity).ret
    Feasible items capacity result.chosen ∧
      result.value = totalValue items result.chosen ∧
      ∀ chosen : Finset (Fin items.length),
        Feasible items capacity chosen → totalValue items chosen ≤ result.value

docstring:

costs one additional equality comparison.

Precondition: as for `lowerBound`, `xs` must be sorted (or partitioned at `key`); on an unsorted
array a present key can be missed and the result can be `none`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst?
signature: {α : Type u} → [LinearOrder α] → Array α → α → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ (Option ℕ)
statement: def binarySearchFirst? (xs : Array α) (key : α) : TimeM Nat (Option Nat)

docstring: The membership wrapper returns `none` exactly when `key` is absent.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst?_eq_none_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (xs : Array α) (key : α), Array.Pairwise (fun x y ↦ x ≤ y) xs → ((Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst? xs key).ret = Option.none ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < xs.size), xs[i] ≠ key)
statement:

    (hs : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => x ≤ y)) :
    (binarySearchFirst? xs key).ret = none ↔
      ∀ i (hi : i < xs.size), xs[i] ≠ key

docstring: The membership wrapper returns exactly the first occurrence of `key`.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst?_eq_some_iff
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (xs : Array α) (key : α), Array.Pairwise (fun x y ↦ x ≤ y) xs → ∀ (i : ℕ), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst? xs key).ret = Option.some i ↔ ∃ (hi : i < xs.size), xs[i] = key ∧ ∀ j < i, ∀ (_hjs : j < xs.size), xs[j] < key
statement:
theorem binarySearchFirst?_eq_some_iff (xs : Array α) (key : α)
    (hs : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => x ≤ y)) (i : Nat) :
    (binarySearchFirst? xs key).ret = some i ↔
      ∃ hi : i < xs.size,
        xs[i] = key ∧
          ∀ j (_hj : j < i) (_hjs : j < xs.size), xs[j] < key

docstring: The wrapper adds one comparison exactly when the lower-bound index is valid.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst?_time
signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] (xs : Array α) (key : α), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.binarySearchFirst? xs key).time = (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.lowerBound xs key).time + if (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.lowerBound xs key).ret < xs.size then 1 else 0
statement:
theorem binarySearchFirst?_time (xs : Array α) (key : α) :
    (binarySearchFirst? xs key).time =
      (lowerBound xs key).time + if (lowerBound xs key).ret < xs.size then 1 else 0

signature: ∀ {σ : ℕ} (pattern text : List (Fin σ)), (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.boyerMooreMatches pattern text).time ≤ if pattern.length = 0 then text.length + 1 else if text.length < pattern.length then 0 else σ + text.length + 11 * pattern.length - 6 + (pattern.length + 4) * (text.length - pattern.length + 1)
statement:
public theorem boyerMooreMatches_time_le {σ : Nat} (pattern text : List (Fin σ)) :
    (boyerMooreMatches pattern text).time ≤
      if pattern.length = 0 then text.length + 1
      else if text.length < pattern.length then 0
      else σ + text.length + 11 * pattern.length - 6 +
        (pattern.length + 4) * (text.length - pattern.length + 1)

docstring:
Repeated-symbol inputs realize `m * (n - m + 1)` actual character tests.
The formula also includes conversions, preprocessing and the other selected events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.boyerMooreMatches_time_replicate
signature: ∀ {σ : ℕ} (x : Fin σ) (m n : ℕ), 0 < m → m ≤ n → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.boyerMooreMatches (List.replicate m x) (List.replicate n x)).time = m + n + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess (List.replicate m x).toArray.toVector).time + (m + 4) * (n - m + 1)
statement:
public theorem boyerMooreMatches_time_replicate {σ : Nat} (x : Fin σ) (m n : Nat)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hlen : m ≤ n) :
    (boyerMooreMatches (List.replicate m x) (List.replicate n x)).time =
      m + n + (preprocess (List.replicate m x).toArray.toVector).time +
        (m + 4) * (n - m + 1)

docstring:
A repeated text symbol and a distinct repeated pattern prefix realize two tests
per attempt and pattern-length shifts. Costs are the documented selected events.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.boyerMooreMatches_time_replicate_append
signature: ∀ {σ : ℕ} (a b : Fin σ) (m n : ℕ), a ≠ b → 2 ≤ m → m ≤ n → (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.boyerMooreMatches (List.replicate (m - 1) a ++ [b]) (List.replicate n b)).time = m + n + (Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.StringMatching.BoyerMoore.preprocess (List.replicate (m - 1) a ++ [b]).toArray.toVector).time + 4 * (n / m)
statement:
public theorem boyerMooreMatches_time_replicate_append {σ : Nat} (a b : Fin σ)
    (m n : Nat) (hab : a ≠ b) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hlen : m ≤ n) :
    (boyerMooreMatches (List.replicate (m - 1) a ++ [b]) (List.replicate n b)).time =
      m + n + (preprocess (List.replicate (m - 1) a ++ [b]).toArray.toVector).time +
        4 * (n / m)

docstring: Each actual floor bucket has mean occupancy one under independent continuous uniforms.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.bucketSort_occupancy_mean
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (i : Fin n), (∫ (ω : Fin n → ℝ), ↑(List.countP (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (⌊↑n * x⌋₊ = ↑i)) (Array.ofFn ω).toList) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x ↦ MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume[|Set.Ico 0 1]) = 1
statement:

      (fun x => decide (Nat.floor ((n : ℝ) * x) = i.val)) : ℝ)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => cond (volume : Measure ℝ) (Ico 0 1))) = 1

docstring: Second moment of the actual floor-bucket count under independent continuous uniforms.

signature: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (i : Fin n), (∫ (ω : Fin n → ℝ), ↑(List.countP (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (⌊↑n * x⌋₊ = ↑i)) (Array.ofFn ω).toList) ^ 2 ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x ↦ MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume[|Set.Ico 0 1]) = 2 - 1 / ↑n
statement:
public theorem bucketSort_occupancy_secondMoment {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    (∫ ω : Fin n → ℝ, ((Array.ofFn ω).toList.countP
      (fun x => decide (Nat.floor ((n : ℝ) * x) = i.val)) : ℝ) ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => cond (volume : Measure ℝ) (Ico 0 1))) =

docstring: Variance of the actual floor-bucket count in the continuous product model.
name: Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM.bucketSort_occupancy_variance
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (i : Fin n), ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω ↦ ↑(List.countP (fun x ↦ Decidable.decide (⌊↑n * x⌋₊ = ↑i)) (Array.ofFn ω).toList)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x ↦ MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume[|Set.Ico 0 1]) = 1 - 1 / ↑n
statement:
public theorem bucketSort_occupancy_variance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :

docstring: Sorting the saved buckets yields a globally nondecreasing array.
