name: Cslib.Circuits.BooleanGate
signature: Type
statement: inductive BooleanGate

docstring: Check a full supplied Boolean valuation, visiting every gate and argument.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate
signature: {i g : ℕ} → Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1 → Array Bool → Cslib.Algorithms.Lean.TimeM ℕ Bool
statement:
public def verifyBooleanCertificate {i g : Nat}
    (c : Circuit booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool) : TimeM Nat Bool

docstring: A satisfying input supplies an accepted certificate through the canonical trace.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_complete
signature:
∀ {i g : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1) (input : Fin i → Bool),
  c.eval Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation input 0 = Bool.true →
    have cert := Array.ofFn (c.program.trace Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation input);
    cert.size = i + g ∧ (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).ret = Bool.true

docstring: Acceptance is exactly the full gate equations and true designated output.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_iff
signature: ∀ {i g : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool), (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).ret = Bool.true ↔ cert.size = i + g ∧ (∀ (j : Fin g), (Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation (c.program.lines j).op fun k ↦ cert.getD (↑((c.program.lines j).wires k)) Bool.false) = cert.getD (i + ↑j) Bool.false) ∧ cert.getD (↑(c.outputs 0)) Bool.false = Bool.true
statement:
public theorem verifyBooleanCertificate_iff {i g : Nat}
    (c : Circuit booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool) :
    (verifyBooleanCertificate c cert).ret = true ↔
      cert.size = i + g ∧
      (∀ j : Fin g, booleanInterpretation (c.program.lines j).op
        (fun k => cert.getD ((c.program.lines j).wires k).val false) =
          cert.getD (i + j.val) false) ∧ cert.getD (c.outputs 0).val false = true

docstring: A short accepted valuation exists exactly when the circuit is satisfiable.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_satisfiable_iff
signature: ∀ {i g : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1), (∃ cert, (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).ret = Bool.true ∧ cert.size ≤ i + 2 * g) ↔ ∃ input, c.eval Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation input 0 = Bool.true
statement:
public theorem verifyBooleanCertificate_satisfiable_iff {i g : Nat}
    (c : Circuit booleanSignature i g 1) :
    (∃ cert : Array Bool, (verifyBooleanCertificate c cert).ret = true ∧
      cert.size ≤ i + 2 * g) ↔
      ∃ input : Fin i → Bool, c.eval booleanInterpretation input 0 = true

docstring: An accepted certificate agrees with the canonical trace and makes the output true.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_sound
signature: ∀ {i g : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool), (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).ret = Bool.true → (∀ (w : Cslib.Circuits.Wire i g), c.program.trace Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation (fun k ↦ cert.getD (↑k) Bool.false) w = cert.getD (↑w) Bool.false) ∧ c.eval Cslib.Circuits.booleanInterpretation (fun k ↦ cert.getD (↑k) Bool.false) 0 = Bool.true
statement:
public theorem verifyBooleanCertificate_sound {i g : Nat}
    (c : Circuit booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool)
    (h : (verifyBooleanCertificate c cert).ret = true) :
    (∀ w : Wire i g, c.program.trace booleanInterpretation
      (fun k => cert.getD k.val false) w = cert.getD w.val false) ∧
      c.eval booleanInterpretation (fun k => cert.getD k.val false) 0 = true

docstring: Exact selected-event count, including the rejecting length check.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_time
signature: ∀ {i g : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool), (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).time = if cert.size = i + g then 2 + g + ∑ j, Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature.Arity (c.program.lines j).op else 1
statement:
public theorem verifyBooleanCertificate_time {i g : Nat}
    (c : Circuit booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool) :
    (verifyBooleanCertificate c cert).time =
      if cert.size = i + g then
        2 + g + ∑ j : Fin g, booleanSignature.Arity (c.program.lines j).op
      else 1

docstring: A fixed fan-in bound gives a linear selected-event bound, including rejects.
name: Cslib.Circuits.Circuit.verifyBooleanCertificate_time_le_of_fanInAtMost
signature: ∀ {i g K : ℕ} (c : Cslib.Circuits.Circuit Cslib.Circuits.booleanSignature i g 1) (cert : Array Bool), c.FanInAtMost K → (c.verifyBooleanCertificate cert).time ≤ 2 + (K + 1) * g

docstring: AND visits the nonempty argument vector from left to right.

docstring:
The square matrix-multiplication operation exponent is the aspect-one case. At aspect

signature: (F : Type u) → [Field F] → ENNReal

    ENNReal

docstring: The square operation exponent is definitionally the aspect-one rectangular exponent.

statement:
theorem squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent_def (F : Type u) [Field F] :
    squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent F = rectangularCircuitExponent F 1

docstring: When finite, the square exponent itself is admissible in the every-epsilon sense.

statement:
theorem squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent_endpoint (F : Type u) [Field F]

docstring:
A real upper bound on the square exponent is exactly an every-epsilon family of
actual square matrix-multiplication circuits.
name: Cslib.Complexity.Algebraic.squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent_le_iff
signature: ∀ (F : Type u) [inst : Field F] {w : ℝ}, 0 ≤ w → (Cslib.Complexity.Algebraic.squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent F ≤ ENNReal.ofReal w ↔ Cslib.Complexity.Algebraic.HasRectangularCircuitExponent F 1 w)
statement:
theorem squareMatrixMultiplicationCircuitExponent_le_iff (F : Type u) [Field F]
    {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) :

      HasRectangularCircuitExponent F 1 w

statement:

name: Cslib.Grover.groverStep_angleAmplitude
signature: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (marked : Finset α), marked.Nonempty → markedᶜ.Nonempty → ∀ (φ : ℝ), Cslib.Grover.groverStep marked (Cslib.Grover.angleAmplitude marked φ) = Cslib.Grover.angleAmplitude marked (φ + 2 * Cslib.Grover.groverAngle marked)

theorem groverStep_angleAmplitude {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

name: Cslib.Grover.groverStep_apply
signature: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (marked : Finset α) (ψ : Cslib.Grover.Amplitude α) (x : α), Cslib.Grover.groverStep marked ψ x = 2 * Cslib.Grover.meanAmplitude (Cslib.Grover.phaseOracle marked ψ) - Cslib.Grover.phaseOracle marked ψ x

docstring:
Every finite separable residue-field extension lifts to a finite DVR extension.

This is the essential-surjectivity object-construction stage (prerequisite)
for ATLAS NumberTheoryI N211, Theorem 10.13, not the full N211 target: given
a finite-dimensional separable extension `L` of the residue field, it builds
a finite local DVR `A`-algebra `B` with residue field `L`, without assuming
completeness or Henselianity of `A` and without proving full faithfulness or
the categorical equivalence.

signature: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (L : Type v) [inst_3 : Field L] [inst_4 : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L] [FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L], ∃ B x, ∃ (x_1 : IsDomain B), ∃ x_2, ∃ (_ : Module.Finite A B) (x_4 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B) (x_5 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)), Nonempty (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] L)

    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsDomain B) (_ : Algebra A B)
      (_ : Module.Finite A B) (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B)
      (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)),
      Nonempty (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] L)

local ring is given, any image of its residue class under a residue-field algebra
hom lifts to a root in the target of `minpoly A beta`.

signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : IsDomain B] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [inst_6 : CommRing C] [inst_7 : Algebra A B] [inst_8 : Algebra A C] [Module.Finite A B] [inst_10 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)] [inst_11 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A C)] [Algebra.Etale A B] [inst_13 : HenselianLocalRing C] {beta : B}, A[beta] = ⊤ → ∀ (f : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B →ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] IsLocalRing.ResidueField C), ∃ gamma, (Polynomial.aeval gamma) (minpoly A beta) = 0 ∧ (IsLocalRing.residue C) gamma = f ((IsLocalRing.residue B) beta)
statement:

docstring:
Partial support package: Hom-set bijectivity, finite-local-DVR realization
without an unramifiedness claim, and lifting of residue-field equivalences.
The finrank equalities together with the separable residue extensions supply
the étale hypotheses only for the fixed objects `B₁` and `B₂`.
name: DVRResidue.residueField_partial_equivalence_package_of_isAdicComplete
signature: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] {B₁ B₂ : Type u} [inst_3 : CommRing B₁] [inst_4 : IsDomain B₁] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₁] [inst_6 : CommRing B₂] [inst_7 : IsDomain B₂] [inst_8 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B₂] [inst_9 : Algebra A B₁] [inst_10 : Algebra A B₂] [inst_11 : Module.Finite A B₁] [inst_12 : Module.Finite A B₂] [inst_13 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B₁)] [inst_14 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B₂)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B₁) B₁] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B₂) B₂] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₁)] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₂)], Module.finrank A B₁ = Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₁) → Module.finrank A B₂ = Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₂) → Function.Bijective DVRResidue.residueFieldMapAlgHom ∧ (∀ (L : Type v) [inst_19 : Field L] [inst_20 : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L] [FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L], ∃ B x, ∃ (x_1 : IsDomain B), ∃ x_2, ∃ (_ : Module.Finite A B) (x_4 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B) (x_5 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)), Nonempty (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] L)) ∧ ∀ (e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₁ ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₂), ∃ e', DVRResidue.residueFieldMapAlgHom ↑e' = ↑e ∧ DVRResidue.residueFieldMapAlgHom ↑e'.symm = ↑e.symm
statement:
theorem residueField_partial_equivalence_package_of_isAdicComplete
    (hfin₁ : Module.finrank A B₁ =
      Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₁))
    (hfin₂ : Module.finrank A B₂ =
      Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₂)) :
    Function.Bijective (residueFieldMapAlgHom (A := A) (B := B₁) (C := B₂)) ∧
    (∀ (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L]
      [FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L]
      [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L],
      ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsDomain B) (_ : Algebra A B)
        (_ : Module.Finite A B) (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing B)
        (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)),
        Nonempty (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A] L)) ∧
    (∀ (e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₁ ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField A]
        IsLocalRing.ResidueField B₂),
      ∃ e' : B₁ ≃ₐ[A] B₂,
        residueFieldMapAlgHom e'.toAlgHom = e.toAlgHom ∧
        residueFieldMapAlgHom e'.symm.toAlgHom = e.symm.toAlgHom)

primitive inducer of `χ` agrees with it after transport to the conductor.

statement: def IsCcwConvexPolygon (p : Fin n → P) : Prop

name: EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {n : ℕ} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p : Fin n → P}, EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p → ∀ {i j k : Fin n}, i < j → j < k → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p i) (p j) (p k)).sign = -1
statement:
theorem IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle (hp : IsCcwConvexPolygon p) {i j k : Fin n}

signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {n : ℕ} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p : Fin n → P}, EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p → ∀ {i j k : Fin n}, i < j → j < k → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p j) (p k) (p i)).sign = -1
statement:
theorem IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle' (hp : IsCcwConvexPolygon p) {i j k : Fin n}
    (hij : i < j) (hjk : j < k) : (∡ (p j) (p k) (p i)).sign = -1

name: EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle''
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {n : ℕ} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p : Fin n → P}, EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p → ∀ {i j k : Fin n}, i < j → j < k → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p k) (p i) (p j)).sign = -1
statement:
theorem IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle'' (hp : IsCcwConvexPolygon p) {i j k : Fin n}

name: EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle_finRotate
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {n : ℕ} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p : Fin n → P}, EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p → 3 ≤ n → ∀ (i : Fin n), (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p i) (p ((finRotate n) i)) (p ((finRotate n) ((finRotate n) i)))).sign = -1
statement:
theorem IsCcwConvexPolygon.sign_oangle_finRotate (hp : IsCcwConvexPolygon p)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    (∡ (p i) (p <| finRotate _ i) (p <| finRotate _ (finRotate _ i))).sign = -1

docstring: The statement that a sequence of points form a convex polygon.
name: EuclideanGeometry.IsConvexPolygon
signature: {V : Type u_1} → {P : Type u_2} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] → [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] → [NormedAddTorsor V P] → [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] → [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] → {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → P) → Prop
statement: def IsConvexPolygon {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → P) : Prop

docstring:
`a b c d` are the vertices, in counter-clockwise order, of an isosceles trapezoid: they are in
strictly convex position, the side `ab` is parallel to the side `cd` (the two bases), and the
diagonals `ac` and `bd` have equal length. One pair of parallel sides together with equal
diagonals is the classical characterization of an isosceles trapezoid; in particular it rules
out non-rectangular parallelograms.
name: EuclideanGeometry.IsIsoscelesTrapezoid
signature: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop
statement: def IsIsoscelesTrapezoid (a b c d : ℝ²) : Prop

docstring:
`a b c` are the vertices of a right-angled triangle: the three vertices are pairwise
distinct and the (unoriented) angle at one of the three vertices equals `π / 2`. The
distinctness hypothesis rules out degenerate triples, whose angles can coincide with `π / 2`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.IsRightAngled
signature: {V : Type u_1} → {P : Type u_2} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] → [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] → [NormedAddTorsor V P] → P → P → P → Prop
statement: def IsRightAngled (a b c : P) : Prop

lemma NonCollinearFor.subset {n : ℕ} {S T : Set P} (h : S ⊆ T) (hS : NonCollinearFor n T) :

docstring:
We say a subset `A` of points in the plane is non-trilinear

name: EuclideanGeometry.isCcwConvexPolygon_four
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (A B C D : P), EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon ![A, B, C, D] ↔ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A B C).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B C D).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle C D A).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle D A B).sign = -1
statement:
theorem isCcwConvexPolygon_four (A B C D : P) :
    IsCcwConvexPolygon ![A, B, C, D] ↔
      (∡ A B C).sign = -1 ∧ (∡ B C D).sign = -1 ∧ (∡ C D A).sign = -1 ∧ (∡ D A B).sign = -1

name: EuclideanGeometry.isCcwConvexPolygon_four'
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p : Fin 4 → P}, EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p ↔ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 0) (p 1) (p 2)).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 1) (p 2) (p 3)).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 2) (p 3) (p 0)).sign = -1 ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 3) (p 0) (p 1)).sign = -1
statement:
theorem isCcwConvexPolygon_four' {p : Fin 4 → P} :
    IsCcwConvexPolygon p ↔ (∡ (p 0) (p 1) (p 2)).sign = -1 ∧ (∡ (p 1) (p 2) (p 3)).sign = -1 ∧
    (∡ (p 2) (p 3) (p 0)).sign = -1 ∧ (∡ (p 3) (p 0) (p 1)).sign = -1

name: EuclideanGeometry.isCcwConvexPolygon_one
signature: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : MetricSpace P] [inst_3 : NormedAddTorsor V P] [inst_4 : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] [inst_5 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (p : Fin 1 → P), EuclideanGeometry.IsCcwConvexPolygon p

docstring:

swapped, and may be negative for clockwise ordering.

constant Neumann mode in positive dimension.

signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ EuclideanLaplacian.neumannPolyaEigenvalueBenchmark Ω j

docstring:
The source's Neumann index `j + 2` has the same Weyl benchmark as the
Dirichlet index `j + 1`; in zero-based API indices this is `j + 1` versus `j`.
name: EuclideanLaplacian.neumannPolyaEigenvalueBenchmark_succ
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} (Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (j : ℕ), EuclideanLaplacian.neumannPolyaEigenvalueBenchmark Ω (j + 1) = EuclideanLaplacian.polyaEigenvalueBenchmark Ω j
statement:
theorem neumannPolyaEigenvalueBenchmark_succ {n : ℕ}
    (Ω : Opens (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (j : ℕ) :
    neumannPolyaEigenvalueBenchmark Ω (j + 1) =
      polyaEigenvalueBenchmark Ω j

docstring:

`ωₙ |Ω|`, with exponent `2 / (n : ℝ)`. The one-based numerator is kept explicit
because `NonnegativeDiscreteSpectrum` is zero-based.

docstring: Farey neighbors have determinant one.
name: Farey.IsFareyNeighbor.det_eq_one
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ} {x y : ℚ}, Farey.IsFareyNeighbor n x y → y.num * ↑x.den = x.num * ↑y.den + 1

theorem IsFareyNeighbor.mediant_not_mem {n : ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (h : IsFareyNeighbor n x y) : mediant x y ∉ fareyFinset n

    IsFareyNeighbor n x y

docstring:
`F_(n+1)` is `F_n` together with the mediants of the Farey pairs whose
denominators sum to `n + 1`.
name: Farey.farey_succ_generation
signature: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ Farey.fareyFinset (n + 1) ↔ q ∈ Farey.fareyFinset n ∨ ∃ x y, Farey.IsFareyNeighbor n x y ∧ x.den + y.den = n + 1 ∧ q = Farey.mediant x y
statement:
theorem farey_succ_generation {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (q : ℚ) :
    q ∈ fareyFinset (n + 1) ↔
      q ∈ fareyFinset n ∨
        ∃ x y : ℚ, IsFareyNeighbor n x y ∧ x.den + y.den = n + 1 ∧ q = mediant x y

theorem isFareyNeighbor_iff_det_and_sum {n : ℕ} {x y : ℚ}

docstring:
Integer solutions of `x ^ 2 - x * y - y ^ 2 = ±1` via integer-indexed
    Fibonacci numbers: `x ^ 2 - x * y - y ^ 2 = 1` or `= -1` iff there exist
    `n s : ℤ` with `s = 1` or `s = -1` such that `x = s * Int.fib n` and
    `y = s * Int.fib (n - 1)`.

      Equations via Fibonacci and Lucas Numbers”, Journal of Integer Sequences
      12 (2009), Article 09.8.7.

docstring:
If a finite set `A ⊆ ℕ` lies below `a`, is invariant under `x ↦ a - x`,
and every value through `a` is a sum of two elements of `A`, then every value
through `2 * a` is such a sum.

This is Rohrbach's theorem on symmetric restricted additive bases.

Source: Jukka Kohonen, "A Meet-in-the-Middle Algorithm for Finding Extremal
Restricted Additive 2-Bases", Journal of Integer Sequences 17 (2014), Article
14.6.8, theorem `theorem:symmrest`, lines 274–288, with notation and basis
definitions at lines 226–248,
<https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/journals/JIS/VOL17/Kohonen2/kohonen5.tex>.
name: Finset.exists_add_eq_of_image_sub_eq_self
signature: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ), Finset.image (fun x ↦ a - x) A = A → (∀ m ≤ a, ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, x + y = m) → ∀ m ≤ 2 * a, ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, x + y = m
statement:
theorem exists_add_eq_of_image_sub_eq_self (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ)
    (hsymm : A.image (fun x => a - x) = A)
    (hadmissible : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ a → ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, x + y = m) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 * a → ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, x + y = m

theorem FractionalIdeal.exists_elem_eq_valuation_at_primes

docstring: Extension commutes with division for a nonzero denominator over a Noetherian base ring.
name: FractionalIdeal.extendedHom_div
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : CommRing B] [inst_3 : IsDomain B] [inst_4 : Field K] [inst_5 : Algebra A B] [inst_6 : Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [inst_7 : Algebra A K] [inst_8 : Algebra B K] [IsScalarTower A B K] [inst_10 : IsFractionRing A K] [inst_11 : IsFractionRing B K] [IsNoetherianRing A] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B] (I J : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors A) K), J ≠ 0 → (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) (I / J) = (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) I / (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) J
statement:
theorem extendedHom_div [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B] (I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    extendedHom K B (I / J) = extendedHom K B I / extendedHom K B J

docstring: Extension commutes with division for a nonzero finitely generated denominator.
name: FractionalIdeal.extendedHom_div_of_fg
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : CommRing B] [inst_3 : IsDomain B] [inst_4 : Field K] [inst_5 : Algebra A B] [inst_6 : Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [inst_7 : Algebra A K] [inst_8 : Algebra B K] [IsScalarTower A B K] [inst_10 : IsFractionRing A K] [inst_11 : IsFractionRing B K] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B] (I J : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors A) K), J ≠ 0 → (↑J).FG → (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) (I / J) = (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) I / (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom K B) J
statement:
theorem extendedHom_div_of_fg (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B]
    (I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) (hJ0 : J ≠ 0) (hJ : (J : Submodule A K).FG) :
    extendedHom K B (I / J) = extendedHom K B I / extendedHom K B J

docstring:
ATLAS N241, canonical-localization scope: extension of the trace-dual fractional
ideal commutes with localization at `S`. That is, extending `dual A K 1` from `B` to
`SB` gives `dual Aₛ K 1`. Transport to an arbitrary base localization is deferred.
name: FractionalIdeal.extendedHom_dual_one_eq_dual_one_ofField
signature: ∀ (A : Type u_1) (K : Type u_2) (L : Type u) (B : Type u_3) [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : CommRing B] [inst_3 : Field L] [inst_4 : Algebra A K] [inst_5 : Algebra B L] [inst_6 : Algebra A B] [inst_7 : Algebra K L] [inst_8 : Algebra A L] [inst_9 : IsScalarTower A K L] [inst_10 : IsScalarTower A B L] [inst_11 : IsFractionRing A K] [inst_12 : FiniteDimensional K L] [inst_13 : IsIntegralClosure B A L] [inst_14 : Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [inst_15 : IsFractionRing B L] [inst_16 : IsDedekindDomain A] [inst_17 : IsDedekindDomain B] (S : Submonoid A) (hS : S ≤ nonZeroDivisors A) (SB : Type u_4) [inst_18 : CommRing SB] [inst_19 : Algebra B SB] [IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B S) SB] [inst_21 : Algebra (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) SB] [inst_22 : Algebra SB L] [IsScalarTower B SB L] [IsScalarTower A (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) L] [inst_25 : IsScalarTower (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) SB L] [inst_26 : IsScalarTower (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) K L] [inst_27 : IsFractionRing SB L] [inst_28 : IsDedekindDomain SB] [inst_29 : Module.IsTorsionFree B SB] [inst_30 : IsIntegralClosure SB (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) L], (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom L SB) (FractionalIdeal.dual A K 1) = FractionalIdeal.dual (↥(Localization.subalgebra.ofField K S hS)) K 1
statement:
theorem extendedHom_dual_one_eq_dual_one_ofField :
    extendedHom L SB (dual A K (1 : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors B) L)) =
      dual Aₛ K (1 : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors SB) L)

docstring:
The bundled multiplicative equivalence between unit fractional ideals and
finitely supported prime-exponent functions.
name: FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv
signature: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDedekindDomain R] → (K : Type u_2) → [inst_2 : Field K] → [inst_3 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ ≃* Multiplicative (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)
statement:
noncomputable def factorizationMulEquiv :
    (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ ≃* Multiplicative (HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)

name: FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv_apply
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (u : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), (Multiplicative.toAdd ((FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K) u)) v = FractionalIdeal.count K v ↑u
statement:
theorem factorizationMulEquiv_apply (u : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (factorizationMulEquiv K u) v =
      count K v (u : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

docstring: Factorization characteristic of the prime unit: it is the basis vector at `v`.
name: FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv_primeUnitFractionalIdeal
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), Multiplicative.toAdd ((FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K) (NumberField.primeUnitFractionalIdeal v)) = fun₀ | v => 1
statement:
theorem _root_.FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv_primeUnitFractionalIdeal
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K
      (primeUnitFractionalIdeal v)) = Finsupp.single v 1

docstring: The image of a prime ideal is the corresponding basis exponent function.
name: FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv_prime_self
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), Multiplicative.toAdd ((FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K) (Units.mk0 ↑w.asIdeal ⋯)) = fun₀ | w => 1
statement:
theorem factorizationMulEquiv_prime_self (w : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (factorizationMulEquiv K
          (Units.mk0 _ (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr w.ne_bot))) =
      Finsupp.single w 1

name: FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv_symm_val
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (e : Multiplicative (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)), ↑((FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K).symm e) = (Multiplicative.toAdd e).prod fun v n ↦ ↑v.asIdeal ^ n
statement:
theorem factorizationMulEquiv_symm_val (e : Multiplicative (HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)) :
    ((↑((factorizationMulEquiv K).symm e) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)) =
      (Multiplicative.toAdd e).prod (fun v n => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ n)

docstring: The finite product of prime powers prescribed by `e` is nonzero.
name: FractionalIdeal.finsuppProd_ne_zero
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (e : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ), (e.prod fun v n ↦ ↑v.asIdeal ^ n) ≠ 0
statement:
theorem finsuppProd_ne_zero (e : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    e.prod (fun v n => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ n) ≠ 0

docstring: Reconstruction of a unit fractional ideal from prime exponents.
name: FractionalIdeal.finsuppToUnits
signature: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDedekindDomain R] → (K : Type u_2) → [inst_2 : Field K] → [inst_3 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ
statement:
noncomputable def finsuppToUnits (e : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ

name: FractionalIdeal.finsuppToUnits_val
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (e : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ), ↑(FractionalIdeal.finsuppToUnits K e) = e.prod fun v n ↦ ↑v.asIdeal ^ n
statement:
theorem finsuppToUnits_val (e : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    (↑(finsuppToUnits K e) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) =
      e.prod (fun v n => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ n)

docstring: The `MulSemiringAction` on fractional ideals induced by that on the base ring.
name: FractionalIdeal.instMulSemiringAction
signature: {G : Type u_3} → {R : Type u_4} → {K : Type u_5} → [inst : Group G] → [inst_1 : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → [inst_3 : CommRing K] → [inst_4 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → [MulSemiringAction G R] → MulSemiringAction G (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)
statement:
noncomputable instance instMulSemiringAction :
    MulSemiringAction G (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

docstring: The unit fractional ideal is prime to every ideal.
name: FractionalIdeal.isPrimeTo_one
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] (J : Ideal A), FractionalIdeal.IsPrimeTo 1 J
statement:
theorem isPrimeTo_one (J : Ideal A) :
    IsPrimeTo (1 : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) J

docstring:
Membership in a translated fractional ideal is tested after applying the inverse
fraction-field automorphism.
name: FractionalIdeal.mem_smul_iff
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsDomain R] [inst_3 : CommRing K] [inst_4 : Algebra R K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_6 : MulSemiringAction G R] (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K) (x : K), x ∈ g • I ↔ (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv ((MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R) g)).symm x ∈ I
statement:
theorem mem_smul_iff (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (x : K) :
    x ∈ g • I ↔
      (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv
        (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R g)).symm x ∈ I

docstring: Membership in a translated fractional ideal via a forward witness.
name: FractionalIdeal.mem_smul_iff_exists
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsDomain R] [inst_3 : CommRing K] [inst_4 : Algebra R K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_6 : MulSemiringAction G R] (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K) (x : K), x ∈ g • I ↔ ∃ y ∈ I, (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv ((MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R) g)) y = x
statement:
theorem mem_smul_iff_exists (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (x : K) :
    x ∈ g • I ↔ ∃ y ∈ I,
      IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv
        (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R g) y = x

docstring: Membership in unitsPrimeTo is the prime-to condition on the underlying fractional ideal.
name: FractionalIdeal.mem_unitsPrimeTo_iff
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] {J : Ideal A} {u : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors A) (FractionRing A))ˣ}, u ∈ FractionalIdeal.unitsPrimeTo J ↔ (↑u).IsPrimeTo J
statement:
theorem mem_unitsPrimeTo_iff {J : Ideal A}
    {u : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ} :
    u ∈ unitsPrimeTo J ↔
      (u : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)).IsPrimeTo J

name: FractionalIdeal.mem_unitsSupportFinset
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (u : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), v ∈ FractionalIdeal.unitsSupportFinset K u ↔ FractionalIdeal.count K v ↑u ≠ 0
statement:
theorem mem_unitsSupportFinset (u : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    v ∈ unitsSupportFinset K u ↔ count K v (u : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ≠ 0

docstring: Nonzero divisors remain nonzero after mapping to the localization at a prime.
name: FractionalIdeal.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_algebraMap_atPrime
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] (p : Ideal A) [inst_1 : p.IsPrime], nonZeroDivisors A ≤ Submonoid.comap (Algebra.algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)) (nonZeroDivisors (Localization.AtPrime p))
statement:
theorem nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_algebraMap_atPrime
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] :
    A⁰ ≤ Submonoid.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (Localization.AtPrime p)⁰

docstring: Ring automorphisms of `R` act on fractional ideals via `ringEquivOfRingEquiv`.
name: FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquivHom
signature: (R : Type u_1) → (K : Type u_2) → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → [inst_2 : CommRing K] → [inst_3 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → RingAut R →* RingAut (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)
statement:
noncomputable def ringEquivOfRingEquivHom :
    RingAut R →* RingAut (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

docstring: The action on an integral ideal agrees with the induced fractional-ideal action.
name: FractionalIdeal.smul_coeIdeal
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsDomain R] [inst_3 : CommRing K] [inst_4 : Algebra R K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_6 : MulSemiringAction G R] (g : G) (I : Ideal R), g • ↑I = ↑(g • I)
statement:
theorem smul_coeIdeal (g : G) (I : Ideal R) :
    g • (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) =
      ((g • I : Ideal R) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

docstring: The action on a fractional ideal is induced by the corresponding base-ring automorphism.
name: FractionalIdeal.smul_def
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsDomain R] [inst_3 : CommRing K] [inst_4 : Algebra R K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_6 : MulSemiringAction G R] (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K), g • I = (FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv K K ((MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R) g)) I
statement:
theorem smul_def (g : G) (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) :
    g • I =
      FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv K K
        (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut G R g) I

docstring: Reconstruction at a single prime power recovers the prime power.
name: FractionalIdeal.symm_single_zpow
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (n : ℤ), ↑((FractionalIdeal.factorizationMulEquiv K).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd fun₀ | w => n)) = ↑w.asIdeal ^ n
statement:
theorem symm_single_zpow (w : HeightOneSpectrum R) (n : ℤ) :
    (↑((factorizationMulEquiv K).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd (Finsupp.single w n))) :
      FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = (w.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ n

docstring: Reconstruction after taking exponents is the identity.
name: FractionalIdeal.toUnits_left_inv
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (u : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ), FractionalIdeal.finsuppToUnits K (FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K u) = u
statement:
theorem toUnits_left_inv (u : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    finsuppToUnits K (unitsToFinsupp K u) = u

docstring: Taking exponents after reconstruction is the identity.
name: FractionalIdeal.toUnits_right_inv
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (e : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ), FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K (FractionalIdeal.finsuppToUnits K e) = e
statement:
theorem toUnits_right_inv (e : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    unitsToFinsupp K (finsuppToUnits K e) = e

docstring: The prime-to subgroups are monotone in the ideal.

signature: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDedekindDomain R] → (K : Type u_2) → [inst_2 : Field K] → [inst_3 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ → Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R)

docstring: The prime exponents of a unit fractional ideal, as a finitely supported function.
name: FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp
signature: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDedekindDomain R] → (K : Type u_2) → [inst_2 : Field K] → [inst_3 : Algebra R K] → [IsFractionRing R K] → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ
statement:
noncomputable def unitsToFinsupp (u : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ

name: FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp_apply
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (u : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), (FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K u) v = FractionalIdeal.count K v ↑u
statement:
theorem unitsToFinsupp_apply (u : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :

docstring: Valuations add under multiplication of fractional ideals.
name: FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp_mul
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (u v : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ), FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K (u * v) = FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K u + FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp K v
statement:
theorem unitsToFinsupp_mul (u v : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    unitsToFinsupp K (u * v) = unitsToFinsupp K u + unitsToFinsupp K v

name: FractionalIdeal.unitsToFinsupp_one

statement: theorem unitsToFinsupp_one : unitsToFinsupp K (1 : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) = 0

docstring: The action on invertible fractional ideals agrees with the ambient action.
name: FractionalIdeal.units_smul_val
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsDomain R] [inst_3 : CommRing K] [inst_4 : Algebra R K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_6 : MulSemiringAction G R] (g : G) (I : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K)ˣ), ↑(g • I) = g • ↑I

    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin A {π} = ⊤) :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap (A ⧸ q.comap (algebraMap A B)) (B ⧸ q))

docstring:
Canonical residue-ring equivalence at a maximal ideal `q` coprime to a
denominator-clearing ideal `c`: the map induced by `algebraMap O B` is an
isomorphism `O ⧸ q.comap (algebraMap O B) ≃+* B ⧸ q`.
name: Ideal.quotient_coprime_residue_equiv
signature: {O : Type u_1} → {B : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing O] → [inst_1 : CommRing B] → [inst_2 : Algebra O B] → (q : Ideal B) → [q.IsMaximal] → (c : Ideal B) → ¬c ≤ q → (∀ x ∈ c, ∀ (b : B), ∃ o, (Algebra.algebraMap O B) o = x * b) → O ⧸ Ideal.comap (Algebra.algebraMap O B) q ≃+* B ⧸ q

docstring:
The canonical equivalence sends residue classes to residue classes along
`algebraMap O B`.
name: Ideal.quotient_coprime_residue_equiv_apply_mk
signature: ∀ {O : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing O] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra O B] (q : Ideal B) [inst_3 : q.IsMaximal] (c : Ideal B) (hc : ¬c ≤ q) (hclear : ∀ x ∈ c, ∀ (b : B), ∃ o, (Algebra.algebraMap O B) o = x * b) (o : O), (q.quotient_coprime_residue_equiv c hc hclear) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.comap (Algebra.algebraMap O B) q)) o) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) ((Algebra.algebraMap O B) o)
statement:
theorem quotient_coprime_residue_equiv_apply_mk (hc : ¬ c ≤ q)
    (hclear : ∀ x ∈ c, ∀ b : B, ∃ o : O, algebraMap O B o = x * b) (o : O) :
    quotient_coprime_residue_equiv q c hc hclear (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ o) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap O B o)

docstring: A prime splits completely iff its decomposition group is trivial.
name: Ideal.stabilizer_eq_bot_iff_ncard_primesOver_eq_card
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] {G : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Group G] [Finite G] [inst_5 : MulSemiringAction G B] [SMulCommClass G A B] [Algebra.IsInvariant A B G] {p : Ideal A} {P : Ideal B} [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p], MulAction.stabilizer G P = ⊥ ↔ (p.primesOver B).ncard = Nat.card G
statement:
theorem stabilizer_eq_bot_iff_ncard_primesOver_eq_card :
    MulAction.stabilizer G P = ⊥ ↔ (primesOver p B).ncard = Nat.card G

theorem tribonacciWordApprox_add_three (n : Nat) :

theorem tribonacciWordApprox_length_add_three (n : Nat) :

docstring:
A two-sided integer sequence with constant second difference two is the expected monic
quadratic once its values at `0` and `-1` are known.
name: Int.eq_quadratic_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem eq_quadratic_of_recurrence (d : ℤ → ℤ) (q N : ℤ)
    (hrec : ∀ n, d (n - 1) + d (n + 1) = 2 * d n + 2)
    (hzero : d 0 = q) (hnegOne : d (-1) = N) (n : ℤ) :
    d n = n ^ 2 + (q + 1 - N) * n + q

docstring:
Factorial form of the recovery identity: `(p-1)! = p * W(p) - 1`.

Equivalent to `mul_wilsonQuotient` with the `+1` moved, matching the
display `(p-1)! = -1 + p * w_p` from Avitabile–Mattarei `AH.tex` ll. 315–321.

    (Nat.factorial (p - 1) : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) * wilsonQuotient p - 1

docstring:

coprime to `p`. Integrality follows from `Int.prime_dvd_pow_sub_one`.
Proof arguments `_hp` and `_ha` are retained to enforce the domain
restriction to prime moduli and coprime integers, though the computed
value is independent of witnesses.
name: Int.fermatQuotient

def fermatQuotient (p : ℕ) (_hp : Nat.Prime p) (a : ℤ)
    (_ha : IsCoprime a (p : ℤ)) : ℤ

docstring: Evaluation formula for the Fermat quotient.
name: Int.fermatQuotient_eq

docstring:
Exact recovery: `p * W(p) = (p-1)! + 1` for a prime `p`.

This is the `ℤ`-form of the identity `(p-1)! = -1 + p * w_p` used in
Avitabile–Mattarei 2308.16034, `AH.tex` ll. 315–321. By Wilson's theorem the
division in `wilsonQuotient` is exact, so multiplying back recovers the numerator.
name: Int.mul_wilsonQuotient
signature: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ↑p * Int.wilsonQuotient p = ↑(p - 1).factorial + 1
statement:
theorem mul_wilsonQuotient (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    (p : ℤ) * wilsonQuotient p = (Nat.factorial (p - 1) : ℤ) + 1

docstring: Exact recovery: `p * q_p(a) = a ^ (p - 1) - 1`.
name: Int.natCast_mul_fermatQuotient
signature: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (a : ℤ) (ha : IsCoprime a ↑p), ↑p * Int.fermatQuotient p hp a ha = a ^ (p - 1) - 1
statement:
theorem natCast_mul_fermatQuotient (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (a : ℤ)
    (ha : IsCoprime a (p : ℤ)) :
    (p : ℤ) * fermatQuotient p hp a ha = a ^ (p - 1) - 1

    (hnotTwoZeros : ∀ n : ℤ,
      n ^ 2 + a * n + q = 0 → (n + 1) ^ 2 + a * (n + 1) + q = 0 → False) :
    a ^ 2 ≤ 4 * q

docstring:
An intermediate field is finite unramified relative to `A` if it is finite over `K` and its
`A`-integral closure is formally unramified over `A`.
name: IntermediateField.IsFiniteUnramified
signature: (A : Type u_4) → {K : Type u_5} → {L : Type u_6} → [inst : CommRing A] → [inst_1 : Field K] → [inst_2 : Field L] → [inst_3 : Algebra A K] → [inst_4 : Algebra A L] → [inst_5 : Algebra K L] → [IsScalarTower A K L] → IntermediateField K L → Prop
statement:
def IsFiniteUnramified (A : Type*) {K L : Type*} [CommRing A] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (E : IntermediateField K L) : Prop

docstring: Finite unramifiedness is stable under `K`-automorphisms of `L`.
name: IntermediateField.IsFiniteUnramified.map
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Field L] [inst_3 : Algebra A K] [inst_4 : Algebra A L] [inst_5 : Algebra K L] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower A K L] {E : IntermediateField K L}, IntermediateField.IsFiniteUnramified A E → ∀ (σ : Gal(L/K)), IntermediateField.IsFiniteUnramified A (IntermediateField.map (↑σ) E)

docstring: Each qualifying intermediate field lies below the maximal one.

docstring:
The maximal unramified subextension, defined as the
supremum of all finite unramified intermediate fields. The supremum need not itself be finite or
formally unramified.

signature: (A : Type u_4) → (K : Type u_5) → (L : Type u_6) → [inst : CommRing A] → [inst_1 : Field K] → [inst_2 : Field L] → [inst_3 : Algebra A K] → [inst_4 : Algebra A L] → [inst_5 : Algebra K L] → [IsScalarTower A K L] → IntermediateField K L
statement:
noncomputable def maximalUnramifiedSubextension (A K L : Type*) [CommRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra A K] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] : IntermediateField K L

docstring: Containment in an arbitrary intermediate field is tested on qualifiers.
name: IntermediateField.maximalUnramifiedSubextension_le_iff
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Field L] [inst_3 : Algebra A K] [inst_4 : Algebra A L] [inst_5 : Algebra K L] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower A K L] {F : IntermediateField K L}, IntermediateField.maximalUnramifiedSubextension A K L ≤ F ↔ ∀ (E : IntermediateField K L), IntermediateField.IsFiniteUnramified A E → E ≤ F
statement:
theorem maximalUnramifiedSubextension_le_iff {F : IntermediateField K L} :
    maximalUnramifiedSubextension A K L ≤ F ↔
      ∀ E : IntermediateField K L, IsFiniteUnramified A E → E ≤ F

docstring:

docstring:
The inverse limit set is closed in the product when every factor is
Hausdorff and every transition map is continuous. Each compatibility equation
`f h (x j) = x i` cuts out a closed set by `isClosed_eq`, and the limit is the
intersection of all of them.
name: InverseLimit.isClosed_carrier
signature: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] [∀ (i : ι), T2Space (X i)] {f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → X j → X i}, (∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄ (h : i ≤ j), Continuous (f h)) → IsClosed (InverseLimit.carrier f)
statement:
theorem isClosed_carrier [∀ i, T2Space (X i)]
    {f : ∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄, i ≤ j → X j → X i}
    (hf : ∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄ (h : i ≤ j), Continuous (f h)) :
    IsClosed (carrier f)

docstring:
The inverse limit set is compact in the product when every factor is

theorem isCompact_carrier [∀ i, CompactSpace (X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (X i)]

    (hf : ∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄ (h : i ≤ j), Continuous (f h)) :
    IsCompact (carrier f)

docstring: Membership in the inverse limit is exactly the compatibility condition.

definition of a CAT(0) space.

docstring:
A finite free `R`-module whose topology is transported from `R`, equipped with a continuous
semilinear action of the topological group `G`.

This is the object-level content of Definition `defsemilinrep` in arXiv:2608.00845, lines
1947–1950. The inherited `SMulDistribClass G R M` is the semilinearity identity
`g • (r • x) = (g • r) • (g • x)`.

    [ContinuousSMul G R] [ContinuousSMul G M] [ContinuousSMul R M] : Prop

signature: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v))
statement:
theorem finite_residueField (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (v.adicCompletionIntegers K))

docstring:
The degree of a finite-place completion equals the product of the corresponding
ramification index and inertia degree.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.finrank_adicCompletion_eq_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [inst_5 : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal], Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion L w) = w.asIdeal.ramificationIdx (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) * w.asIdeal.inertiaDeg (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)
statement:
theorem finrank_adicCompletion_eq_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg :
    Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K) (w.adicCompletion L) =
      w.asIdeal.ramificationIdx (𝓞 K) * w.asIdeal.inertiaDeg (𝓞 K)

docstring:
The local degree at a finite place lying over `v` is bounded by the
global degree.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.finrank_adicCompletion_le
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [inst_5 : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal], Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion L w) ≤ Module.finrank K L
statement:
theorem finrank_adicCompletion_le :
    Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K) (w.adicCompletion L) ≤
      Module.finrank K L

docstring: The source and target of the completion tensor-product map have equal dimension.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.finrank_completionTensorProduct_eq_pi
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) (TensorProduct K (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) L) = Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ((w : v.placesOver L) → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion L ↑w)
statement:
theorem finrank_completionTensorProduct_eq_pi :
    Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K) (v.adicCompletion K ⊗[K] L) =
      Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K)
        ((w : v.placesOver L) → w.val.adicCompletion L)

docstring:
The canonical map on finite-place completion integer rings preserves the
inertia degree.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.inertiaDeg_adicCompletionIntegersMap
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [inst_5 : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal], (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers L w)).inertiaDeg ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v) = w.asIdeal.inertiaDeg (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)

theorem inertiaDeg_adicCompletionIntegersMap :

docstring:
A p-ordering is determined by infinitude, membership, and the
minimum condition at positive stages only: stage zero is automatic
since every stage-zero valuation equals zero, so `a 0` is arbitrary
within `S`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isPOrdering_iff_pos
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] {p : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R} {S : Set R} {a : ℕ → R}, p.IsPOrdering S a ↔ S.Infinite ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), a n ∈ S) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ x ∈ S, p.pOrderingValuation a n (a n) ≤ p.pOrderingValuation a n x
statement:
theorem isPOrdering_iff_pos
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    {p : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R} {S : Set R}
    {a : ℕ → R} :
    IsPOrdering p S a ↔
      S.Infinite ∧ (∀ n, a n ∈ S) ∧
        ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → ∀ x ∈ S,
          pOrderingValuation p a n (a n) ≤
            pOrderingValuation p a n x

docstring: Unfolding characterization of `IsPOrdering`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isPOrdering_unfold
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] {p : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R} {S : Set R} {a : ℕ → R}, p.IsPOrdering S a ↔ S.Infinite ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), a n ∈ S) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ S, p.pOrderingValuation a n (a n) ≤ p.pOrderingValuation a n x
statement:
theorem isPOrdering_unfold
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    {p : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R} {S : Set R}
    {a : ℕ → R} :
    IsPOrdering p S a ↔
      S.Infinite ∧ (∀ n, a n ∈ S) ∧
        ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S,
          pOrderingValuation p a n (a n) ≤
            pOrderingValuation p a n x

docstring:

signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain A] {K : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra A K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing A K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum A), Ideal.map (Algebra.algebraMap A ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v)) v.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v)
statement:

    Ideal.map (algebraMap A ↥(v.adicCompletionIntegers K)) v.asIdeal =

docstring: The canonical map on finite-place completion integer rings preserves ramification index.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ramificationIdx_adicCompletionIntegersMap
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [inst_5 : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal], (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers L w)).ramificationIdx ↥(IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v) = w.asIdeal.ramificationIdx (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.separableExtension_isCompletion_finitePlace
signature:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (M : Type v) [inst_2 : Field M] [inst_3 : Algebra (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) M] [FiniteDimensional (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) M] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) M],
  ∃ L x,
    ∃ (x_1 : NumberField L),
      ∃ x_2,
        ∃ (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L) (_ : FiniteDimensional K L),
          ∃ w,
            ∃ (hw : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal),
              have x_5 := hw;
              Module.finrank K L = Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) M ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₐ[IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v] IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion L w)
statement:
theorem separableExtension_isCompletion_finitePlace
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))
    (M : Type v) [Field M] [Algebra (v.adicCompletion K) M]
    [FiniteDimensional (v.adicCompletion K) M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (v.adicCompletion K) M] :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : NumberField L) (_ : Algebra K L)
      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L) (_ : FiniteDimensional K L)
      (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L))
      (hw : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal),
      let _ : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal := hw
      Module.finrank K L =
          Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K) M ∧
        Nonempty (M ≃ₐ[v.adicCompletion K] w.adicCompletion L)

docstring:
The sum of local completion degrees over places above `v` is the global degree.
This combines parts (4) and (5) of ATLAS N236, Theorem 11.23, for use in N265.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.sum_finrank_adicCompletion_placesOver
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) [inst_5 : Fintype (v.placesOver L)], ∑ w, Module.finrank (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion L ↑w) = Module.finrank K L
statement:
theorem sum_finrank_adicCompletion_placesOver [Fintype (v.placesOver L)] :
    ∑ w : v.placesOver L,
      Module.finrank (v.adicCompletion K) (w.val.adicCompletion L) =
      Module.finrank K L

docstring:
The localization valuation subring at `v` is the preimage of the valuation ring in the adic
completion along the canonical embedding of the fraction field.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_comap_adicCompletionIntegers
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra R K] [inst_4 : IsFractionRing R K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v).toSubring = Subring.comap (Algebra.algebraMap K (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)) (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers K v).toSubring
statement:
theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_comap_adicCompletionIntegers (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    (valuationSubringAtPrime (K := K) v).toSubring =
      Subring.comap (algebraMap K (adicCompletion K v))
        (adicCompletionIntegers K v).toSubring

docstring: Completion extension of `valuation_liesOver`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_adicCompletionMap
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField K] [inst_3 : NumberField L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [inst_5 : w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v), Valued.v ((v.adicCompletionMap w) x) = Valued.v x ^ v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal

name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.MaximalIdealGradedPiece

docstring:
Scaling of `addVal` along a torsion-free local DVR extension by the
current unprimed ramification index.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_algebraMap_eq_ramificationIdx_mul
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : IsDomain B] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [inst_6 : Algebra A B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)] (x : A), (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal B) ((Algebra.algebraMap A B) x) = ↑((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx A) * (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal A) x
statement:
theorem IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_algebraMap_eq_ramificationIdx_mul
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] (x : A) :
    addVal B (algebraMap A B x) =
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx A : ℕ∞) * addVal A x

docstring:
Multiplying a nonzero element by an element of the maximal ideal strictly
increases its additive valuation.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_lt_addVal_add_of_mem_maximalIdeal
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] {d q : A}, d ≠ 0 → q ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A → (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal A) d < (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal A) d + (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal A) q

docstring:
Unramified refinement: when the maximal ideal extends to the maximal ideal
(ramification index one) and the residue-field extension is separable, every lift of a
residue-field generator generates `B`.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.adjoin_eq_top_of_lift_of_map_maximalIdeal
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : IsDomain B] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [inst_6 : Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B] [inst_8 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)], Ideal.map (Algebra.algebraMap A B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B → ∀ {β : B}, (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)[(IsLocalRing.residue B) β] = ⊤ → A[β] = ⊤
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_top_of_lift_of_map_maximalIdeal
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (ResidueField A) (ResidueField B)]
    (hunram : (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B) = maximalIdeal B)
    {β : B} (hβ : Algebra.adjoin (ResidueField A) ({residue B β} : Set _) = ⊤) :
    Algebra.adjoin A ({β} : Set B) = ⊤

docstring:
Element-membership corollary: images of elements of the base maximal ideal lie in
the `e`-th power of the target maximal ideal.

docstring:
A finite extension of discrete valuation rings with separable residue fields is
monogenic: `B` is generated by a single element over `A`. No unramifiedness is assumed;
the ramified case is handled by perturbing a residue-field lift so that the value of
the lifted minimal polynomial is a uniformizer. This is a projection of
`exists_generator_with_residue_minpoly_uniformizer`.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_adjoin_eq_top_of_separable_residueField
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : IsDomain B] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [inst_6 : Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B] [inst_8 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)], ∃ α, A[α] = ⊤
statement:
theorem exists_adjoin_eq_top_of_separable_residueField
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (ResidueField A) (ResidueField B)] :
    ∃ α : B, Algebra.adjoin A ({α} : Set B) = ⊤

docstring:
Strengthening of `exists_adjoin_eq_top_of_separable_residueField`: the generator
`α` can be chosen together with a monic polynomial `F` over `A` lifting the residue
minimal polynomial, whose value at `α` is a uniformizer of `B`.
`F` is a monic lift of `minpoly (ResidueField A) (residue B α)`; it is in general
NOT `minpoly A α` — indeed `Polynomial.aeval α F` is a nonzero uniformizer, whereas
`aeval α (minpoly A α) = 0`. Separability makes the derivative value
`Polynomial.aeval α F.derivative` a unit. No claim is made about the different.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_generator_with_residue_minpoly_uniformizer
signature: ∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : IsDomain B] [inst_5 : IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [inst_6 : Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B] [inst_8 : IsLocalHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)] [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)], ∃ α F, A[α] = ⊤ ∧ (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)[(IsLocalRing.residue B) α] = ⊤ ∧ F.Monic ∧ Polynomial.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) F = minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ((IsLocalRing.residue B) α) ∧ IsUnit ((Polynomial.aeval α) (Polynomial.derivative F)) ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B = Ideal.span {(Polynomial.aeval α) F}
statement:
theorem exists_generator_with_residue_minpoly_uniformizer
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (ResidueField A) (ResidueField B)] :
    ∃ (α : B) (F : Polynomial A),
      Algebra.adjoin A ({α} : Set B) = ⊤ ∧
      Algebra.adjoin (ResidueField A)
        ({residue B α} : Set (ResidueField B)) = ⊤ ∧
      F.Monic ∧
      F.map (residue A) =
        minpoly (ResidueField A) (residue B α) ∧
      IsUnit (Polynomial.aeval α F.derivative) ∧
      maximalIdeal B = Ideal.span {Polynomial.aeval α F}

docstring:
Base-change conjugacy: after restricting scalars to a base field `K`, the
graded-piece equivalence conjugates residue-field left multiplication to the
graded-piece multiplication endomorphism. New prerequisite support for the
corrected ATLAS N261 filtered-trace route, not a source theorem.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.residueFieldLinearEquivMaximalIdealGradedPiece_conj_lmul
signature: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_3 : Field K] [inst_4 : Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)] (i : ℕ) [inst_5 : _root_.Module K (IsDiscreteValuationRing.MaximalIdealGradedPiece R i)] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsDiscreteValuationRing.MaximalIdealGradedPiece R i)] (a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), (LinearEquiv.restrictScalars K (IsDiscreteValuationRing.residueFieldLinearEquivMaximalIdealGradedPiece R i)).conj ((Algebra.lmul K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) a) = ↑K (IsDiscreteValuationRing.residueFieldMulMaximalIdealGradedPiece R a i)
statement:
theorem residueFieldLinearEquivMaximalIdealGradedPiece_conj_lmul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (i : ℕ) [Module K (MaximalIdealGradedPiece R i)]
    [IsScalarTower K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (MaximalIdealGradedPiece R i)]
    (a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) :
    ((residueFieldLinearEquivMaximalIdealGradedPiece R i).restrictScalars K).conj
        (Algebra.lmul K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) a) =
      (residueFieldMulMaximalIdealGradedPiece R a i).restrictScalars K

representative as the representative `R`-scalar action `x • ·`. This is the
bridge from residue scalar multiplication to actual multiplication on the
quotient.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.residueFieldMulMaximalIdealGradedPiece_residue_mk
signature: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing R] (x : R) (i : ℕ) (y : ↥(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ i)), (IsDiscreteValuationRing.residueFieldMulMaximalIdealGradedPiece R ((IsLocalRing.residue R) x) i) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (x • y)

docstring:

exactly those indices have pairwise disjoint left cosets.

    (hidx : ∀ i, (U i).index = a i)

    IsGHarmonic G a

docstring: The witnessing subgroups and coset representatives.
name: IsGHarmonic.witnesses
signature: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {n : ℕ} {a : Fin n → ℕ}, IsGHarmonic G a → ∃ U g, (∀ (i : Fin n), (U i).index = a i) ∧ Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint fun i ↦ g i • ↑(U i)

theorem IsGHarmonic.witnesses {G : Type*} [Group G] {n : ℕ} {a : Fin n → ℕ}

generated by a root of `X ^ p - C a` with `a` not a `p`th power in `K`.
name: IsPurelyInseparable.exists_minpoly_X_pow_sub_C_of_finrank_eq_prime
signature: ∀ (K : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] [IsPurelyInseparable K L] [FiniteDimensional K L], Nat.Prime p → Module.finrank K L = p → ∃ α a, minpoly K α = Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C a ∧ (∀ (b : K), b ^ p ≠ a) ∧ K⟮α⟯ = ⊤

docstring:
A self-adjoint operator and a vector determine a finite regular scalar spectral measure.

The measure lives on the complex spectrum. Its support is real because the spectrum of a
self-adjoint operator is real.
name: IsSelfAdjoint.exists_spectralMeasure
signature: ∀ {E : Type u} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (v : E), ∃ μ, MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ μ.Regular ∧ ∀ (f : C(↑(spectrum ℂ T), ℝ)), ∫ (z : ↑(spectrum ℂ T)), f z ∂μ = (Inner.inner ℂ (((cfcHom ⋯) { toFun := fun z ↦ ↑(f z), continuous_toFun := ⋯ }) v) v).re
statement:
theorem IsSelfAdjoint.exists_spectralMeasure
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (v : E) :
    ∃ μ : Measure (spectrum ℂ T), IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ μ.Regular ∧
      ∀ f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ),
        ∫ z, f z ∂μ = Complex.re (inner ℂ ((cfcHom hT.isStarNormal)
          (⟨fun z => (f z : ℂ), Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp f.continuous⟩ :
            C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) v) v)

    ‖(LatticePointEnumerator.latticeEnumerator n S t : ℝ) -
      (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal * t ^ n‖ ≤

A pair `φ : M →ₗ[R] N`, `ψ : N →ₗ[R] P` is exact with `ψ` surjective if and only if

name: LinearMap.exact_and_surjective_iff_forall_lcomp
signature: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {N : Type w} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : _root_.Module R N] {P : Type w} [inst_5 : AddCommGroup P] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R P] (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (ψ : N →ₗ[R] P), Function.Exact ⇑φ ⇑ψ ∧ Function.Surjective ⇑ψ ↔ ∀ (D : Type w) [inst_7 : AddCommGroup D] [inst_8 : _root_.Module R D], Function.Injective ⇑(LinearMap.lcomp R D ψ) ∧ Function.Exact ⇑(LinearMap.lcomp R D ψ) ⇑(LinearMap.lcomp R D φ)

docstring: The matrix of a basis partitioned into Jordan chains is block diagonal.
name: LinearMap.toMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordanBlock
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : _root_.Module K V] [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → ℕ) (b : Module.Basis ((i : ι) × Fin (d i + 1)) K V) (f : Module.End K V) (μ : ι → K), (∀ (i : ι), f (b ⟨i, 0⟩) = μ i • b ⟨i, 0⟩) → (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin (d i)), f (b ⟨i, j.succ⟩) = μ i • b ⟨i, j.succ⟩ + b ⟨i, j.castSucc⟩) → (LinearMap.toMatrix b b) f = Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun i ↦ MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.JordanNormalFormWanted.jordanBlock (d i + 1) (μ i)
statement:
theorem toMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordanBlock
    {V ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℕ) (b : Basis (Σ i, Fin (d i + 1)) K V) (f : Module.End K V) (μ : ι → K)
    (hzero : ∀ i, f (b ⟨i, 0⟩) = μ i • b ⟨i, 0⟩)
    (hsucc : ∀ i (j : Fin (d i)),
      f (b ⟨i, j.succ⟩) = μ i • b ⟨i, j.succ⟩ + b ⟨i, j.castSucc⟩) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix b b f =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i ↦ jordanBlock (d i + 1) (μ i))

docstring: The matrix of a linear map on a Jordan chain is the corresponding Jordan block.
name: LinearMap.toMatrix_eq_jordanBlock
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : _root_.Module K V] (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin (d + 1)) K V) (f : Module.End K V) (μ : K), f (b 0) = μ • b 0 → (∀ (j : Fin d), f (b j.succ) = μ • b j.succ + b j.castSucc) → (LinearMap.toMatrix b b) f = MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.JordanNormalFormWanted.jordanBlock (d + 1) μ

theorem toMatrix_eq_jordanBlock

docstring:
Trace additivity for an invariant submodule: if `e` preserves `W`, then
`trace e = trace (restrict e) + trace (mapQ e)`.
name: LinearMap.trace_eq_trace_restrict_add_trace_mapQ
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : _root_.Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (W : Submodule K V) (e : V →ₗ[K] V) (he : W ≤ Submodule.comap e W), (LinearMap.trace K V) e = (LinearMap.trace K ↥W) (e.restrict he) + (LinearMap.trace K (V ⧸ W)) (W.mapQ W e he)
statement:
theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_trace_restrict_add_trace_mapQ
    (W : Submodule K V) (e : V →ₗ[K] V) (he : W ≤ W.comap e) :
    LinearMap.trace K V e =
      LinearMap.trace K W (e.restrict he) +
        LinearMap.trace K (V ⧸ W) (W.mapQ W e he)

docstring:
Trace of an endomorphism along a surjective intertwiner: the trace splits
as the trace of the restriction to the kernel plus the trace on the target.
name: LinearMap.trace_eq_trace_restrict_ker_add_of_surjective
signature: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : _root_.Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {W : Type u_3} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : _root_.Module K W] (q : V →ₗ[K] W) (f : V →ₗ[K] V) (g : W →ₗ[K] W), Function.Surjective ⇑q → ∀ (h : q ∘ₗ f = g ∘ₗ q), (LinearMap.trace K V) f = (LinearMap.trace K ↥q.ker) (f.restrict ⋯) + (LinearMap.trace K W) g
statement:
theorem LinearMap.trace_eq_trace_restrict_ker_add_of_surjective
    (q : V →ₗ[K] W) (f : V →ₗ[K] V) (g : W →ₗ[K] W)
    (hq : Function.Surjective q) (h : q.comp f = g.comp q) :
    LinearMap.trace K V f =
      LinearMap.trace K (LinearMap.ker q)
        (f.restrict (by
          change LinearMap.ker q ≤ (LinearMap.ker q).comap f
          rw [← LinearMap.ker_comp f q, h]
          exact LinearMap.ker_le_ker_comp q g)) +
      LinearMap.trace K W g

docstring:
Explicit finite-grid cardinality estimate (source lines 114–222).
Put `T = ⌈t⌉₊` and partition the cube into `T ^ d` cells with lower-corner
representatives; Lipschitz control bounds every floor-coordinate offset from
the representative by `L = ⌈K * √d⌉₊`, and each met integer cube is encoded
injectively by its cell and an offset in `Fin (2 * L + 3) ^ n`.
name: LipschitzImageCubeCount.card_integerCubeSet_le
signature: ∀ {n d : ℕ} (f : ↑(unitCube d) → Fin n → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ t → Nat.card ↑(LipschitzImageCubeCount.integerCubeSet f t) ≤ ⌈t⌉₊ ^ d * (2 * ⌈↑K * √↑d⌉₊ + 3) ^ n
statement:

    (K : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    Nat.card (integerCubeSet f t) ≤
      ⌈t⌉₊ ^ d * (2 * ⌈(K : ℝ) * Real.sqrt d⌉₊ + 3) ^ n

docstring:
Real `O(t ^ d)` consequence (source lines 283–311): with
`M = 2 * ⌈K * √d⌉₊ + 3`, the constant `C = 2 ^ d * M ^ n` depends on `f`
(through `K`), `n`, and `d`, but not on `t`. Uses `⌈t⌉₊ ≤ 2 * t` for `t ≥ 1`.
name: LipschitzImageCubeCount.exists_cubeCount_le_const_mul_pow
signature: ∀ {n d : ℕ} (f : ↑(unitCube d) → Fin n → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K f → ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ t → ↑(Nat.card ↑(LipschitzImageCubeCount.integerCubeSet f t)) ≤ C * t ^ d
statement:

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t →
      (Nat.card (integerCubeSet f t) : ℝ) ≤ C * t ^ d

docstring:

A vector `v : Fin n → ℤ` is included when some cube point `y` has `t * f y` in
the half-open cube `[vᵢ, vᵢ + 1)` in every coordinate.

docstring: Unfolding lemma for `integerCubeSet`.
name: LipschitzImageCubeCount.mem_integerCubeSet_iff
signature: ∀ {n d : ℕ} {f : ↑(unitCube d) → Fin n → ℝ} {t : ℝ} {v : Fin n → ℤ}, v ∈ LipschitzImageCubeCount.integerCubeSet f t ↔ ∃ y, ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(v i) ≤ t * f y i ∧ t * f y i < ↑(v i) + 1

Characteristic equation for `semilocalizationToAtPrime` on a localization
representative. It avoids exposing the implementation's chosen inverse unit.
name: Localization.semilocalizationToAtPrime_mk'_eq_iff
signature: ∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : CommRing T] [inst_3 : Algebra R S] [inst_4 : Algebra S T] [inst_5 : Algebra R T] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower R S T] (p : Ideal R) [inst_7 : p.IsPrime] (Q : Ideal T) [inst_8 : Q.IsPrime] [inst_9 : Q.LiesOver p] (x : S) (y : ↥(Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)) (z : Localization.AtPrime Q), (Localization.semilocalizationToAtPrime p Q) (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)) x y) = z ↔ (Algebra.algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) x = (Algebra.algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ↑y * z
statement:
theorem semilocalizationToAtPrime_mk'_eq_iff
    {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (Q : Ideal T) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p]
    (x : S) (y : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)
    (z : Localization.AtPrime Q) :
    semilocalizationToAtPrime p Q
        (IsLocalization.mk'
          (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)) x y) = z ↔
      algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q) x =
        algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q) y * z

docstring:
The projection normal form of a submersion can use any maximal-atlas codomain chart
containing the image point, after changing and shrinking its domain chart.

statement:
theorem _root_.Manifold.IsSubmersionAtOfComplement.exists_domChart_of_codChart
    [I.Boundaryless] [J.Boundaryless]
    {F : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    {f : M → N} {x : M} (hf : IsSubmersionAtOfComplement F I J n f x)
    (codChart : OpenPartialHomeomorph N G) (hfx : f x ∈ codChart.source)
    (hcodChart : codChart ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas J n N) :

docstring:
**Abel–Ruffini theorem** (§57). For each positive `n`, every root in `ℂ` of
every nonzero rational polynomial of degree `n` lies in `solvableByRad ℚ ℂ` iff
`n ≤ 4`. The forward direction (universal radical solvability implies
`n ≤ 4`) is the classical insolvability of the general quintic, padded to
higher degrees; the reverse direction proves radical solvability for
degrees at most four using the explicit low-degree (Cardano/Ferrari)
formulas. This corrects the direction descriptions in the lean-eval
source docstring, which assigned the two arguments to the opposite
implications.

Source: P. Ruffini (1799), N. H. Abel (1824), É. Galois (1832). Listed as §57
in O. Knill, *Some Fundamental Theorems in Mathematics*
(https://people.math.harvard.edu/~knill/graphgeometry/papers/fundamental.pdf);
the general-quintic insolvability is #16 on Freek Wiedijk's *Formalizing 100
Theorems* list (https://www.cs.ru.nl/~freek/100/). Taken verbatim, with no
Lean variant, from leanprover/lean-eval at commit
38361be884302c7edce1908c4aef8296eb2cb27e, manifest
`manifests/problems/abel_ruffini.toml` (statement revision 1), module
`LeanEval.Algebra.AbelRuffini`, hole `abel_ruffini`.
name: MathlibExt.Algebra.AbelRuffiniWanted.abel_ruffini
signature: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ((∀ (p : Polynomial ℚ), p.natDegree = n → ∀ (x : ℂ), (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 → x ∈ solvableByRad ℚ ℂ) ↔ n ≤ 4)

docstring:
The standard polynomial `S_{2n}` vanishes on `n × n` matrices over a commutative ring.
Source: A. S. Amitsur and J. Levitzki, Minimal identities for algebras, Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 1
(1950), 449-463, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-1950-0036751-9; textbook in Rowen, Polynomial Identities in
Ring Theory.

If `A` is a `k`-subalgebra of `M_n(k)` acting irreducibly, then `A` is the full matrix algebra.
Source: W. Burnside, On the condition of reducibility of any group of linear substitutions, Proc.
London Math. Soc. 3 (1905), 430–434, DOI 10.1112/plms/s2-3.1.430; textbook in Lam, First Course in
Noncommutative Rings, Thm 1.2. Burnside's theorem on matrix algebras / Burnside density.

docstring:
If `A` is a finite-dimensional associative unital division algebra over `ℝ` (`DivisionRing A`,
`Algebra ℝ A`, `FiniteDimensional ℝ A`), then `A` is `ℝ`-algebra isomorphic to `ℝ`, `ℂ`, or
`Quaternion ℝ`. Source: G. Frobenius, Ueber lineare Substitutionen und bilineare Formen,
J. reine angew. Math. 84 (1878), 1–63, DOI 10.1515/crelle-1878-18788403; textbook in Jacobson,
Basic Algebra II; Lean states associative unital case via `DivisionRing` excluding octonions
intentionally.
